10-b-criminal-law-center-st-catharines:
10(B) Criminal Law Center is a Niagara criminal defence practice handling bail hearings, trials, youth court and impaired driving charges.

The office is in St. Catharines, and the practice is exclusively criminal defence, led by Sidney Zarabi. Areas of work include bail hearings, resolution and diversion, youth criminal justice, mental health and drug treatment court, Indigenous peoples court and trials. The firm also helps clients reach counselling, housing and employment programs. Zarabi has written commentary on Niagara's justice system, including its detention centre and treatment court, and the firm is a member of the Ontario Trial Lawyers Association.
a-circelli-law-guelph:
Antonio Circelli runs A.Circelli Law, a family-run Guelph practice handling divorce, separation, custody, child protection and estates. He has close to 20 years of litigation experience, including trial and appellate work, and served for 11 years as counsel to the Children's Aid Society, most recently with Family and Children's Services of Guelph and Wellington County.

He has appeared in the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice, the Divisional Court and the Ontario Court of Appeal. The firm also handles equalization and property division and child and spousal support, and legal clerk Melanie Pavone works with him in serving the Guelph and Waterloo area.
a-dhillon-law-brampton:
A Dhillon Law is a Brampton criminal defence firm serving clients in Toronto, Mississauga and across Southern Ontario.

The firm is led by Akash Dhillon, who holds an Hons B.A. and J.D. It handles charges such as sexual assault and impaired driving, and its blog covers identity fraud in Milton, disobeying a court order in Orangeville and youth charges in Ontario. A criminal charge can affect liberty, immigration status, career and travel, and each case receives a defence strategy based on the evidence. Flexible payment plans are available.
a-m-canadian-immigration-law-corporation:
A&M Canadian Immigration Law Corporation is a Winnipeg firm handling study permits, work permits, Express Entry, family sponsorships and citizenship matters. The firm was founded by Dr. Muhammad Abrar, a barrister and solicitor with a PhD in law from Glasgow University who began practising law in 2005.

Practice areas include study permit extensions, post-graduation work permits, LMIA work permits, visitor visas, the Super Visa, provincial nominations including all Manitoba Provincial Nominee Program streams, the Rural Community Immigration Program, spousal sponsorships and proof of citizenship. The firm also handles procedural fairness letters, refusals and reconsideration, appeals and Federal Court litigation, as well as U.S. immigration. It serves clients across Canada and internationally.
a-s-law-office-winnipeg:
This Winnipeg, Manitoba law office at 1785 Main Street, known as A.S. Law Office, is associated with real estate and family law.

No further details about the office's lawyers, services or approach are on record, so this entry is limited to the firm's name, location and practice areas. The office is on Main Street in Winnipeg, Manitoba, and its listed areas of practice are real estate law and family law.
a-s-mattoo-and-associates-law-office-kam:
Mattoo & Associates is a Kamloops law office handling residential and commercial real estate, mortgages, wills and estates, and corporate law. A.S. Mattoo & Associates is led by Amrik S. (Steve) Mattoo, who works with associate Jas Dhaliwal, and the lawyers and senior staff bring more than two decades of combined conveyancing experience.

Commercial real estate work includes the acquisition and sale of office buildings, apartment buildings and shopping centres. The firm also represents taxpayers in CRA audits, appeals and the Tax Court of Canada, working with a former CRA tax auditor who has 23 years of experience in investigations, appeals and audits, and assists families with the transfer of estates on death.
aaries-family-law-kingston:
Aaries Family Law has offices in Kingston and Toronto and handles divorce, separation, custody, support and property division. Separation agreements and prenuptial agreements are also part of the work.

Founder Mark Kim practised as a family mediator before becoming a family lawyer, holds a Certificate in Family Mediation from York University and completed an internship with child psychologist Dr. Barbara Fidler. Helena Kim is the firm's chief executive officer. Clients set their budget, services and timeframe, and cases can be resolved through negotiation, mediation or collaborative family law. The offices are at Bay and Dundas in Toronto and at Brock and Wellington in Kingston, and the firm serves the GTA, Oshawa, Napanee, Belleville and Brockville.
aasara-lawyers-professional-corporation-:
Aasara Lawyers is a Brampton firm handling real estate, business and corporate, and wills and estates matters for clients across the GTA.

Partner Aman Kapila, a Barrister & Solicitor, practises business and corporate law, commercial matters and secured financing, and has worked on files for individual clients as well as banks and private lenders. The firm's real estate work covers buying, selling and mortgaging residential and commercial property across Ontario.
abramovich-immigration-law-toronto:
Abramovich Immigration Law handles immigration applications, refugee matters and Federal Court litigation from its office in Toronto. The firm practises only immigration law, from student visas, provincial nominations, Express Entry and spousal sponsorships to inadmissibility issues and visa refusals, and it advises Canadian and international businesses on temporary foreign worker strategy and compliance.

Services are offered in English, Russian, Spanish and Cantonese, with professional interpreters for other languages. Clients come from the US, Latin America, India and the former Soviet republics, among other places. The firm works with Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada, the Canada Border Services Agency, the Immigration and Refugee Board and the Federal Court, and its lawyers include Lev Abramovich, Anna Aazam, Sara Pesko and Sonja Pesko.
accord-family-law-edmonton:
Accord Family Law is an Edmonton firm drafting separation agreements, uncontested divorces and prenuptial and cohabitation agreements at a flat fee.

Founded by Reena Herian, a family lawyer with more than 15 years of legal experience, the practice aims to keep low-conflict families out of court and meets clients remotely. Work includes parenting arrangements, child and spousal support, property division, and independent legal advice where the other side's lawyer drafted the agreement. Wills, powers of attorney, personal directives and residential real estate purchases and sales are also offered.
accord-law-professional-corporation-toro:
Real estate, immigration, wills and powers of attorney, and business law make up the work of Accord Law Professional Corporation in Toronto. Principal lawyer and founder Angat Saini worked for over 12 years as a real estate agent and has practised at a large Bay Street firm, where he handled immigration matters for clients ranging from individual applicants to multinational corporations.

The immigration group has advised on citizenship and business cases for more than 14 years, covering business immigration, resident permits, work permits and student visas for employers hiring from abroad and for individuals moving to Canada. The firm also provides notary public and commissioner of oaths services and offers its legal services in several languages.
achkar-law:
Achkar Law is a North York employment law firm acting for employees and employers in Ontario and British Columbia on dismissal, severance and human rights.

Christopher Achkar founded the firm in 2016 with the aim of practising in plain language, with practical strategies, for real people facing real problems. The firm also handles constructive dismissal, workplace disputes and employer-side defence, with a hub for Toronto and the GTA. For employers, its lawyers design workplace training, including on the harassment and violence requirements under Ontario's Occupational Health and Safety Act. The firm acts on either side of an employment dispute.
acosta-legal-services-north-york:
Acosta Legal Services is a Toronto firm handling traffic tickets, impaired driving and criminal defence, founded in 2014.

Founder Maikell Acosta is a licensed member of the Law Society of Ontario, a certified interpreter, and a former Crown prosecutor and professor of law who is fluent in Spanish and English. The firm has grown to include a team of traffic ticket lawyers, and it offers a free consultation for new clients.
adam-miller-kelly-law-firm-ottawa:
Since 1988, Adam Miller Kelly Law Firm has served Ottawa's West End from Kanata in real estate, wills and estates. The multi-service firm has been based in Kanata since February 1988 and serves the Kanata-Stittsville community and surrounding regions. Its lawyers practise in real estate, wills, powers of attorney, estates and living wills.

Real estate lawyers act for people purchasing, selling or refinancing residential property. The firm also provides notary public and commissioner of oaths services, and March Road in Kanata is its address.
addelman-baum-gilbert-llp-ottawa:
Addelman Baum Gilbert LLP is an Ottawa firm handling criminal defence and child protection (C.A.S.) proceedings across Eastern Ontario.

The firm was formed in January 2010 by Richard Addelman, Douglas Baum, Jason Gilbert and Joseph Addelman. Based in Ottawa, it also serves Brockville, Cornwall, L'Orignal, Perth, Pembroke, Renfrew and Smiths Falls. It acts in criminal and regulatory offences as well as child protection cases, and does trial and appellate work on matters such as homicides. Richard Addelman graduated from the University of Ottawa Faculty of Law in 1969 and helped found the Defence Counsel Association of Ottawa in 1975.
ads-law-professional-corporation-mississ:
In Mississauga, ADS Law Professional Corporation acts in real estate, business and wills and estates matters, in person or online. The firm has offices in Mississauga and Toronto, with meeting offices across Ontario, and offers a transparent flat-fee structure.

Business work includes share and asset acquisitions and dispositions and incorporations, including professional corporations. The firm also drafts domestic contracts such as cohabitation agreements, marriage contracts and separation agreements, assists with divorce, and handles residential tenancies, real estate disputes and power of sale or mortgage enforcement.
advocate-law-calgary:
Advocate Law is a criminal defence firm serving Calgary, Edmonton, Red Deer and central Alberta.

The firm lists assault, sexual offence, impaired driving, drug, and murder and manslaughter charges among the matters it defends. Its legal services pages explain how assault charges are handled and what a conviction can mean, including a criminal record.
aeh-legal-laval:
Former Crown prosecutor Alicia Haziza founded AEH Legal, a Laval firm defending criminal and penal charges in Montreal and across Quebec.

Me Haziza worked for ten years as a Crown prosecutor before moving to defence, and the firm approaches each case through how prosecutions are built and where they can be challenged. It handles impaired driving, assault, drug, fraud and weapons charges, as well as penal statements of offence, and represents clients in English and in French. Representation is available around the clock. The office is on Boulevard Chomedey.
aftermath-law-criminal-defence-mississau:
Aftermath Law is a Mississauga criminal defence practice led by Dildeep Sahi, handling assault, domestic assault and sexual assault charges in Peel Region.

Dildeep Sahi trained at an Ontario Crown Attorney's Office, and the firm takes urgent matters around the clock. Charges handled include assault with a weapon or causing bodily harm and aggravated assault. From its Mississauga office the firm serves thirteen Ontario communities, including Brampton, accepts Legal Aid and offers flat fees. Languages are English, Punjabi and Hindi, and a charge can affect release conditions, a record, travel and immigration status.
agir-legal-inc: Agir Legal Inc is a family law firm in Quebec City, Quebec. Its office is at 1020 Rue Bouvier, Suite 400, Quebec City, Quebec G2K 0H3. The firm's practice area is family law, and it is based in Quebec City in the province of Quebec. Details of its lawyers, services other than family law and approach are not on record, so this entry is limited to the firm's name, address and practice area.
agnes-law-toronto:
Agnes Law is a Toronto family law practice led by its owner and principal lawyer, Agnes K Varkeychen. The practice handles family law matters, and its principal is also a notary public.

Varkeychen holds a BA, an LLB with honours and an LLM, is pursuing a doctorate, and practises as a barrister, solicitor and notary public. The office is at 885 Progress Avenue, Suite 218, in the Scarborough area of Toronto, Ontario.
agp-llp-ottawa-criminal-lawyers-ottawa:
AGP LLP is an Ottawa criminal defence firm of trial and appellate lawyers handling appeals, assault, drinking and driving, drug and homicide cases.

The firm was founded in Ottawa two decades ago and builds a custom-crafted defence for each client. Its practice areas include bail hearings, domestic assaults, sexual assault and white-collar matters, and it acts for executives, civil servants, doctors, pharmacists, high-tech workers, diplomats and organizations facing criminal or regulatory issues. Criminal appeals turn on finding legal errors, and the firm defends against Crown appeals from acquittal or sentence and takes referrals from other lawyers.
ain-whitehead-llp-barrie:
Ain Whitehead LLP is a Barrie firm handling business, real estate and wills and estates law.

The practice marks ten years and counts lawyers Andrew Ain, Graydon Ebert, Jill Annett, Kathryn Whitehead and Tony Servello among its team. Andrew's work centres on residential real estate, mortgage lending and commercial transactions, with a focus on land development and condominium law, plus corporate matters such as new corporations, shareholder agreements and the buying and selling of businesses. Real estate work covers commercial leasing, lease negotiation and drafting, and the firm offers a land transfer calculator. Areas served include the City of Barrie and the Township of Springwater.
aird-berlis-llp:
Aird & Berlis LLP is a Toronto business law firm, with a Vancouver office, advising on corporate, capital markets and real estate matters.

Founded in 1919, the firm acts for multinational corporations, startups, individuals, governments and Indigenous nations. Its areas of work include Aboriginal law, projects and infrastructure, restructuring and insolvency, intellectual property, municipal and land use planning, tax, technology and workplace law. Recent items include a Workplace Law Summit scheduled for November 12, 2026 in Toronto and a Wolters Kluwer book on international relocation and tax planning for high-net-worth individuals.
aitken-robertson-kingston:
Aitken Robertson's Kingston office defends criminal charges, including impaired driving, sexual assault, domestic assault and internet offences.

The firm works as a team in which every criminal lawyer takes an active role in each case, with a pool of seven lawyers working on a file. Combined experience exceeds 100 years, and the firm acts at all court levels in Oshawa, Toronto, Newmarket, Peterborough, Kingston, Markham and elsewhere in Ontario. Flexible fee arrangements are available, and the firm publishes a list of myths and facts about impaired driving, covering topics such as blood alcohol readings and the difference between over 80 and impaired charges. The Kingston office is on Princess Street.
aitken-robertson-peterborough:
Aitken Robertson (Peterborough) is a Peterborough criminal defence firm handling impaired driving, sexual assault and domestic assault charges. Its lawyers work as a team, with every criminal lawyer at the firm taking an active part in each file, and the firm has more than 100 years of combined experience.

The Peterborough office is at 263 Charlotte Street. The firm defends charges at all court levels in Ontario, including in Oshawa, Toronto, Newmarket, Kingston and Markham. Richard Aitken is among its lawyers, and the firm also publishes a myths-and-facts guide to impaired driving charges in Canada and offers flexible fee arrangements.
aj-murray-legal-services-professional-co:
Paralegals at AJ Murray Legal Services Professional Corporation handle landlord and tenant, human rights and provincial offences matters in Ottawa.

The firm also has offices in Toronto and Hamilton. Licensed paralegal and notary public Amri Murray holds a law degree from the University of London and has more than 16 years in the legal industry. The firm appears before the Landlord and Tenant Board, the Ontario Court of Justice and the Human Rights Tribunal, and handles employment standards issues such as minimum wage and hours of work, from negotiation through to litigation.
akrami-and-associates-mississauga:
Akrami & Associates helps individuals, families and businesses in Mississauga with work permits, visitor visas, sponsorship and permanent residence. The firm also assists with Express Entry and with business immigration for people planning to establish or operate a business in Canada, and its team has worked on thousands of cases involving permanent and temporary residence.

The firm holds that anyone with a valid reason to immigrate to Canada should have the chance to do so. Its team includes licensed immigration representatives regulated by the Law Society and the Immigration Consultants of Canada Regulatory Council, and it follows government announcements that could affect an application. The office is on Hurontario Street in Mississauga.
alam-real-estate-law-mississauga:
Alam Real Estate Law is a Mississauga firm handling property purchases, sales, refinancing and real estate litigation in the GTA and Halton.

Principal lawyer Jawaid Alam has degrees in commerce, economics and finance, business management and law, holds Ontario accreditation of his law degree through the National Committee of Accreditation, and speaks English, Hindi and Urdu. The firm also handles construction litigation, registering and removing liens, commercial property development litigation, and examination of agreements of purchase and sale and mortgage agreements. It serves residential and commercial clients across Mississauga and the surrounding communities.
alepin-gauthier-avocats:
Alepin Gauthier Avocats is a family-run Laval firm of lawyers, notaries and tax advisers covering business law, family law, tax and litigation. The firm has been in business since 1978 and serves individuals and small and medium businesses.

It serves clients across Quebec and internationally through the Law Firm Alliance, with appointments in Laval, Montreal, Quebec City or online at any hour. Its franchise law group assists franchisors and franchisees, including on intellectual property, and its advertising and marketing group advises on promotional contests, signage under the Charter of the French Language, influencer partnerships, anti-spam and privacy rules, and competition law.
alexander-hu-professional-corporation-to:
Alexander Hu Professional Corporation is a Downtown Toronto law firm limited to real estate, handling home and condo purchases, sales and mortgages.

The firm's work covers title examination, financing and closing coordination, including examination of condominium status certificates and collaboration with realtors and mortgage lenders. It serves Toronto, Peel, Durham, York and Halton regions, with local coverage of Central Toronto, Old York, East York, Etobicoke, North York and Scarborough. Topics include multiple offers, rezoning and development, property taxes, land transfer taxes and mixed-use or commercial properties.
alg-lawyers:
ALG Lawyers is an Abbotsford firm with offices in Surrey and Vancouver, handling family, criminal, civil, real estate and estate litigation matters.

Its head office is on Garden Street in Abbotsford, where the firm moved while welcoming professionals and clients from Bronson Jones Gray & Company. Practice areas include appeals and a detailed adoption service covering step-parent, relative and kinship, adult, direct placement, agency and ministry, and contested adoptions. The firm is a paperless office staffed by lawyers and paralegals, and it serves families across the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley.
ali-family-law-surrey:
Ali Family Law is a Surrey firm handling divorce, separation agreements, parenting, child and spousal support, and property division.

The firm drafts and reviews agreements to reduce conflict and avoid court, and it offers mediation and independent legal advice. Its site says it aims for parenting arrangements that support the child's well-being.
alice-huynh-law-corporation-vancouver:
Alice Huynh Law Corporation is a Vancouver firm handling family law, civil disputes and estate disputes, with service available in Vietnamese. It has offices on West Broadway in Vancouver and on Edmonds Street in Burnaby.

Family services cover separation agreements, divorce, parenting arrangements, child and spousal support, the division of assets and debt, cohabitation and pre-nuptial agreements, and adoption applications. The firm also represents individuals, businesses and government entities in civil disputes and helps with will and estate conflicts, including challenges to a will's validity, disputes over an executor's actions and allegations of undue influence.
align-family-law:
Align Family Law is a Victoria family law firm, with a Kimberley office, handling separation, divorce and marriage and cohabitation agreements.

The firm takes a collaborative approach built around a step-by-step plan called the Align Method. Services include flat-fee work, divorce-only packages and independent legal advice on family law agreements, and clients choose how much help they want, from assistance with one part of a matter to full representation. The firm works with people around British Columbia.
alloy-llp-calgary:
Alloy LLP is a Calgary firm practising corporate litigation, real estate and personal injury law for individuals and businesses. Partners Joseph Iwanicki and Greg von Euw became friends in law school and formed the firm after more than 10 years of experience in the industry.

Each file stays with one lawyer rather than passing between several, so clients deal with the same person throughout. The firm helps business owners with legal problems, home buyers and sellers, and people hurt in accidents. The office is in Bow Valley Square II on 5 Avenue SW and serves the Calgary area and beyond.
amanda-berloni-professional-corporation:
Amanda Berloni Professional Corporation is a Greater Sudbury practice, founded in 2015, focused on real estate and corporate and commercial law.

Amanda Berloni and her team have helped thousands of people with property purchases since 2015, examining agreements of purchase and sale, preparing mortgage and loan documents and commercial leases, and advising on title insurance and electronic registration. On the business side, the firm helps clients establish, grow and support their companies. The practice marks ten years in the community and sponsors local causes, including a Sudbury Secondary School law bursary, Place des Arts de Sudbury and the Sudbury Wolves.
amani-law-office-richmond-hill:
Immigration, notary public, real estate and estate-planning services are offered by Amani Law Office in Richmond Hill. It also acts in civil litigation and criminal matters.

The office is in Suite 203 at 27 Major Mackenzie Drive East in Richmond Hill, and appointments can be booked. Information about the practice is presented in both English and Farsi. In all, the six service areas are immigration, notary public, real estate, wills and powers of attorney, civil litigation and criminal matters.
ambassador-law-corporation-abbotsford:
Ambassador Law Corporation is an Abbotsford firm handling real estate conveyancing, subdivisions, wills and estates, corporate law and notarizations.

The firm amalgamated with Terry Sidhu Notarial Services Inc. and serves clients throughout the Fraser Valley. Its real estate group acts on home purchases and sales and changes of mortgage lender, and its subdivision work with municipalities covers rezoning, border realignments and splitting a property into several PIDs. Notarizations include affidavits for BC registries, international documents and real estate transfers; the signer must attend in person with government photo identification. The firm has more than fifteen years in subdivisions and over twenty years overall.
amberstone-law-civil-litigation-lawyers-:
Amberstone Law is a Calgary firm for business owners, corporations and investors, handling commercial litigation and commercial real estate.

The firm also handles commercial closings. The site says each client works directly with the lawyer handling the file. The team includes Shubhankar Baweja, Karanbir Dhariwal, Jason Ramsoondar, Ashima Dawar and Avneet Kaur.
amer-ali-law-ottawa:
Amer Ali Law is a virtual Ontario firm, with Ottawa, Orleans and Toronto listed, that handles real estate closings, incorporations and wills.

The firm's model pairs technology with personal service, with documents signed electronically and remotely, or in person when arranged in advance. Its real estate work includes buying and selling, title transfers and survivorship applications, mortgage transactions, mortgage refinancing and debt consolidation, and examining the agreement of purchase and sale. It acts for homeowners, realtors, lenders and mortgage professionals on residential and commercial properties, and has completed thousands of real estate deals.
amica-law-corporation-winnipeg:
Amica Law Corporation is a general practice law firm in Winnipeg, Manitoba, at 226 Osborne Street North, Suite 30. The firm is located on Osborne Street North in Winnipeg, and its listed practice area is general practice.

Details of its lawyers, history and specific services are not on record, so this entry is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice area in Manitoba.
amlea-avocats:
Amlea Avocats is a Montreal boutique firm handling business law, taxation, and mergers and acquisitions for entrepreneurs and small businesses. It also works with start-ups and combines legal, tax and strategic advice.

Services include incorporation, choice of corporate structure, corporate books and registers, share capital and shareholder agreements, and the purchase or sale of businesses, shares or assets, including letters of intent. On the tax side, the firm plans for growing businesses, advises on salary versus dividend compensation and sets up holding companies. It offers personalized support and availability, and its office is at Place d'Armes.
ammar-law-professional-corporation-winds:
Ammar Law Professional Corporation is a Windsor firm led by Ahmad Ammar handling criminal defence, real estate, personal injury, traffic and wills matters.

Ahmad Ammar is licensed to practise in both Ontario and Michigan. The firm handles Criminal Code and drug offences, bail hearings, traffic offences, powers of attorney, wills and estates, notary services, and motor vehicle and personal injury cases, and also works in immigration. Real estate services cover purchases, sales and refinancing. The firm's approach is strategic and aimed at protecting legal rights.
anderson-haak-and-engels-edmonton:
Anderson Haak & Engels is an Edmonton real estate law firm handling home and condo purchases, sales and mortgage refinancing in Alberta.

A lawyer is needed in Alberta to transfer title on a purchase or sale, and the firm brings more than sixty years of experience to that work. It has handled over 45,000 real estate transactions, and its partners are Kenneth R. Haak and Robert A. Engels. The firm also prepares wills, personal care directives and enduring powers of attorney, and it publishes base fees for each service.
andrew-edgar-criminal-defence-counsel-br:
Andrew Edgar Criminal Defence Counsel represents people facing criminal charges in Brampton, Mississauga and across the GTA. Andrew Edgar has practised exclusively in criminal defence since 2005, a span of more than 20 years, and works directly with each client. He represents clients in the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice.

He walks through the allegations, the evidence, the options and the possible consequences of a charge, including questions about work, family and a criminal record, so that clients can make informed decisions. The firm, which also operates as Edgar Law, is on Steeles Avenue East in Brampton.
andrews-donnelly-llp-kingston:
Andrews Donnelly LLP is a Kingston boutique firm handling family law, estate litigation and civil litigation.

Its dispute resolution services are available in Kingston, Frontenac County, Prince Edward County and surrounding areas, including Brockville, Napanee, Belleville and Picton. Family work covers custody, access, child and spousal support and division of property. Estate litigation covers will challenges, power of attorney disputes, capacity questions and the passing of fiduciary accounts. Its lawyers include Paul and Whitney, and fees can be arranged as fixed-fee or project-based billing, hourly engagements, or monthly retainers.
ang-law-professional-corporation-north-y:
Ang Law Professional Corporation is a North York firm handling real estate, family law, wills and estates, immigration and business law. Founded in 2020, it acts on residential and commercial real estate transactions, divorce and separation including mediation and support, marriage and cohabitation contracts, civil matters and estate planning.

Lawyer Derek graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School in 2018, focuses on family and real estate law and sits on the Legal Aid family panel. Lia is licensed in both the Philippines and Ontario and practises immigration and business law. Services are offered remotely for clients across the Greater Toronto Area.
angeles-and-de-jesus-law-llp-toronto:
Angeles & De Jesus Law LLP is a Toronto general practice firm serving the Filipino-Canadian community in family, immigration and estate law. Also known as AJ Law LLP, it handles immigration, decision-making responsibility and parenting time, marriage and cohabitation contracts, property division, wills, residential and commercial real estate closings, criminal law and civil litigation, and offers paralegal and notary services.

The firm was started by Fatima, who completed a Master of Laws in Canadian common law at the University of Toronto, and Czarina, a licensed paralegal, with the aim of widening access to legal services for the Filipino community. Its office is on Eglinton Avenue East in Toronto.
anita-perera-law-professional-corp-lawye:
Anita Perera Law is a Brampton firm offering real estate, immigration, family, wills and notary services across the GTA, founded in 2016.

Anita Perera practised law in Sri Lanka before requalifying in Canada and being called to the Ontario bar in 2016. The firm describes its approach as patient, plain-language advice for clients who find the legal system intimidating, particularly newcomers. Its paralegal services cover Small Claims Court and tribunal matters across the Greater Toronto Area.
ankr-legal-calgary:
ANKR Legal is a Calgary firm handling personal injury and motor vehicle accident claims, with wills and estates work alongside.

The firm says it explains each step of a claim clearly and understands how insurers operate. Its estate planning services help clients set out how their estate is managed, so their wishes are carried out.
anne-gervais-corbin-avocate:
Anne Gervais-Corbin is a Granby lawyer practising family law and youth protection. Her office is at 371 Rue Racine in the Estrie region of Quebec.

She is listed in the Réseau des professionnels du droit du Québec directory as Avocate en droit familial et protection de la jeunesse Granby. No further detail on the types of family or youth matters handled is on record, so this description is limited to the practice areas and office location.
annette-lefebvre-avocats-montreal:
Annette Lefebvre Avocats is a Montreal firm representing patients and accident victims in medical malpractice and personal injury cases.

The firm acts only for patients and victims, including in birth injury, spinal cord injury and chiropractic injury cases against doctors, medical institutions, building owners and insurers. It has more than forty years of experience. Annette Lefebvre is a former intensive care nurse who has spent over thirty years on malpractice and injury suits, and Melissa Lonn has devoted her practice to the same fields, drawing on a background in social work and science. The firm serves Montreal, Laval, Longueuil and Brossard.
annie-boyer-avocate-saint-jerome:
Annie Boyer practises criminal and penal defence in Saint-Jerome with the lawyers of OMB Avocats, who also serve Laval and Joliette.

Her colleagues at the firm are Carl Ouimet, Karam Mahrez, Jonathan Boivin and Félix Beauchemin. OMB Avocats defends impaired driving, drug, assault, domestic violence, sexual assault, theft, hit and run, weapons and attempted murder charges, and also handles restricted licences, vehicle seizures and the setting aside of default judgments. Its main territories are Saint-Jerome, Mirabel, Repentigny, Terrebonne, Laval and Joliette. Legal aid mandates are accepted, and emergency service is available around the clock.
ansari-immigration-law-calgary:
Ansari Immigration Law is a Calgary firm handling Express Entry, permanent residence, work and study permits and family sponsorship. Founder Yameena Ansari is licensed in Ontario, Alberta and the Northwest Territories and graduated from the University of Victoria Faculty of Law.

The firm works in English, French, Hindi and Urdu, and also assists with LMIA applications, super visas, citizenship, refugee and humanitarian matters, and employers hiring foreign workers. Since November 2023 Ansari has focused on immigration measures for Gazans, founding the Gaza Family Reunification Project with fellow lawyers to petition the federal government.
anton-m-katz-barrister-and-solicitor-nor:
Anton Katz practises corporate and commercial law in North York for small and mid-size businesses. His work includes federal and Ontario incorporations, including professional corporations, share issuances, transfers and redemptions, amalgamations and reorganizations, asset and share purchase agreements, commercial leases and customer contracts.

Anton M. Katz graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School in 1994, was called to the Ontario bar in 1996 and has been a sole practitioner since 2001. He served on the Ontario Bar Association Council from 2012 to 2018 and has held executive roles in its business law and sole and small firm general practice sections. The office is on Yonge Street.
apna-law-llp-burnaby:
Apna Law LLP is a Burnaby firm of trial and appellate lawyers handling family, estate, personal injury and civil disputes.

The firm opened in 2018 and serves British Columbia and Alberta, and its lawyers have more than 40 years of combined experience inside and outside the courtroom. Its name is a Punjabi word loosely meaning ours, which the firm links to community and collaboration. The family law team includes James Gill, Amanda James, Hannah Gowans and Ingrid Lee, and an appeal to the Court of Appeal is not a re-hearing of the case. It also publishes articles, including one on international students and immigration consultants.
archstone-law-professional-corporation-m:
Archstone Law Professional Corporation, in Mississauga, acts in real estate, family, immigration, estates and civil litigation matters.

Areesha Raja is the principal lawyer. She articled at an estate litigation firm in downtown Toronto, worked at firms in immigration, family, civil litigation and real estate, and represented clients at a ten-day civil trial in her first year as a lawyer. The firm acts for both plaintiffs and defendants in Ontario litigation, handles residential and commercial real estate transactions and prepares wills. During law school Areesha sat on a pro bono committee, and she still serves clients who might not otherwise afford a lawyer.
arrow-law-north-york:
Immigration, real estate, wills and estates, and family law are the practice areas of Arrow Law, a firm in North York serving Toronto and Durham. Its lawyers also act for clients in Whitby and the wider Durham Region, and the firm works from offices on Yonge Street in North York and on King Street West in Hamilton.

Clients receive timely updates at every step of a matter, and the firm uses technology and flexible service methods to deliver its services. Its lawyers practise in each of these areas, and a steady flow of its work comes from referred clients.
art-of-law-professional-corporation-nort:
Art of Law Professional Corporation is a North York firm handling civil litigation, family law, wills and estates and real estate. Civil work includes breach of contract, wrongful dismissal, debt collection, property damage and personal injury, while family matters include contested and uncontested divorce, child and spousal support, parenting, equalization of net family property and domestic contracts such as cohabitation, separation and marriage contracts.

Estates work covers wills and powers of attorney. Lawyer Ardeshir works in English and Farsi, focuses on family law, civil litigation, and wills and estates, and has experience from Greater Toronto Area firms. The office is at Yonge Street and Sheppard Avenue.
ascent-employment-law-vancouver:
Ascent Employment Law is a Vancouver firm acting for employers, employees and contractors in employment, labour and human rights matters. Richard Johnson, David Brown and Trevor Thomas formed the practice, and its work is limited to employment, human rights, contractor engagements, labour and workers' compensation law.

Typical assignments include negotiating new employment terms, handling workplace conflict and grievances, ending difficult employment relationships and appearing in court. The wider team includes Veronica Ukrainetz, Ian Jung, Brynna Hambly, Glen Stratton and Sean Marzinzik.
avanessy-giordano-llp-north-york:
Avanessy Giordano LLP is a North York boutique personal injury firm representing injured people in Toronto and across Ontario.

The firm was founded in 2015 by Michael Giordano and Aline Avanessy, each with more than a decade of personal injury experience at large firms before they opened their own practice. They keep a conservative file load, give clients regular updates and maintain a network of medical and rehabilitation practitioners. The firm also handles medical malpractice, with medical professionals on staff to help identify negligence and support a case through litigation.
aviron-law-professional-corporation-bram:
Aviron Law Professional Corporation is a Brampton firm handling real estate, wills and estate planning, business law, immigration and civil litigation.

Its principal lawyer, Dilvir S. Tatter, holds LL.M. and LL.B. degrees, practises as barrister, solicitor and notary public, and began his career in litigation on contractual disputes. The real estate group acts on residential, commercial and condominium purchases and sales, mortgage refinancing, survivorship applications and title transfers. Its litigation practice covers civil disputes from a demand letter through negotiation, mediation and trial, including shareholder and partnership conflicts, failed closings and deposit disputes. Team member Avinash Kaur is also named.
avocat-criminel-montreal-montreal:
Lespérance Avocats, operating as Avocat Criminel Montréal, is a criminal defence firm serving Montreal, Laval, Gatineau and Maniwaki in French and English.

The main office is in Old Montreal near Notre-Dame Basilica, with a second office in Gatineau and meetings in Maniwaki by appointment. The firm acts in criminal cases involving firearms, drugs, violence and domestic violence, and handles offences tied to sexual services and human trafficking. It accepts legal aid and takes a collaborative, organized approach to each file, with an administrative team that manages communication and case handling.
avocat-droit-criminel-montreal-montreal:
Criminal defence in Montreal and Longueuil is handled by Avocat droit criminel Montréal, which operates as Solution Avocat.

The team represents clients at each stage of the court process so they need not attend every appearance, and fees are set on a flat basis rather than by the hour, explained at the first meeting. It has handled more than 3,000 files, including impaired driving cases, and its team includes a member of the Barreau du Québec since 2009. The firm serves the judicial districts of Montreal, Longueuil and Saint-Hyacinthe, among others, in French and English, from an office on Rue Sherbrooke Est.
avocat-maitre-lachance:
Avocat Maitre Lachance is a Repentigny practice covering business, civil, real estate and family law, plus mediation.

Me Michel Lachance founded his own firm in Repentigny in 1994, after being admitted to the Barreau du Québec in 1985. He holds a law degree from Université Laval, served as a councillor of the Laurentides-Lanaudière bar from 2008 to 2010 and is an active member of the Chamber of Commerce of the MRC de L'Assomption. His business work includes commercial leases, movable hypothecs, hidden defects, corporate restructuring and insurance disputes, and service is offered in French.
avocat-montreal:
Avocat Montreal is a Montreal service of the Devichy firm that lets people speak directly with a lawyer seven days a week, by telephone or online chat. It covers civil, family, immigration, business, labour, real estate, construction, tax and criminal law.

The service was created because people needing a lawyer are often in urgent situations. The lawyer can give first advice and then refer the matter to a meeting with that lawyer or another in the relevant field. Topics include sponsorship, asylum and permanent residence, legal hypothecs and RBQ matters in construction, GST and QST questions involving Revenu Québec, and traffic tickets. The office is at 240 Rue Saint-Jacques.
avocates-paille-grondin: Avocates Paille Grondin is a family law practice in Drummondville, Quebec, with an office at 215 Rue Lindsay. This entry rests on the firm's name, address and practice area of family law. The French name indicates a practice of women lawyers, avocates, though no individual lawyers, services or courts are named.
avocats-laurentides-me-rheaume: Avocats Laurentides - Me Rheaume is a law office at 330 Rue Saint-Georges in Saint-Jerome, in Quebec's Laurentides region. No practice areas or description are on record for the firm, so no particular services or courts are stated. The name suggests a practice led by a lawyer named Rheaume serving the Laurentides area.
avocats-rive-sud:
Avocats Rive-Sud is a Brossard firm handling civil and criminal law matters, with an office on Avenue Auteuil.

The firm guides people through the criminal court process while making sure their fundamental rights are respected, and it also acts in civil matters. Its civil services are advice, drafting, representation and negotiation. The firm's full name, Avocats Rive-Sud, droit civil et droit criminel, and its name point to the South Shore of Montréal as its home area.
avtar-bhangal-mississauga:
Avtar Bhangal practises as Bhangal Law, a Mississauga criminal defence firm handling assaults, impaired driving, fraud, theft and drug charges.

The firm's lawyers have over thirty years of courtroom experience between them. Avtar Bhangal has been a member of the Law Society of Ontario, formerly the Law Society of Upper Canada, since 1994, and Savena Bhangal since 2022. The firm has handled thousands of criminal matters, keeps clients informed about their case, and guides them through the criminal justice process. The office is on Derry Road West in Mississauga, Ontario.
axess-law-toronto:
Axess Law is a Toronto firm that handles home closings online or at the client's home, and also advises small businesses on incorporation and registration.

The firm has focused for over a decade on virtual real estate closings, with a short onboarding process, video signing meetings, in-home signing and status updates. It also handles closings for Quebec properties. Its business law work covers business names, registration, incorporation and partnerships for small businesses and start-ups, through virtual or in-person appointments in Ontario.
axon-law-edmonton:
Axon Law is an Edmonton firm handling civil litigation, corporate law, criminal defence, family law and immigration. It also acts in real estate matters and prepares wills and powers of attorney.

Mandarin-speaking lawyers are available for clients who want to work in Mandarin. The office is at 10209 97 Street NW, and the firm is recruiting associates with three to five years of experience who are independent and entrepreneurial, with family law and civil litigation experience and additional languages considered assets.
ayf-law-firm-markham:
Family, criminal, immigration and real estate matters across the Greater Toronto Area are handled by AYF Law Firm in downtown Markham. The team combines lawyers, paralegals and immigration consultants.

Family services include divorce, separation, arbitration and mediation, asset division, child custody and access, and child support and spousal support. Real estate work covers residential and commercial transactions, title transfers and refinances. The firm also prepares wills and handles civil litigation, immigration appeals and criminal charges, and it works with clients around the globe as well as in the Greater Toronto Area.
ayoun-law-mississauga:
Ayoun Law is a Mississauga firm handling family law, real estate, immigration, estate planning and civil litigation across the GTA.

Styled Ayoun & Sabeeya LLP, the firm was founded by Ayoun Haroon and Sabeeya Akram in 2018, and a licensed paralegal and notary later joined it for tribunal matters and notarizations. Landlord and Tenant Board matters, traffic tickets, independent legal advice and notary services are handled alongside its main practice areas. Lawyers advise in English, Urdu, Punjabi and Hindi, with an assistant supporting Polish-speaking clients. Fees are stated openly at $199 per half-hour after an introductory 15-minute intake, and service areas include Brampton, Oakville, Milton and Toronto.
azatian-law-professional-corporation-st-:
Family law, small business and wills and estates services are offered by Azatian Law Professional Corporation. The firm works collaboratively with clients, and notary public services are available by appointment.

The office is at 43 Church Street in St. Catharines. Lawyer Lilia holds an Honours Bachelor of Arts in political science from the University of Toronto and received a full academic scholarship in law school, where she was involved with a neighbourhood legal clinic. She volunteers as a mock trial coach with the Ontario Justice Education Network. The business work covers starting, buying or merging with an existing business, and the wills work covers will drafting.
azimi-law-north-york:
Azimi Law is a North York litigation boutique handling personal injury cases and immigration litigation across Ontario. Founded in 2016 by Bahman (Ben) Azimi, it acts for people hurt in car, motorcycle, truck, pedestrian, bicycle, ride-share and transit accidents, as well as slip and fall, dog bite, product liability and medical malpractice matters, including accident benefits and negligence actions.

On the immigration side it acts for people facing refusals, detention, delays or removal, including appeals and Federal Court litigation. Personal injury files are taken on a contingency basis, and the lawyer will travel to a client's home, hospital or rehabilitation facility. The office is on Sheppard Avenue East.
b-and-b-law-greater-sudbury:
B&B Law is a general practice firm in Greater Sudbury that acts for both individuals and businesses.

The firm stresses timely communication, transparency and a client-responsive way of working, and it is a modern firm that makes use of technology. It regularly meets with clients over audio-visual platforms such as Zoom. The office is at 238 Elm Street, Unit 200, in Greater Sudbury, Ontario, and the firm serves individual and business clients with a general practice.
b-kay-law-office-edmonton:
B.Kay Law Office is an Edmonton practice handling immigration law, personal injury and notary services for individuals, families and businesses.

The firm was founded by Bikramjit Singh and serves Edmonton's multicultural community, as well as clients across Canada, in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu. Its immigration practice covers Canadian temporary residence programs and admissibility hearings and detention matters. Notary Public and Commissioner for Oaths services are offered in Edmonton and surrounding areas, including affidavits, and clients are told what to bring to an appointment.
badesha-law-criminal-lawyer-brampton-bra:
Badesha Law is a Brampton criminal defence firm representing people charged with assault, DUI, theft, domestic violence and other offences.

The firm is led by founding lawyer Harprit Badesha and senior lawyer Kajol Panchol. It acts from the first police involvement through bail hearings and trial, across Brampton, Mississauga, Peel Region and the Greater Toronto Area. Other charges handled include sexual assault, dangerous driving, uttering threats, and theft under and over $5,000. Fees can be flat or flexible, and the firm is available around the clock.
badre-law-professional-corporation-ottaw:
Badre Law Professional Corporation is an Ottawa personal injury firm handling car accident cases and other injury cases across Ontario.

The firm focuses exclusively on personal injury and accidents. Its team includes founder Daniel Badre alongside lawyers Michael Adamek, Paul D. Mooney, Alex Elkin, Trevor Tynan and Madona Markaj, with over 170 years of combined legal experience. Alex Elkin works in the Ontario courts and before the License Appeal Tribunal. The firm also publishes guidance on long-term disability matters, including pre-existing conditions and applications.
bagga-and-associates-calgary:
Bagga & Associates is a Calgary firm focused on criminal defence, serious personal injury, immigration and real estate law. Founded by Ravinder (Rob) Bagga, the firm includes Rohan Bagga, his son, and serves individuals, families and businesses from its office on 34 Street NE.

Criminal work covers bail hearings, drug and impaired driving charges, Immediate Roadside Sanctions, domestic assault, sexual offences and serious violence. The injury practice handles motor vehicle collisions and medical malpractice, and immigration work covers permanent residence, spousal sponsorship, work permits, refusals and appeals. Real estate includes residential and commercial purchases, sales and refinancing.
baig-law-firm-mississauga:
BAIG LAW FIRM is a Mississauga practice handling personal injury, immigration, real estate and franchise law. Founding principal Abbas M. Baig holds a Juris Doctor from the University of Ottawa and a BSc and MSc from the University of Guelph. Before practising law he served as chief of staff to a federal Member of Parliament and as an advisor to cabinet ministers in the Government of Ontario.

He has appeared in the Federal Court of Canada, the Ontario Superior Court of Justice and the Refugee Protection Division, Refugee Appeal Division and Immigration Appeal Division of the Immigration and Refugee Board. The firm also handles motor vehicle accident, contract, corporate and civil litigation matters and serves Oakville, Milton, Brampton, Toronto, Kitchener, Waterloo, Hamilton and Niagara Falls.
bakleh-avocats-and-associes-saint-jerome:
Bakleh Avocats & Associés is a Saint-Jerome firm working in criminal, penal, civil and real estate law, and it also contests traffic tickets.

The team helps drivers keep their demerit points and their licence when a ticket is contested, including tickets issued in Montreal. The firm also runs an immigration practice that pairs Me Charlis Bakleh with regulated immigration consultant Joseph Zakhour for study permits, work visas, permanent residence and status regularization, in Quebec, Ontario or remotely. Real estate law is among its practice areas, and the firm works in French.
balance-law-professional-corporation:
Balance Law Professional Corporation is a Niagara Falls firm founded in 2024 that handles tax, corporate, employment, estate and real estate matters.

The firm was started to take the mystery out of tax, corporate and commercial law and real estate for clients at every financial level. Its work includes CRA audits, tax controversy, international tax planning and transfer pricing, incorporations through mergers and acquisitions, estate plans and property closings, and it represents clients before the Federal Court of Canada. The lawyer who leads it holds CPA and LLM qualifications, with earlier experience at RSM, PwC and KPMG. Its clients are small business owners, individuals and families, and property buyers and sellers.
balawan-law-firm-calgary:
Balawan Law Firm is a Calgary practice near Chinook Mall offering family, real estate, criminal and immigration law in English and Filipino. The office is on Macleod Trail SW.

Personal injury, wills and estates and notary services are also available, including same-day notarization and mobile visits to homes or hospitals. Lawyer Chris earned his law degree at the University of the Cordilleras in the Philippines, qualified through the National Committee on Accreditation and was admitted to the Law Society of Alberta in January 2022. He speaks English, Tagalog and Ilocano and gained experience in family and criminal law as a student-at-law.
bally-hundal-brampton:
Bally Hundal is a Brampton criminal defence lawyer who has practised for over 24 years, defending charges from assault to murder. He was called to the Ontario bar in March 2002 and worked for over three years as criminal duty counsel with Legal Aid Ontario, then completed a Master of Laws at Osgoode Hall in 2019.

He has worked part-time as a staff lawyer on Charter litigation with the Justice Centre for Constitutional Freedoms and served as an adjudicator at the Ontario Licence Appeal Tribunal. His practice, Hundal Law Firm, appears in the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice and the Court of Appeal, with trials and bail hearings across Ontario.
banks-avocats-montreal:
In Montreal, Banks Avocats handles corporate and commercial law, civil litigation, family law and immigration matters across Quebec. It is led by Maître Jade Banks and is based on Boulevard Henri-Bourassa Ouest in Saint-Laurent.

Its clients range from small start-ups to multinationals, and from individuals to businesses, in English and in French. Business services run from incorporation and contracts to compliance, while the civil law practice covers contract disputes and personal injury. Immigration work includes visa applications, asylum cases, family reunification and employment-based immigration. A guide to opening a business in Quebec is also published for new entrepreneurs.
barapp-law-calgary-personal-injury-lawye:
Barapp Law Calgary Personal Injury Lawyers handles car accident, slip and fall and other injury cases for people in Calgary, Alberta.

The firm serves the Calgary area exclusively and operates as Barapp Law Alberta, a member of the Barapp Law Alliance. Its practice areas cover car accidents, orthopaedic injuries, slip and fall accidents, motorcycle accidents, public transit accidents, pedestrian accidents and dog bite incidents. Each type of injury case is explained in detail, including what a case assessment involves, and the firm is available to injured people at any hour.
barapp-law-firm-and-associates-ottawa:
Barapp Law Firm and Associates is a personal injury practice in Nepean, near Ottawa, also serving Grimsby and Timmins.

The firm is a member of the Barapp Law Alliance and handles car accidents, orthopaedic injuries, slip and fall, motorcycle, public transit and pedestrian cases. Eric Barapp, a graduate of Osgoode Hall Law School, leads a team that also includes Lorne Weinstock, Eti Taylor, Nabeel Sera, Michael Brill, Albert Wong and Aurora Mancuso. Each client has a case manager who stays involved throughout, and fees are payable only if the case succeeds.
barapp-personal-injury-lawyers-toronto-n:
Barapp Personal Injury Law Firm is a Toronto firm handling car accident, slip and fall, pedestrian and public transit injury claims.

The firm is the flagship office of BARAPP Law Alliance and acts for people injured in motorcycle, dog bite and orthopaedic injury incidents across Toronto. The site also explains the steps after an accident, such as getting medical attention and reporting the incident to the relevant authority.
barbarian-law:
Barbarian Law is an Aurora transactional firm handling real estate closings, corporate work, wills and notary services across York Region.

The firm, based at 14981 Yonge Street, assigns one lawyer to each file from start to finish. It handles residential and commercial closings, incorporations, shareholder agreements, mergers and acquisitions, and wills with powers of attorney. A written fee estimate comes before work begins, fees are published online, and invoices follow delivery with no deposit. Its service area includes Aurora, Richmond Hill, Newmarket and Vaughan, and it works in English and Persian. Lawyer Karim Eshqoor also writes commentary on how Canadian law societies regulate law-firm ownership.
barriston-llp:
Barriston LLP is a full-service Barrie firm serving Central Ontario in business, real estate, wills and estates, family law and litigation.

The firm has offices in Barrie, Collingwood, Bracebridge and Huntsville, and more than 40 lawyers. A municipal group acts for municipalities across Central Ontario as well as for developers and landowners. The firm's blog covers legal developments such as a Manitoba court decision on Indigenous self-government in child and family services, procedural questions in Aboriginal title litigation, and the Indian Act's enfranchisement provisions. Community support is also among its activities.
barrou-nadia-montreal:
Barrou Nadia is a Montreal immigration law practice handling temporary visas, permanent residence, sponsorship and citizenship applications.

The firm has worked in Canadian immigration law since 1998, with a team of lawyers and consultants. It acts on applications for foreign students, temporary workers, permanent residents, sponsored family members, visitors and prospective citizens. Work permit routes include labour market impact assessment streams, the International Mobility Program, the Programme de l'expérience québécoise and the regular skilled worker program, along with permanent resident card renewals. Nadia Barrou Avocate Inc. now operates as Barrou Immigration Inc., and the team presents online webinars.
bartlaw-llp:
BARTLAW LLP is a Toronto firm handling Canadian immigration, citizenship and relocation matters for families and corporations.

The firm is a full-service citizenship and immigration practice working from a downtown Toronto office. It assists with applications that allow temporary relocation or permanent immigration to Canada and represents clients in all aspects of cases before the federal immigration and citizenship ministry. It also enables the cross-border transfer of professionals and business people. Jacqueline Bart is a corporate immigration lawyer at the firm, which has a team of other lawyers.
bassili-law-edmonton:
Bassili Law is a remote employment law practice serving clients across Alberta from its Edmonton office.

The firm handles wrongful termination, employment contract review, whistleblower and retaliation claims, severance negotiation, and discrimination and harassment claims. It says working fully online lets it start on a file sooner, without the overhead of a physical office.
batasar-law-brampton:
Batasar Law is a Brampton criminal defence practice led by Gary Batasar, who defends bail, domestic assault, sexual assault and impaired driving charges.

Gary Batasar has practised for more than 28 years, mostly at the Brampton Courthouse and across the GTA, first as a student and then as a lawyer, and has handled more than 20,000 cases. He studied at the University of Toronto and Queen's University and works with Judges, Crown Attorneys and police in Peel Region. Other charges handled include refusing a breathalyzer, dangerous driving and theft, and he also offers media commentary.
batth-law-office-brampton:
Batth Law Office is a Brampton firm handling immigration, family law, wills and estates, criminal defence, real estate and notary services.

As Batth Law Professional Corporation, it serves Brampton, Mississauga, Oakville, Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area and works in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu. Immigration work includes work permits, spousal and family sponsorship, study permits, Express Entry, Visitor and Super Visa applications, and appeals. Notary services cover certified true copies, statutory declarations, affidavits and travel consent letters for minors.
battista-migration-law-group:
Battista Migration Law Group is a Toronto immigration and refugee law firm with a particular focus on the LGBTQ+ community.

The firm has more than 30 years of experience in Canadian immigration law and helps clients who wish to visit, study or move permanently to Canada with their families. It has appeared before the House of Commons and Senate on including same-sex and queer families in the definition of family, and before Parliamentary Standing Committees on removing medical inadmissibility. Articles address LMIA requirements for employers, Express Entry CRS scores and Federal Court decisions on study permit refusals.
bay-view-law-employment-lawyers-kelowna:
Bay View Law Employment Lawyers is a Kelowna firm acting for British Columbia employees in wrongful dismissal, layoff and severance matters. It has offices in Kelowna and Vancouver, and lawyer Aleks Kukolj is named for both.

The firm represents employees in termination, constructive dismissal and layoff disputes, assesses reasonable notice and severance entitlements, and helps negotiate employment arrangements. It also advises on workplace bullying and harassment, discrimination and maternity and parental leave. Vancouver work focuses on dismissals and layoffs among workers in sectors such as technology, hospitality, film and construction.
bayview-law-calgary:
Bayview Law is a Calgary boutique focused on real estate transactions, commercial and corporate matters, and related services.

The firm works closely with real estate agents and mortgage brokers to coordinate transactions, and says every file is handled directly by an experienced lawyer. It offers a flat-fee service for residential purchases in Alberta.
bcf-business-law:
BCF Business Law is a Montreal firm covering taxation, employment, real estate, litigation, financing and mergers and acquisitions. It was founded in 1995 by eight lawyers and has offices in Montreal and Quebec City, plus a presence in Paris for intellectual property.

The firm serves businesses in Quebec, elsewhere in Canada and in Europe. It also operates BCF Global, an international division that assists companies and investors entering Quebec or expanding abroad, and BCF Ventures, a Canadian venture capital fund backed by the firm that invests in early-stage technology start-ups in areas such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and fintech.
bear-creek-law-llp:
Bear Creek Law LLP is a Surrey firm handling civil litigation, criminal defence, business disputes, debt collection and real estate disputes.

The firm avoids restricting its practice to one area, reasoning that judges hear many kinds of cases and that advisers focused on a single field may miss related issues. Its practice areas include white collar crime and civil forfeiture, privacy breaches, contempt of court, defamation, fraud and misrepresentation, collections, negligence and professional malpractice, and real estate and strata disputes. It aims to be its clients' lawyers for life and checks and revises agreements for business clients.
beard-winter-llp:
Beard Winter LLP is a Toronto firm acting in insurance litigation, corporate law, commercial litigation and employment law, and has done so since 1964.

Its insurance practice group acts for local, national and global insurers on accident benefits and Licence Appeal Tribunal matters, professional negligence and errors and omissions, and property and commercial general liability cases. Three members of that group have been appointed to the Ontario Superior Court of Justice. A separate team handles defence-side institutional human rights litigation before the Human Rights Tribunal of Ontario. The firm belongs to the Law Firm Alliance, a network of firms abroad.
beaudry-roussin-avocats-quebec-city:
Beaudry Roussin Avocats, which also uses the name Roussin Langlois, defends criminal, penal and youth protection cases in Quebec City.

Lawyers Myralie Roussin, Alexandre Langlois and Éloïse Marceau act in all judicial districts of Quebec, and Me Roussin and Me Langlois work in French and English. Me Roussin has pleaded defence files since 2011 and was appointed in 2019 as an independent external decision-maker under Bill C-83 on solitary confinement in federal penitentiaries. Me Langlois regularly acts in sexual offence cases involving digital evidence and consent, and in motions to exclude evidence. Fees can be adapted to each client and file, and fixed-fee packages are often used.
beckett-personal-injury-lawyers-london:
Beckett Personal Injury Lawyers is a London, Ontario firm handling car accidents, slip and falls, sexual abuse cases and insurance disputes. The firm has practised since 1999 and works only in personal injury law, including accident benefits, wrongful death, life insurance disputes and long-term disability disputes.

Its partners include Chris Beckett, Rob Talach, Mary-Anne Strong, Dallas Lee, Aaron Lealess, Teri-Ellen Haddy and Chelsea Hishon, and its sexual abuse lawyers act for survivors. The office is on Richmond Street in London.
belecky-and-belecky-london:
Since 1972, Belecky & Belecky has handled real estate, family, wills and estates and corporate work from London, Ontario. Real estate services cover purchases and sales of homes, condominiums and cottages, title transfers, survivorship applications, private and institutional mortgages, and commercial property transactions, and documents can be signed remotely from anywhere.

Al Belecky has practised in Ontario for over 50 years in commercial real estate, business and corporate law. John Belecky has practised since 2010, focusing on residential real estate, wills and estates and family law, including probate, powers of attorney, family contracts and divorce filings. Together the lawyers serve clients across Ontario online and in person.
bell-temple-llp:
Bell Temple LLP is a Toronto litigation firm handling commercial and general litigation, estates litigation, employment disputes and cybersecurity liability.

The firm provides litigation services to insurers and their policyholders and has been appointed counsel in high-profile and precedent-setting cases. Its matters are wide: environmental litigation involving oil spills and leaks, accident benefits and License Appeal Tribunal proceedings, professional negligence, medical malpractice, health discipline, regulatory proceedings and wrongful death. It also advises on privacy, data breach management and post-breach planning. Partners include David A. Tompkins, Brian E. Lucas and Hugh G. Brown, and its lawyers act as trial counsel for multi-party disputes.
bellemare-avocats:
Bellemare Avocats is a Quebec City firm representing injured workers and accident victims in compensation matters before the CNESST, the SAAQ and IVAC. It contests decisions of these bodies before the Tribunal administratif du travail and the Tribunal administratif du Québec.

The practice is led by Marc Bellemare, and the firm has 40 years of experience and also practises in class actions and civil liability in Quebec. It offers percentage-based or flat-fee billing and takes charge of the entire file for each client. The office is at 455 Rue du Marais.
bellissimo-immigration-law-group-pc-toro:
Bellissimo Immigration Law Group PC is a Toronto firm handling immigration, citizenship and refugee matters for individuals and families from around the world.

The firm is one of few remaining law firms in Canada that focus exclusively on citizenship, immigration and refugee law, and its team's experience goes back more than forty-five years. It has been responsible for key court decisions, policy work and publications in the field. Its work includes complex citizenship, immigration and refugee appeals and inadmissibility cases. The firm takes a client-centred approach with plain and transparent communication, and answers common questions about hiring an immigration lawyer in Canada.
benmor-family-law-group:
Benmor Family Law Group is a Toronto family law firm handling divorce, child and spousal support, custody and access, and mediation.

A multi-disciplinary team led by Steve Benmor, a senior divorce lawyer, offers separation and divorce representation, mediation, divorce coaching and parenting coordination. Clients who do not need full representation can book a Divorce Strategy Session for advice at key stages. The firm's work covers parenting plans and schedules, the division of parental responsibilities, and Ontario's equalization of net family property, as well as cohabitation agreements and marriage contracts as ways to protect assets in advance.
bennett-jones-llp:
Bennett Jones LLP is a Toronto business law firm advising on corporate and M&A transactions, litigation, tax and regulatory matters.

Businesses have turned to the firm for complex matters for about a century. Its transactions include KingSett Capital's C$9.4 billion acquisition of First Capital REIT, the acquisition of H&R REIT in a C$6.7 billion deal, Ovintiv's agreement to acquire NuVista Energy, and a C$1 billion Canada Infrastructure Bank financing for the Montréal-Trudeau transformation. It also acted for Canadian Pacific Kansas City in overturning a C$228 million judgment and publishes a quarterly private equity briefing.
bennett-jones-llp-calgary:
Bennett Jones LLP is a business law firm with a Calgary office in Bankers Hall East, handling energy, corporate and M&A, and dispute matters. The firm has served businesses with complex legal matters for the last century, with services that include M&A, litigation, tax and regulatory work.

Its transactions include KKR's joint venture with Enbridge on the Westcoast pipeline system, the acquisition by Apollo funds of a 40% interest in Pembina Gas Infrastructure, Ovintiv's C$3.8 billion acquisition of NuVista Energy, and KingSett Capital's C$9.4 billion acquisition of First Capital REIT. It also acted for Canadian Pacific Kansas City in overturning a C$228 million judgment, and publishes an accessibility plan for its Toronto office.
berard-avocats-montreal:
Bérard Avocats is a Montreal firm handling civil, commercial, real estate and construction law disputes, established in the city in 2016.

Commercial disputes it handles include unpaid invoices and debts, missed deliveries by suppliers, difficulties with commercial leases and whether to incorporate, and early legal advice can reduce the impact of such problems on a business. Its practice areas are civil law, real estate law, construction law and commercial law, and it supports clients from diagnosis through to resolution of a file. The firm also maintains a YouTube channel, and Me Bérard is the lawyer named.
beresh-law-edmonton:
Beresh Law is an Edmonton boutique criminal defence firm founded by Brian A. Beresh, with more than 40 years of legal experience.

The firm describes its work as defending serious and complex cases, with a focus on the protection of civil rights. It serves clients throughout Western Canada.
bergel-magence-guelph:

bergmanis-preyra-llp-toronto:

bernard-brassard-avocats-d-affaires:

bernard-lau-and-co-law-office-richmond:

bernier-fournier-avocats:

bernstein-law-group-personal-injury-lawy:

bessette-avocats-inc-montreal:

bhardwaj-co-family-law-edmonton:

bickhram-litigation-mississauga:

bin-xia-zhang-montreal:

binhimyar-law-group-vancouver:
BinHimyar Law Group is a Vancouver immigration firm covering business and family immigration, temporary visas, refugee matters and citizenship. birdsell-grant-llp-edmonton:
Birdsell Grant LLP is a full-service Edmonton firm with roots in Stony Plain, handling real estate, business, litigation, family and estate law. Alastair Grant and Mike Birdsell began practising together in Stony Plain, Spruce Grove and Parkland County, and the firm has served Alberta since 1984.

bishop-mckenzie-llp:

blake-cassels-graydon-llp:

blake-cassels-graydon-llp-calgary:

blaney-mcmurtry-llp: Blaney McMurtry LLP is a Toronto, Ontario law firm with an office at 2 Queen St E. The firm's office is on Queen Street East in Toronto, Ontario. blfon-personal-injury-lawyer-north-bay:

block-law-edmonton:

blottman-legal-services:

blp-avocats:

blw-injury-law-waterloo:

boghossian-morais-llp-ottawa:

bola-akinnusi-barrie:

bondy-immigration-law-toronto:

borden-ladner-gervais-llp-calgary:

borders-law-firm-toronto:

borja-law-calgary:

borna-law-professional-corporation-north:

boro-polnicky-lighter-montreal: Boro Polnicky Lighter is a law firm in Montreal, Quebec, listed under criminal defence. The office is located at 500 Place d'Armes, Montreal, QC H2Y 2W2. bottos-law-group-edmonton:

boudreau-law-winnipeg:

bouffard-law-office-greater-sudbury:

bourassa-gilbert-avocats: Bourassa Gilbert Avocats is a law office in Sherbrooke, Quebec, with its address at 315 Rue Marquette. bow-river-law-llp-calgary:

brace-law-professional-corporation:

brar-tamber-rigby-badham:

brass-law-office-ottawa:

brazeau-seller-law-ottawa:

brentwood-law-corporation:

brett-mcgarry-criminal-law-ottawa:

briand-s-a-avocats:

bridgepoint-law-kingston:

brij-mohan-and-associates-edmonton:

brisebois-law-office-windsor:

broadhurst-and-kooy-llp-vancouver:

broderick-partners-llp: Broderick & Partners LLP is a law firm in Niagara Falls, Ontario, with an office on Ontario Avenue. bromwich-smith-toronto:

brown-family-law-guelph:

browne-criminal-defence-calgary:

brownlee-llp:

Brownlee, who served as Alberta's fifth head of government, and it publishes case analysis, a practical guide to shareholder disputes and on-demand insurance law webinars for insurance professionals.
bruce-and-birklein-law-calgary:

brum-immigration-ottawa:

brunet-jean-avocat: Brunet Jean Avocat is a family law lawyer in Trois-Rivieres, Quebec, at 190 Rue Bonaventure. bryan-and-company-llp:

brykman-lefler-lawyers-north-york:

bulwark-law-criminal-defence-lawyer-calg:

burnet-duckworth-palmer-llp:

burshtein-law-toronto:

bussey-ainsworth-lawyers-peterborough:

cain-lamarre-chicoutimi:

The firm, formally Charlebois Swanston Gagnon, works in criminal law, statements of offence, youth law, matters before the Commission des transports du Québec, administrative law and pardon applications. It takes emergency matters at any hour, and its defence is rigorous, human and personalized. The office is at 166 Rue Wellington in Gatineau, in the Outaouais region.
cuming-gillespie-llp:
Cuming & Gillespie LLP is a Calgary boutique handling serious personal injury and medical malpractice cases for injured people throughout Alberta.

The firm acts only for people who have suffered serious injury, loss or death caused by someone else's fault, and does not represent defendants, including in medical malpractice matters. Its cases involve motorcycle collisions, pedestrians struck by vehicles, rental e-scooter injuries and social host or bar liability. James Cuming joined the firm in 1995 and became managing partner in 2000, and Craig Gillespie joined in 2000 and became a managing partner in 2007. Its eight lawyers practise only in personal injury and medical malpractice, and the firm acted as counsel in the first class action certified in Alberta.
cunningham-swan-carty-little-bonham-llp:
Cunningham Swan Carty Little & Bonham LLP is a full-service Kingston firm dating to 1894, with over 30 lawyers in 13 practice areas.

The firm serves Southeastern Ontario. Its history is that of two earlier practices that later combined: the Cunningham line, begun by Arthur Cunningham, KC, who operated at 79 Clarence Street for 53 years, and the Swan, Carty, Belch and Ryan line that grew from the practice of David Rankin and Harry Wright after World War II. Later partners include Robert Little, Peter Milliken and David Bonham. The firm's office is on Princess Street in Kingston.
da-silva-legal-north-york:
Da Silva Legal is a family-owned firm whose work is focused on car accident injury claims for clients in Toronto.

The site says the founder was injured in a car accident in 2016 and built the firm around explaining the legal process clearly to people who are unsure what to do next. It describes the firm as a family-owned legal services practice that helps people with serious car accident injuries deal with insurance companies.
dabros-law-ottawa:
Dabros Law is a family-run Ottawa law office handling estates, wills and powers of attorney, residential real estate and personal injury.

The firm serves the greater Ottawa area, including Nepean, Barrhaven, South Keys, Findlay Creek, Orleans, Greely, Manotick and Stittsville. Founder Shane A. Dabros holds a degree from the University of Ottawa and a master's in law from the University of Bristol, grew up in Orleans and names responsiveness as a pillar of his service. Slip and fall and car accident injuries fall under personal injury, and the firm also covers probate and estate administration as well as home purchases, sales and refinancing.
dagenais-maynard-avocats:
Dagenais Maynard Avocats is a Longueuil firm practising criminal law, with an office at 365 Rue Saint-Jean.

The firm appears in the Réseau des professionnels du droit du Québec directory under the Montérégie region. Details are limited to the firm's name, location and criminal defence focus, with no further text on particular offences or courts.
dahlem-criminal-defence-lawyers-calgary:
Dahlem Criminal Defence is a Calgary firm defending people charged with criminal offences in Alberta, with services available in French.

The site explains how criminal cases work in Alberta, including court appearances by video link and online docket appearances. It also lists charges the firm can help with, including computer crime.
dale-streiman-law-brampton:
Dale Streiman Law is a full-service Brampton firm handling family law, real estate, business law, and wills and estates for individuals and companies.
