The practice operates as Dale Streiman Law LLP, or DS Law. Its lawyers draw on years of experience in the GTA, and the team of nine lawyers is supported by law clerks. Appointments are also offered in Toronto, Vaughan, Milton, Oakville, Burlington and Hamilton. The firm's motto is No Nonsense Law, and its guiding test is what a lawyer would tell a sister or brother to do. Elliott Dale and Fred Streiman are among the lawyers, and the firm keeps an eye on costs as well as outcomes.
daniel-a-wolson-winnipeg:
Daniel Wolson is a Winnipeg criminal defence lawyer handling impaired driving, drug, assault, sexual and fraud charges across Manitoba.

He has more than 15 years of courtroom experience, was mentored by Richard J. Wolson, K.C., and brings over 60 years of combined experience to each case. He studied criminal justice at the University of Winnipeg and law at Queen Mary, University of London, then articled at Gindin, Wolson, Simmonds, Roitenberg, where he worked in criminal law for over ten years. In 2021 he co-founded Wolson, Roitenberg, Robinson, Wolson. Areas include driving-related offences, domestic violence and white collar crime, and the office is at 363 Broadway.
daniel-brown-law-llp:
Daniel Brown Law LLP is a Toronto criminal defence firm handling bail hearings, trials and appeals in courts across Ontario.

Founded in 2005, the firm defends charges such as sexual assault, impaired driving, fraud, drug, assault, weapons and domestic assault offences, and also advises before charges are laid. Its work follows the stages of an Ontario prosecution, from arrest and bail to disclosure, Crown pre-trial and preliminary inquiry, and publishes articles on topics such as care or control and refusal offences in impaired driving law.
daniel-partners-llp:
Daniel & Partners LLP handles personal injury, corporate, estates, insurance, employment and administrative law matters in St. Catharines.

The firm's history reaches back to 1922, and it also offers real estate and municipal law. Its administrative law practice involves appearances before bodies such as the Ontario Land Tribunal, the Normal Farm Practices Protection Board, the License Appeals Tribunal, the Human Rights Tribunal and Canada Pension Plan appeal tribunals, as well as court challenges to an unfavourable tribunal decision. Lawyers in that area are Sarah J. Draper, Terrence H. Hill, Lucianna S. Saplywy and Callum Shedden. The office is on Fourth Avenue.
danson-delavar-llp-toronto:
Toronto litigation boutique Danson Delavar LLP handles high-stakes commercial, employment, constitutional, defamation and insurance disputes. Partners Timothy Danson and Marjan Delavar bring decades of courtroom experience to these matters and focus on identifying risk early, before disputes escalate.

Core practice areas are corporate, commercial and civil litigation, employment law, constitutional law, insurance litigation and defamation litigation. The practice also includes complex personal injury litigation, appellate advocacy, administrative law, sports law and professional negligence. Clients include corporations, professionals, executives, insurers and professional athletes.
daryl-royer-criminal-defence-lawyer-edmo:
Daryl Royer Criminal Defence is an Edmonton practice with more than 20 years of criminal defence experience.

The site says the lawyer has been involved in over 90 reported cases and more than 50 appeals, and has represented clients in criminal courts across several Canadian provinces and territories. Its areas include murder and attempted murder, sexual offences and assault charges.
das-law-north-york: Das Law is a general practice law firm in North York, Ontario. The office is at 200, 5700 Yonge Street, 2nd Floor, North York, Ontario M2M 7K2. The firm is listed under general practice, which points to work across several everyday areas of law rather than a single field. Further details about its lawyers and services are not currently available.
david-edmunds-avocat:
David Edmunds Avocat is a criminal defence lawyer based in Trois-Rivieres, Quebec, at 1350 Rue Royale, suite 1403.

Criminal defence is the recorded practice area, and no additional services, courts or languages are on record. The entry is limited to his name, address and criminal defence focus. The French title avocat is the Quebec term for lawyer.
david-genis-north-york:
Criminal lawyer David Genis defends impaired driving, assault, drug and other charges from his North York office. He also appears as an immigration lawyer in matters before the Immigration Appeal Division and the Federal Court of Canada.

He graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School, articled with a Toronto criminal defence firm and appears in the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court and the Court of Appeal for Ontario. Clients speak English, Mandarin, Cantonese, Russian and Ukrainian, and most appear in Toronto, Newmarket or Brampton courts. Charges handled include over 80 mg, refuse sample, dangerous driving, sexual offences, thefts, frauds and domestic assault. He belongs to the Criminal Lawyers Association.
david-hollingsworth-and-associates-ottaw:
David Hollingsworth and Associates is an Ottawa personal injury firm acting for people hurt in motorcycle crashes, slips and falls and dog bites.

Its practice areas include animal attacks and dog bites, assaults and sexual assault, boat accidents, child injury, disability matters, motorcycle accidents, product liability, slip and fall accidents and train accidents. On dog bites, the firm addresses Ontario's Dog Owners' Liability Act and who is responsible when a dog injures someone. Its injury lawyers will travel to a client's home, hospital or rehabilitation centre anywhere in eastern Ontario.
davidson-cahill-morrison-llp:
Davidson Cahill Morrison LLP is a Toronto litigation boutique handling insurance law, medical malpractice, personal injury, municipal litigation and appeals.

The firm has offices in Toronto, Huntsville and Bowmanville and acts for clients across Ontario. Its partners include lawyers designated by the Law Society of Ontario in civil litigation, and other lawyers retain it to argue their appeals. Because it acts on both sides of injury and insurance cases, the firm understands how a case is built, valued and defended. Jim Davidson is among its trial counsel.
davies-ward-phillips-vineberg-llp:
Davies Ward Phillips & Vineberg LLP is a Toronto law firm focused on high-stakes matters, with cross-border capability and international reach.

The firm is a true partnership that works across geographies, practices and industries. Its representative work includes Brookfield's C$1.6 billion acquisition of Gregg Distributors, Plenary Americas' C$1.2 billion take-private of Information Services Corporation, and Agnico Eagle's C$3.8 billion consolidation of assets in Lapland, Finland. Diversity and inclusion and pro bono work are also part of the firm's activities.
davylaw-north-york:
DavyLaw is a North York practice handling real estate, wills and estates, business and immigration matters across Toronto and the GTA. It also takes on family and franchise work and provides notary services, along with a check of documents before signing, such as agreements of purchase and sale, status certificates and commercial leases.

Irina Davydova studied law at City, University of London, and has experience in real estate law, particularly mortgage matters, having once managed a boutique mortgage brokerage. She also acts on commercial matters and offers immigration services. The firm works in English and Russian, supports virtual signing, offers after-hours and weekend appointments, and provides a land transfer tax calculator that accounts for first-time homebuyer rebates.
day-borg-llp-mississauga:
Established in 1980, Day + Borg LLP practises business, real estate, family and estate law from Streetsville in Mississauga.

The practice has stayed in the Village of Streetsville, moving in 1989 and again in 1994 to its current office on Queen Street South, and it now employs 14 staff. Business clients include corporations, entrepreneurs, emerging companies, controlling shareholders, management buy-out groups and boards of directors. The real estate group handles title searches, residential and commercial purchases and sales, and secured and unsecured mortgage lending, while the estates group prepares wills, family trusts and powers of attorney.
de-bakker-law-thunder-bay:
de Bakker Law is a Thunder Bay firm handling real estate, wills and estates, criminal, civil litigation, corporate and immigration matters.

The practice has represented Thunder Bay for over 40 years, and its services also include medical malpractice. Deborah de Bakker practises wills, estates and real estate alongside her son. She is a lifelong Thunder Bay resident with a B.A. from Queen's University and an LL.B. from Osgoode Hall Law School, a member of the Law Society of Ontario and the Thunder Bay Law Association, and a past member of the federal Judicial Appointments Advisory Committee. The team also includes Vlad Popescu, Jennifer Hay, Jessica Macaulay and Carly Deboni.
de-bousquet-pc:
De Bousquet PC is an Oakville-listed firm handling employment law, wrongful dismissal and civil litigation for employees and employers.

The firm works on severance pay, termination without cause, constructive dismissal, unpaid wages, overtime and employment classification, and also advises on estate planning. It serves Toronto, Etobicoke, Mississauga, Hamilton and the wider Greater Toronto Area, and can represent clients in both official languages. Jean-Alexandre De Bousquet is a lawyer active in human rights law. The firm offers extended business hours and flexible billing arrangements, and publishes blog posts on topics such as minimum wage and workplace vaccination policies.
de-krupe-law-north-york:
De Krupe Law is a North York firm handling real estate closings, mortgage refinancing, wills and estates, corporate, family and litigation matters.

The firm has offices in Toronto, Newmarket, Vaughan and Barrie, and also serves Mississauga. It offers flat-rate pricing, after-hours and weekend appointments, and in-person meetings Monday to Saturday as well as online meetings. It has handled more than 1,000 cases and 3,000 transactions, and clients work directly with their assigned lawyer. The team includes Stan Aranush de Krupe, Eva Aranush de Krupe, Anthony Galasso and Julieta Daniel.
deborah-todd-law-corporation:
Deborah Todd Law Corporation is a Victoria family law firm handling divorce, custody, mediation, negotiation and estate planning.

Deborah Todd has practised family law, wills and estates in Victoria for over 40 years. Practice areas are mediation, negotiation, collaborative law, litigation, and wills and estates, with prenuptial agreements and divorce also handled. Appointments are held by video conference or by audio link, including witnessing of some documents. A profile draws on an interview with Ageless Living Magazine about balancing her career and fitness.
decarie-stephenson-avocats:
Decarie Stephenson Avocats is a Gatineau practice offering civil and commercial mediation and arbitration, led by Me Sophie-Anne Décarie.

She has nearly 30 years of litigation practice and devotes much of her work to private dispute resolution. Services include mediation, arbitration, med-arb, negotiation and facilitation for individuals, lawyers, businesses and organizations. Disputes covered include hidden defects, servitudes, encroachments, property boundaries, rights of way, neighbour disturbances, co-ownership, construction defects and conflicts between buyers, sellers, brokers or notaries. The approach is built on preparation, neutrality, risk analysis and proportionality, and published articles address topics such as bailiff visits and flooded apartments.
delaney-s-law-firm:
Delaney's Law Firm is an Ottawa practice handling real estate, family law, personal injury and wills and estates matters.

Bryan Delaney founded the firm in 2006, after his first year of practice, and has handled thousands of real estate transactions and appeared before tribunals and courts across Ontario. Real estate work covers residential closings as well as commercial leases, acquisitions, liens, title defects, severances and OMB hearings. The lawyers include Andreia Granja, Jessica Surla, Dakota Damboise, Rosana Yaworski and Jason Benwell, and the firm is in downtown Ottawa.
demas-schaefer-family-lawyers-edmonton:
Demas Schaefer Family Lawyers is an Edmonton family law firm handling divorce, separation, property division and adoption, serving Northern Alberta.

Its lawyers have appeared at all levels of court in Alberta and treat litigation as one tool among several, tailoring a strategy to each client's situation and goals. The team includes lawyers, legal assistants and paralegals. Published articles address practical questions such as how long a divorce takes in Alberta and how support figures are calculated.
demelo-heathcote-london:
DeMelo Heathcote is a London, Ontario criminal defence firm handling Criminal Code, drug and provincial offences, plus appeals, across Southwestern Ontario.

Cassandra DeMelo founded the firm in 2014 and Katie Heathcote became a partner in 2022; the firm now has fourteen people. Other lawyers include Shayne Stroud and Adriana D'Arpino. Its practice covers domestic charges, possession for the purpose of trafficking, regulatory and by-law matters, and appellate work up to the Supreme Court of Canada. Service is offered in English, French, Portuguese and Spanish, and the office is on Colborne Street in London.
denham-law-office:
Denham Law Office is a Kamloops law firm listed under real estate, with an office at 520 Chief Eli Larue Way, Suite 211.

The firm practises real estate law in Kamloops, British Columbia. Its recorded information is limited to its name, its Kamloops address and its real estate practice area, and no further details about its lawyers, services or approach are available.
dentons-canada-llp:
Dentons Canada LLP is a Toronto, Ontario law firm with a full-service, cross-border practice and an office at 77 King St W, Suite 400.

The firm's office is on King Street West in Toronto. No further details about its lawyers, offices or matters are on record, so this entry is limited to its name, address and practice description.
dentons-canada-llp-calgary:
Dentons Canada LLP is a Calgary firm with energy and corporate and M&A practices, at 850 2 St SW, Bankers Court.

The office is in the Bankers Court building on 2 St SW in Calgary. No further detail on its lawyers, history or approach is available. The listing is limited to the firm's name, city, address and practice areas in Alberta.
deol-and-nagpal-law-firm-llp-brampton:
In Brampton, Deol & Nagpal Law Firm LLP serves the GTA in real estate, criminal, family, immigration and civil litigation matters. The firm was founded by Birdavinder Singh Deol in partnership with Amanpreet Singh Nagpal. Its real estate practice covers purchases and sales of houses and condos, mortgages and refinancing, property transfers and taxes, and title insurance.

Criminal work includes bail, assault, theft, drug offences, impaired driving, fraud and youth criminal justice matters. The firm also acts in family law and spousal sponsorship, business law, powers of attorney, wills and estates, immigration and notary services, working from an office on Maritime Ontario Boulevard.
derek-wilson-hamilton-personal-injury-an:
Derek Wilson is a Hamilton lawyer who handles personal injury and long-term disability cases, including car, truck, motorcycle and pedestrian accidents.

He has practised personal injury and insurance litigation since 1995, handles every file himself and keeps a limited caseload. His education includes an LL.B. from the University of Alberta, an LL.M. in civil litigation from the London School of Economics and a Harvard mediation certificate from 2025, and he spent much of his career dealing with insurance companies from both sides. Service areas include traumatic brain injury, spinal injury and slip and fall cases for clients in Hamilton, Burlington, Niagara Falls, Brantford and Kitchener.
desaulniers-avocats:
Desaulniers Avocats is a Rimouski criminal and family law practice associated with the firm Bérubé Lambert Avocates.

Bérubé Lambert Avocates was founded in 2005 and has acted for more than 15 years, with lawyers practising criminal and family law in Rimouski and defending clients from Rivière-du-Loup to the Îles-de-la-Madeleine. Criminal matters include vehicle-related offences and offences against the person. Its values are rigour, honesty and integrity.
deutschmann-de-koning-law-kitchener:
Deutschmann de Koning Law is a Kitchener firm that represents people hurt in accidents and people whose disability benefits have been denied.

The firm was founded in 1995 and was previously known as Deutschmann Law. Founding partner Rob Deutschmann and partner Nick de Koning lead a team that also includes Alexander David and Brenda Hicks. The firm has served clients across Southwestern Ontario, and its service area includes Waterloo, Cambridge, Brantford, Guelph, Milton, Woodstock and Tillsonburg. Topics covered include car accident matters and notice letters to municipalities.
dfs-kaneski-unruh-llp-winnipeg:
DFS Kaneski UnRuh LLP is a Winnipeg firm with corporate and commercial, civil litigation and family law groups, formed by a merger in January 2023.

The merger joined Deeley Fabbri Sellen LLP, created by its founding partners in 1979, and BD Oakes Jardine Kaneski UnRuh LLP, whose history the firm traces to 1974 and which acquired Tupper & Adams, regarded as Manitoba's oldest firm. Its civil litigation group represents clients at all levels of court, from Small Claims to the Court of Appeal. The family law group handles negotiation, litigation, collaboration, arbitration, mediation and independent legal advice, and the firm serves Manitoba and Northwest Ontario.
dhasi-law-family-lawyer-brampton-brampto:
Dhasi Law is a Brampton firm serving Ontario clients in personal injury, immigration, criminal law, civil litigation, estates and real estate.

Practice areas are personal injury, immigration, criminal law, civil litigation, notary public, wills, estates and trusts, real estate, corporate law and family law. For injuries caused by negligence, the firm pursues compensation for medical expenses and lost income. Immigration work covers applications, permits and sponsorships for individuals and families, and the criminal practice supports clients facing charges through the court process. The office is on Mayfield Road in Brampton.
dhillon-murthi-law-p-c-mississauga:
Dhillon Murthi Law is a Mississauga, Ontario practice listed for family law and real estate matters.

Its office is on Tranmere Drive in Mississauga, and the firm is recorded in Ontario as a professional corporation. Its practice areas are family law and real estate, and no further detail about its lawyers, services or approach is available.
dhiman-law-professional-corporation-otta:
Dhiman Law Professional Corporation is an Ottawa general practice firm handling family law and real estate matters.

Founder and principal lawyer Inderjit Dhiman is qualified to practise in both India and Canada and is a member of the Law Society of Ontario. The firm serves Barrhaven, Kanata, Nepean, Manotick, Orleans, Greely, Osgoode and Riverside South, along with Brampton and Mississauga, offers virtual meetings, and speaks Punjabi and Hindi. Its family law practice concerns separation and the interests of families, and its real estate practice the careful handling of closings for buyers moving into a new home.
diamond-and-diamond-lawyers-edmonton:
Diamond and Diamond Lawyers runs an Edmonton office for personal injury cases, from motor vehicle accidents to medical malpractice.

The firm has experience across the full range of personal injury matters, including other accidents, injuries, misdiagnosis and diagnostic errors, birth and obstetric injury, and treatment errors. It also helps families with estate administration, applications and litigation. The firm has offices in Ontario, including Toronto, Barrie, Kitchener, London, Ottawa, Sudbury, Timmins and Windsor, as well as in Alberta.
dietrich-law-office-kitchener:
Dietrich Law Office is a Kitchener firm that represents injured people and those seeking disability benefits in Waterloo Region and nearby areas.

The lawyers serve Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, the GTA, Brant and Oxford. The personal injury lawyers follow changes to motor vehicle accident legislation and the law of negligence, and the disability lawyers work with orthopaedic, psychological, chronic pain and fibromyalgia diagnoses. The firm pays attention to treatment and medication needs and to income replacement, and its practice is limited to personal injury and disability law.
dimic-law-calgary:
Dimic Law is a Calgary business and corporate law firm that also handles civil litigation, real estate, and wills and estates. The office is in Macleod Plaza on 94 Avenue SE.

Corporate services include incorporations under Alberta's Business Corporations Act, shareholder and non-disclosure agreements, and advice on equity and debt financing for small businesses. The firm also provides notary public and commissioner for oaths services and acts for both Legal Aid and private clients. The team includes associate lawyer Moremi Adekunle, law clerk Kay Penaflorida and student-at-law Kathleen Lee.
dimitri-trofimoff-lawyer-ottawa:
Dimitri Trofimoff Lawyer is an Ottawa practice handling family law and criminal defence, with offices serving Ottawa, Kanata and Perth.

On the criminal side, the practice represents clients from police interaction and bail hearings through negotiation with prosecutors, judicial pre-trial and trial in Ontario courts. Its family work covers anything from a simple divorce to a complicated separation. The office also provides certification of copies, witnessing of signatures, commissioning of oaths, and travel and invitation letters. It has three locations in the region and offers virtual meetings, and Dimitri Trofimoff was educated in Russia, England and Ontario.
dionne-avocats-boucherville-brossard:
Based in Brossard, Dionne Avocats Boucherville is a family law practice handling divorce, separation, child custody and child support.

The practice also covers access rights, whether through negotiation, amicable agreements or before the courts, and handles criminal and penal matters. Services are offered remotely to clients across Quebec, and the lawyers travel throughout the greater Montreal area. Topics addressed include how a custody application proceeds in Quebec and whether a support payment or an existing judgment can be changed.
diversitas-law-group-london:
Diversitas Law Group is a London, Ontario association of independent practitioners handling immigration, citizenship and refugee protection matters.

The group is not a law firm, partnership or limited liability company: each sole practitioner runs a separate practice, shares office space and administrative resources, and holds the solicitor-client relationship personally. Its practitioners have more than thirty years of combined experience and offer service in Arabic, Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu. Its work covers immigration, refugee and citizenship appeals, including reconsideration, residency obligation appeals and responses to various immigration refusals.
dla-piper-canada-llp:
DLA Piper (Canada) LLP is the Toronto office of a global law firm with lawyers in over 40 countries.

The firm advised Realty Income on its EUR1.078 billion joint venture with KKR and IntraBio on its US$2.0 billion acquisition by Shionogi. It publishes material on the changing landscape of AI laws and regulations and on sports ownership. Sustainability, pro bono work and global leadership are part of its profile, with Frank Ryan, Charles Severs and Loren Brown named. The Toronto location is at 333 Bay St.
dlegal-law-office-wills-calgary:
DLegal Law Office: Wills is a Calgary practice handling wills and estate planning, family matters, real estate transactions and business law.

The firm offers everyday legal services for everyday needs, supporting Calgary families through each stage of life. It publishes its flat fees, because transparency and predictability matter to its clients. Lawyer and notary Anna Dunaeva leads the practice, which also carries resources on the roles of executors and estate trustees and on the Estate Administration Act in Alberta. The firm serves on community boards and teaches seminars around Calgary.
dng-law-ottawa:
DNG Law, also known as Daniel Nassrallah Law Office, handles real estate, wills and estates and business law in Ottawa. Its real estate work covers residential and commercial purchases, sales and refinancing, including title transfers and closing documents, for first-time buyers and investors alike.

Other practice areas are powers of attorney, elder abuse and long-term care matters, and commercial tenancies, corporate and business law. The office on Holly Lane serves individuals, families and businesses in Ottawa and surrounding communities.
doak-shirreff-lawyers-llp:
Doak Shirreff Lawyers LLP is a Kelowna full-service firm handling business, employment, construction, civil litigation, family and personal injury matters.

The firm has been based in Kelowna since 1968 and serves individuals and businesses throughout the Okanagan Valley and across British Columbia, and it has marked fifty years in practice. Services include charities and not-for-profit work, civil and commercial litigation, construction law and real estate. Its employment group acts for both employees and employers, and its approach is practical, approachable and cost effective.
dolgin-family-law-ottawa:
Dolgin Family Law is an Ottawa family practice led by Jeremy Dolgin, who acts for clients in Ottawa, elsewhere in Ontario and abroad.

He has practised family law for almost thirty years since graduating from the University of Toronto Faculty of Law in 1997. He represents clients at the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice and the Ontario Court of Appeal. He is a trained mediator and a founding member of the collaborative law network of Ottawa, and many of his files are settled through non-adversarial processes. Gabriel Bidner is also on the team. The office is on Somerset Street West.
dominion-criminal-defence-london:
Dominion Criminal Defence is a boutique London, Ontario firm practising only criminal law across London, Kitchener, Brantford and Guelph.

It was founded by lawyer Phillip P. Dinis and licensed paralegal Dallas Thompson, and the team includes Christina Hamp and legal clerk Madison Thompson. Its areas include impaired driving, assault and domestic assault, sexual offences and youth criminal law. It also represents clients in Woodstock and Cambridge, its lawyers have appeared at every level of court in Ontario, including the Court of Appeal, and an urgent line is answered at all hours. The office is in downtown London.
donald-kehler-law-office-brandon:
Donald & Kehler Law Office is a Brandon firm serving South Western Manitoba in real estate, corporate and commercial, family, and wills and estate law.

Formerly known as Donald Legal Services, the firm has operated since 1994 and treats personal service as a hallmark. Its real estate work covers acquisitions, financing and disposition of residential, commercial and agricultural property. Family matters can proceed through the court system or alternative dispute resolution such as mediation and collaborative family law. Other areas are civil litigation, employment and labour law, notaries public and alternative dispute resolution, and a Manitoba land transfer tax calculator is available.
dosanjh-ladner-arora-vancouver:
Dosanjh Ladner Arora is a Vancouver trial law firm handling family law, civil litigation, personal injury and insurance disputes. The firm, formerly Dosanjh Law Group, traces its practice to 1979, when Ujjal Dosanjh opened it in Vancouver; he later served as Attorney General of British Columbia and as federal Minister of Health.

His sons Aseem and Pavel Dosanjh became partners after being called to the bar in 2001 and 2002, and Aseem has served as president of the Trial Lawyers Association of British Columbia. Paul Ladner joined as an articling student in 2014 and became a partner in 2018. The practice also takes on professional misconduct and police misconduct matters.
doyon-avocats:
Doyon Avocats is a criminal and penal law firm serving Quebec City and Montreal, handling trials and appeals in complex cases.

The firm acts at every stage, from arrest and bail hearings to trial, sentencing and appeal. Each lawyer practises on their own account under a common banner, sharing strategy and resources, and the firm also advises other defence lawyers and works with a network of correspondents across Quebec. Topics covered include impaired driving, sexual assault matters, defamation on social media and discharges to avoid a criminal record. It reports an acquittal at the Quebec Court of Appeal and conference talks by Me Doyon and Me Pelletier, and the Quebec City office is on Boulevard Jean-Lesage.
dr-injury-and-disability-law-north-york: DR Injury & Disability Law is a personal injury and disability law firm in North York, Ontario. It acts for people across the province in car accident, slip and fall, serious injury and long-term disability matters. The office is on Yonge Street in North York, in the Toronto area, and personal injury is its main practice area.
droit-ouimet-mcpherson-law-ottawa:
Droit Ouimet-McPherson Law is an Ottawa boutique firm offering real estate, business law, estate planning and estate administration in English and French.

Its owner, Marc, was raised in Ottawa, holds an LL.B. from the University of Ottawa's French common law program and founded the firm in 2020 after practising in Orléans and Rockland. The firm limits itself to no more than 25 transactions a month, uses secure online forms alongside virtual and in-person meetings, and prepares documents for probate applications. It also offers executor services at 4.0 percent of the estate value, subject to a minimum.
dtb-avocats-inc-montreal:
Founded in January 2019, DTB Avocats is a Montreal firm working in immigration, business law, civil and commercial litigation and mediation.

Clients are national and international, and the firm favours out-of-court dispute resolution, appearing when needed before the civil and commercial divisions of the Superior Court and the Court of Quebec, the Immigration and Refugee Board and the Federal Court of Canada. Contract law is also part of the practice. The team works in French, English, Poular and Wolof from an office on Chemin de la Côte-des-Neiges.
du-plooy-law-calgary:
Du Plooy Law is a Calgary business law firm practising corporate law and international business law.

The firm's work includes business reorganization and structuring. Its site includes guidance on protecting brands and intellectual property for hospitality businesses, and says it explains legal matters and potential outcomes in plain English.
duboff-edwards-schachter-law-corporation:
Duboff Edwards Schachter Law Corporation is a downtown Winnipeg firm offering civil litigation, corporate, real estate, family and employment law.

The firm has served clients for over 25 years. Its practice traces to Neil Duboff, who was later joined by partners Harley Schachter and Paul Edwards, all of whom left larger firms to build a smaller one. Practice areas also include administrative and regulatory law, class actions, alternative dispute resolution, entertainment law, and Indigenous and constitutional law. The firm's work for government and Indigenous groups has produced landmark rulings, and its office is on Carlton Street.
duclos-societe-d-avocats:
Duclos Société d'Avocats is a Gatineau law firm covering civil law, real estate and construction law, family law and labour law. The firm has been established in the Outaouais for more than 30 years and is located in downtown Gatineau.

A multidisciplinary team advises and represents large companies needing legal services as well as individuals and local businesses, with knowledge of the legal scene, the business community and regional and national policy issues. The office is at 139 Boulevard de l'Hôpital, Suite 127.
dudzic-peter-hamilton:
Residential real estate and mortgages are the main work of Peter Dudzic Law, a Hamilton practice.

Peter Dudzic, B.A., LL.B., earned his law degree at the University of New Brunswick after a Bachelor of Arts at the University of Western Ontario, and was called to the bar in 1994. He has practised in Hamilton since then and is a member of the Hamilton Law Association. The office handles the sale and purchase of resale properties and new and refinanced mortgages. It is in the Lime Ridge Office Complex on Hamilton Mountain, across from Lime Ridge Mall, and is wheelchair accessible.
duke-law-firm-etobicoke:
Real estate, business and wills and estates work in Etobicoke is the focus of Duke Law Firm, based in Toronto's west end.

Marko Djukic leads the practice. A graduate of Osgoode Hall Law School, he finished the Schulich School of Business with distinction and worked in financial services before becoming a lawyer. The firm acts for individuals and small businesses and for national and international clients, including on probate. It bills by task, with the same fees for everyone and no hidden fees or disbursements, so clients have cost certainty.
dumoulin-boskovich-llp-vancouver:
DuMoulin Boskovich LLP is a Vancouver law firm, also in Kelowna and Vernon, handling personal injury, family, corporate and real estate matters. Founded in 1972 by Joe Boskovich and Tony DuMoulin, it acts for local, provincial, national and international clients.

Joe Boskovich built a clientele of fishermen, boat owners and fish processors and became a qualified mediator in 1985, while Tony DuMoulin brought strength in real estate, commercial transactions and wills and estates. Today the firm also handles estate litigation, employment law, catastrophic injury, debt collection, strata fee collection and proceedings under the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act.
duncan-and-associates:
Duncan and Associates is a Prince George firm handling criminal, family, civil litigation and real estate matters for clients across Northern British Columbia.

The firm has served Prince George and Northern BC for more than ten years. Jon Duncan practises general law, including criminal, civil and family matters, and Jennifer Reid works in criminal and family law and mental health law. Mohammad Hajivandi handles criminal, civil, immigration and regulatory matters, and the team also includes David Duncan, Hazem Osso and Colson Witten. Its articles cover child support guidelines and legal liability for artificial intelligence.
duncan-craig-llp:
Duncan Craig LLP is an Edmonton full-service firm handling wills and estates, real estate, business, family and litigation matters since 1894. It was founded by William Short, Edmonton's first mayor, and Charles Cross, Alberta's first Attorney General.

Practice areas include business law, real estate transactions, estate planning, family law, employment law, personal injury, litigation and mediation, with offices in Edmonton and Drayton Valley. The firm moved in 1909 to the Merchant's Bank Building, close to its current base at Rice Howard Place, and supports a community giving committee, a community fund and a community service prize in law.
dunlap-criminal-defence-lawyer-edmonton-:
Dunlap Criminal Defence is an Edmonton firm led by Timothy Dunlap, who defends sexual assault, sexual interference and domestic violence allegations.

Mr. Dunlap has more than thirty years of experience and has handled over three thousand trials. Services extend across Alberta, including Calgary, Grande Prairie and Fort McMurray. The firm's process starts with guidance on what to do after a charge, including knowing your rights and staying silent. Fees are arranged under a contingency fee arrangement, and questions about fees and areas served are addressed in a frequently asked questions section.
durno-and-shea-professional-corporation-:
Founded in 1974, Durno & Shea Professional Corporation is a boutique firm in Toronto focused on residential real estate and estate law. Founding partners Robert Durno and Michael Shea began as a full-service practice covering everything from criminal law to real estate before narrowing to real estate and estate planning. Services include purchases, sales, refinancing, assignments, new construction and status certificates.

On the estate side the firm prepares wills and powers of attorney, assists with estate administration and offers notary and commissioner services. It handles assignment transactions, in which an original buyer transfers an agreement of purchase and sale to another buyer, most often for pre-built homes and condominiums. Shannon Durno is among its lawyers, and the office is in Scarborough on Ellesmere Road.
dutton-brock-llp:
Dutton Brock LLP is a Toronto insurance litigation firm handling coverage disputes, accident benefits and other complex insurance matters.

The firm has operated for over 40 years, and its work spans the full range of insurance litigation. Its lawyers also act as mediators and arbitrators in insurance disputes. Paul Tushinski, admitted to the Ontario bar in 1985, has argued cases on products liability, insurance coverage, class proceedings and hospital liability and served as managing partner from 2002 to 2018. Philippa G. Samworth practises insurance defence in accident benefits and was retained by Ontario's Ministry of Finance on Bill 59 and designated assessment centre matters.
east-law-hamilton:
Criminal defence is all that East Law does in Hamilton, where it acts for people charged with drug, driving, violent and weapons offences. The firm litigates exclusively in criminal law and acts only for people who have been charged or have reason to believe that charges are pending.

Its practice covers drug offences, property offences, driving offences, violent offences, impaired driving and DUI charges, and weapons or firearms offences. John East is the lawyer behind the firm, and the office is located on Main Street East in Hamilton, Ontario.
eb-personal-injury-lawyer-hamilton:
Injuries from car, motorcycle, pedestrian and slip and fall accidents are the focus of EB Personal Injury Lawyer in Hamilton. The firm, based in Stoney Creek, also acts in dog bite, traumatic brain, spinal cord, orthopaedic and public transit injury cases, and serves Stoney Creek, Brockville and Stratford as a member of the BARAPP Law Alliance.

Each injured client is assigned a case manager, and support is offered around the clock. Personal injury cases are handled on a contingency basis, so no fees are payable unless the case succeeds.
ebpc-personal-injury-lawyer-ottawa:
EBPC Personal Injury Lawyer is a personal injury firm with an Ottawa-area office in Gloucester, also serving Fergus, London and Belleville.

The firm is a member of the Barapp Law Alliance and handles car accidents, orthopaedic injuries, slip and fall, motorcycle and public transit cases. Lorne Weinstock holds a psychology degree from York University and a law degree from Windsor, and was admitted to the Law Society of Upper Canada in 2002. He handles spinal and brain injuries from motor vehicle accidents and occupiers' liability cases. Fees are payable only if the case succeeds.
edh-law-peterborough:
EDH Law is a general practice in Peterborough and Bradford covering real estate, wills, family, immigration and corporate law.

Formally Evans de Vries Higgins LLP, the firm is the successor to Evans & Evans, established in Bradford in 1894, and to the Peterborough practice of Douglas F. Walker, which has served the Kawarthas since 1974. Robert Evans, Jenivieve de Vries and Nathan Higgins merged their practices in April 2015, and Robert Evans retired at the end of 2019. The firm acts for buyers and sellers in mortgage and title matters, offers notarizing and commissioning, and holds original wills and powers of attorney prepared by lawyers of both earlier practices.
edmonton-criminal-lawyer-ziv-edmonton:
Edmonton Criminal Lawyer Ziv is the Ziv Law Group, a criminal defence practice handling assault, drug, theft, fraud and impaired driving charges in Edmonton.

Rory Ziv has practised criminal defence since his admission to the Alberta Bar in 2005 and founded the firm in Edmonton in 2011. His practice includes homicide, sexual assault, impaired driving, major fraud and drug offences. The work is organized into financial offences, assault, possession and trafficking, theft, serious offences and driving offences, and the firm serves Edmonton along with Fort Saskatchewan, Leduc, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, St. Albert and Drayton Valley.
edmonton-law-office-edmonton:
Edmonton Law Office is a downtown Edmonton firm handling family law, divorce, real estate, immigration, civil litigation and wills and estates.

Belal Najmeddine founded the firm in 2018 and practises in family law, real estate and wills and estates. The office is on 107 Street at 101 Avenue, and the team serves the Greater Edmonton community. In family law, clients choose between negotiation and litigation under federal and Alberta legislation. The firm aims to build long-term relationships with clients and to keep legal services cost-effective.
edmonton-top-law-edmonton:
Edmonton Top Law is a litigation-focused family law firm founded in 2024, representing individuals and businesses in family, civil and commercial matters.

Majd Mouzaffar, a litigation lawyer, focuses on complex family and civil disputes. The firm says it uses negotiation and mediation where appropriate and is ready to go to court when necessary, and its listed languages are English, Arabic and French.
eidelmann-law-inc-montreal:
Eidelmann Law Inc is a bilingual Montreal litigation boutique handling business, real estate, labour, debt collection and civil matters.

Founded by Me Adam Eidelmann, a litigator who also runs a business, the firm weighs the economic consequences of a legal strategy before recommending it. Its contract work falls under the Civil Code of Quebec, including drafting, analysis and enforcement when a deal breaks down. Service is offered in English and French to a local and international clientele from its office on Boulevard Decarie. The firm is deliberately small, with the founder handling every file.
einfeld-law-kelowna:
Einfeld Law is a Kelowna civil litigation and personal injury firm acting in lawsuits, estate disputes and employment matters. It acts for individuals and businesses in civil lawsuits in the Okanagan and beyond, including contract disputes, insurance disputes, property disputes and matters involving municipalities.

Business litigation includes breach of contract, negligence, lease disputes, builders liens and product liability. Estate work covers contested wills, wills variation, trust litigation and executor disputes, with arbitration and mediation available, and employment work covers wrongful dismissal and severance. Injury cases arise from negligence such as slips and falls and unsafe property; the firm does not act on ICBC motor vehicle injury cases.
el-asmar-legal-edmonton:
El-Asmar Legal is an Edmonton firm handling immigration, refugee and human rights law with a trauma-informed approach to client work. The practice was established in 2010 by Jouman El-Asmar, who is licensed in Quebec and Alberta.

The firm appears before the Immigration and Refugee Board and the Federal Court of Canada. Work covers asylum and humanitarian applications, PRRA, sponsorships, Express Entry, provincial nominee programs, work, study and visitor permits, LMIA and Super Visa applications, and appeals. It also acts in discrimination and employment matters before human rights commissions and tribunals.
el-haddad-avocats:
El-Haddad, Avocats is a Laval criminal defence firm handling drug, weapons, assault, fraud, cybercrime and driving offences. The team defends clients through each step of the criminal justice process.

The practice also covers white-collar offences, theft and other property offences, and probation breaches, and its drug work ranges from simple possession to large-scale importation of controlled substances. A longer guide sets out the legal definition of drug offences under the Criminal Code, what to do after an arrest, how to choose a lawyer, the rights of an accused and the consequences of conviction. The office is on Boulevard le Carrefour.
elegant-law-corporation-surrey:
Elegant Law Corporation is a Surrey law firm working in immigration, civil litigation and real estate. Its office is at 13737 72 Avenue, Suite 205, Surrey, British Columbia.

The firm also acts in business formation, contracts and dispute resolution, and gives industry-specific advice on compliance and risk management to sectors such as construction, healthcare and manufacturing. Family work includes divorce, child custody, spousal support and adoption, and the firm also deals with cross-border disputes, international trade and foreign investment.
elevate-law-group:
Elevate Law Group is a Guelph firm advising on wills and estates, business law and real estate, led by lawyer Ajay Sharma.

Ajay Sharma holds a Bachelor of Commerce from Ryerson University and a J.D. from the University of New Brunswick, earned in 2017. He articled in downtown Brampton, has worked from Bay Street to in-house counsel, and completed the Osgoode Intensive Program in Wills & Estates in 2020. He also serves as vice chair for Guelph Police Services. Business law work covers ownership structuring, incorporation, mergers, acquisitions and business sales, and the firm helps first-time homebuyers. Louise Jeffray and Pradnya Kakade are also part of the team.
eli-bloom-avocat-montreal: ELI BLOOM Avocat is a general practice law office in Montreal, Quebec. The office is located at 4810 Rue Jean-Talon Ouest, Montreal, QC H4P 1W7. The firm's practice is recorded as general practice, and no further details about its lawyers, particular areas of law or languages of service are on record.
ellis-criminal-law-professional-corporat:
Ellis Criminal Law Professional Corporation is a London, Ontario firm that limits its practice to criminal defence.

The firm has practised only criminal defence since 2006, after earlier work in civil litigation and education, and has appeared at all levels of court in Ontario. Laura Ellis, Ron Ellis and Stephen Troyer are the lawyers, with Kholood Ghenniwa as paralegal and office manager. Its services include cyber crime, preliminary hearings, trials, first-time offenders, young offenders, and corporate, property and driving offences. The team stresses Charter protections and is reachable around the clock, every day of the week.
england-lam-family-law-vancouver:
England Lam Family Law is a Vancouver firm handling divorce, separation agreements and child custody matters.

Jessica K. England and Louise A. Lam lead a team of family lawyers with more than 30 years of family law experience between them. The firm also offers alternative resolution options for complex divorces and separations.
epp-law-office-brandon:
Epp Law Office is a Brandon firm handling real estate conveyancing, corporate work, estate administration, estate planning and municipal law. Andrea Epp opened the practice in November 2020, associate lawyer Alex Klippenstein joined in spring 2021, and renovations in summer 2025 made room for more staff.

Its real estate work includes purchases, sales, refinancing, subdivisions and lease agreements. Corporate services include incorporations, annual returns, shareholder agreements, share purchase and sale agreements and business name registrations. Estate administration covers probate applications, letters of administration and estate distribution, while estate planning covers wills and powers of attorney. The office is at 642 18th Street.
ericksons-llp:
Ericksons LLP is a full-service Thunder Bay firm, active since 1986, with practice in Indigenous and First Nations law, litigation, estates and real estate.

The main offices sit near the Waterfront District, and the firm operates satellite offices in Geraldton, Manitouwadge, Marathon and Terrace Bay. Its practice also includes insurance, construction, medical malpractice, personal injury, motor vehicle accidents, environmental, employment and labour, and corporate and commercial law. Indigenous and First Nations work covers joint ventures, partnerships, charitable corporations, taxation advice for First Nations and resource development in forestry, mining and energy. Lawyers include Derek T. Noyes, Theodore L. Scollie, Evan A. Juurakko, Ryan C. Venn and Matthew Smiley.
erikson-law-firm-ottawa:
Erikson Law Firm in Ottawa handles real estate, tax and family law matters, with flat-fee billing for most of its legal services.

Valentin Erikson owns the firm. He studied at Carleton University and the University of Ottawa, clerked at the Tax Court of Canada and was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2009. The practice serves clients in Ottawa and across Ontario from an office in Nepean, and also covers estate planning and same-sex legal issues. Notary services include administering oaths, certifying true copies, consent letters for children travelling abroad, passport declarations, and authenticating documents in English, French, Russian, Estonian and Lithuanian.
etude-davocats-tlr-law-office-winnipeg:
Étude d'avocats TLR Law Office is a Winnipeg neighbourhood firm handling wills, estates, residential real estate and business law for Manitoba families. The focus is on Manitoba families and small businesses and the common legal situations they face.

The practice covers probate and estates, wills and powers of attorney, residential real estate, and corporate and business law. The firm hosts educational webinars on wills and offers an executor checklist for people administering an estate. Philippe Richer and Cheryl Pearson are co-owners, and Cheryl brings a background in corporate, commercial and real estate work. The office is at 131 Provencher Boulevard.
evans-pollock-schofield-family-law-corpo:
Evans Pollock Schofield Family Law Corporation is a Winnipeg family firm using collaborative practice, mediation and arbitration outside court.

The firm has practised collaborative law since 2003. Its work covers prenuptial agreements, separation and divorce, adoption and assisted reproduction, and estate planning. Its guiding principles are empathy, transparency and a safe space without judgment, and it helps clients choose which resolution process suits their family. The firm's offices stand on Treaty One Territory, the traditional territory of several Indigenous peoples and the homeland of the Red River Metis.
evolution-legal-calgary:
Evolution Legal is a Calgary firm that acts for employees on employment matters, using a flat-fee model.

Founding lawyer Stephen Dugandzic has more than 10 years of experience in employment law, civil litigation and human rights. The firm handles wrongful dismissal and severance reviews, constructive dismissal, and non-competition and non-solicitation agreements.
ewen-boyd-llp-barrie:
Ewen Boyd LLP is a Barrie firm that handled family, real estate, wills and estate planning and corporate law, and has announced that it is closing.

After more than eleven years of service the firm will close its doors in the near future. It no longer holds any wills or powers of attorney, which have been transferred to Ness Law in Orillia. Before the closure notice, it assisted clients across Simcoe County and Muskoka. Former clients who need a closed real estate or family file are directed to a mailing address in Barrie.
excelsior-avocats:
Excelsior Avocats is a Laval firm of lawyers and business advisers covering business law, litigation, real estate and family law. It also handles trademark and intellectual property work, construction law and arbitration.

Business services include incorporation and corporate organization and commercial transactions. The firm's mission is to advise clients on informed decisions, both in growing a business and in more complex or contested situations, and its service is rigorous, attentive and human. The office is at 211 Boulevard de la Concorde Est, and the firm also produces a podcast.
fabris-mciver-and-durvin-nanaimo:
Fabris McIver & Durvin is a Nanaimo association of lawyers handling civil litigation, personal injury, employment, estates, real estate and business law.

The firm has looked after clients since 1980 and practises across British Columbia from 40 Cavan Street on Vancouver Island. Its clients include individuals, partnerships, corporations, insurers, financial institutions, retailers and contractors. Its lawyers tend to concentrate on preferred areas of practice and consult each other regularly. Iain D. McIver, admitted to the bar in 1990 after law studies at UBC, works on personal injury, estate and inheritance disputes, commercial litigation and employment law.
falcon-law-pc-mississauga:
Falcon Law PC is a largely virtual Canadian firm focused on business, corporate and commercial law, with immigration and real estate work.

Founder Raz Toor advises entrepreneurs and business owners on buying and selling businesses, franchise agreements and e-commerce matters. The firm also acts for buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants on commercial and residential real estate across Ontario, and it serves clients across Canada.
fallow-gould-llp-kingston:
Fallow Gould LLP is a Kingston firm offering estate planning, estate administration, beneficiary guidance and estate litigation.

The work is bespoke and carried out with discretion and precision, with the aim that a client's legacy endures for generations. The firm's practice areas are wills and estates and civil litigation, and it operates from The Woolen Mill at 4 Cataraqui Street in Kingston, Ontario. Estate planning, administration, guidance for beneficiaries and estate litigation make up the core of its work.
family-lawyers-collective-llp-london:
Family Lawyers Collective LLP is a London, Ontario family law firm covering separation, divorce, parenting time, property division and domestic contracts.

Its lawyers are Jelena Buac, Louise M. Mimnagh and Alice Rho. Ms. Buac has practised only family law since 2015 and co-founded the firm as a partner. She has a particular interest in matters involving professional corporations, self-employed people and family businesses, and favours negotiation and mediation before court. The firm also serves clients with high net worth assets and income, and its articles explain separation agreements and what child support covers.
farhat-associates-law-firm:
Farhat & Associates Law Firm is a Windsor, Ontario firm associated with Rashid Farhat, a Windsor solicitor. The firm has an office at 1 Hanna St W in Windsor.

No specific services or practice areas are recorded for the firm beyond a general areas of practice listing, so none are described here. The profile is limited to the firm's name, its city and its street address, and it will be extended when verified details of its lawyers and fields of work are available.
farjoud-law-professional-corporation-nor:
In North York, Farjoud Law Professional Corporation defends clients charged with criminal offences in Toronto and across Ontario. The firm is led by criminal defence lawyer Arman Farjoud.

Arman Farjoud earned a Bachelor of Arts with Honours at the University of Guelph and a Juris Doctor at the University of Windsor, and he has focused his practice on criminal law, from theft and assault to robbery and murder charges. Services include surrendering to police, bail hearings and bail variations, pre-trials, preliminary hearings, trials, and applications to destroy fingerprints and photos or suspend a criminal record. Clients can reach counsel directly and expect a reply within 24 hours. The firm works in Scarborough, Brampton, Newmarket, Etobicoke, Mississauga and Oshawa.
fasken:
Fasken is a law firm in Toronto, Ontario, with an office at 333 Bay St, Suite 2400. No practice tags are recorded for the firm, so its fields of work are not listed.

The entry identifies the firm only by its name and Toronto address. Nothing is stated here about other offices, individual lawyers or areas of practice, and the profile will be extended once verified information on those points is available.
fasken-calgary:
Fasken is a Calgary firm with energy and mining practice tags, at First Canadian Centre, 350 7 Ave SW, Suite 3400.

The entry for this Alberta office is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice areas. No description of its lawyers, history or approach is recorded here, and the profile will be extended once verified information on those points is available.
fazio-law-sarnia:
Fazio Law is a Sarnia firm that has handled real estate, business and estate matters since 1988 for individuals, families, charities and companies.

The practice serves Sarnia and the surrounding area, from small businesses to large corporations, and covers estate planning, real estate transactions and corporate law. Frank Fazio was admitted to the Ontario bar in 1988 and has more than 37 years in practice. He has served on boards in Sarnia-Lambton, including the YMCA, the Downtown Business Improvement Area, the Lung Association and the real estate section of the Lambton Law Association, and the aim is to explain legal dealings in everyday English.
fdg-avocats-montreal:
Business law, tax law and litigation for start-ups and established companies are the focus of FDG Avocats in Montreal.

Services include representation in audits, objections and court proceedings against tax authorities, tax strategies for individuals and businesses, and legal structuring that isolates business assets from personal wealth and guards against seizure. The firm also advises on business management and growth and helps resolve disputes between individuals or companies, whether by agreement or before the courts. Me Félix-Desbiens-Gravel is a former counsel for the Canada Revenue Agency. The office is on Route Transcanadienne Ouest in Saint-Laurent.
feld-kalia-professional-corporation-toro:
Feld Kalia is a Toronto law firm built by David Feld and Sonia Kalia, handling residential real estate closings remotely.

The firm handles the legal work for buying, selling or refinancing a home, and says its fees include all of the legal work on a residential closing. The two partners describe themselves as partners in chambers and at home, as a husband and wife team.
fg-avocat-inc-repentigny:
FG Avocat is a Repentigny firm practising criminal and penal law, from impaired driving and criminal offences to pardon applications and traffic tickets.

Me François Gaudreau defends people charged in the Joliette, Repentigny and Laval areas, with service points in Joliette, Laval, Saint-Jérôme, Terrebonne, Trois-Rivières and Témiscamingue (Ville-Marie). The firm supports clients from the first steps after an arrest for impaired driving through to court appearances, and helps challenge a ticket considered unjustified. The firm works in French.
field-law:
Field Law is a full-service Edmonton firm advising businesses, institutions and individuals on corporate, employment, litigation and estates matters. It has served western and northern Canada for over 100 years, with offices in Calgary, Canmore, Edmonton and Yellowknife, and more than 300 legal professionals and support staff.

Its practice areas include business and corporate law, litigation and dispute resolution, appellate advocacy, class actions, bankruptcy and insolvency, health law, insurance, intellectual property and technology, labour and employment, privacy, professional regulatory matters, real estate, and mediation and arbitration, plus wills, estates and trusts for individuals. Its service area includes St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Stony Plain, Leduc and Beaumont.
filkow-law-kelowna:
Filkow Law Kelowna is a criminal and driving defence firm in Kelowna acting for people charged with offences in British Columbia.

Kevin A. Filkow studied law at the University of Toronto, joined the British Columbia bar in 1994 and the Manitoba bar in 1999, and has acted as a Crown prosecutor during a practice spanning over three decades. He is a member of the Canadian Bar Association, the American Bar Association and the Criminal Defence Advocacy Society, and sits on the board of governors of the Trial Lawyers Association of British Columbia. Service is available in English, French, Punjabi, Hindi, Mandarin and Cantonese.
fine-and-associates-toronto:
Fine & Associates Professional Corporation limits its Toronto practice to family law and divorce, including parenting, support and property division. Lawyer Lorne J. Fine graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School in 1990, was called to the bar in 1992 and has studied at Oxford. He holds certificates in negotiation, collaborative law and mediation, has mediated numerous cases and is a qualified arbitrator.

The firm seeks settlements through mediation where possible and prepares for trial when a fair resolution cannot be reached. It acts for clients across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, including Markham, Oakville and Mississauga, and Lorne has been interviewed on Global television and CHCH television about major family law issues in Ontario.
flaherty-mccarthy-llp:
Flaherty McCarthy LLP is a Markham insurance litigation firm handling motor vehicle tort, accident benefits, coverage disputes and class proceedings.

Every lawyer at the firm works in motor vehicle tort, occupiers' liability, statutory accident benefits, loss transfer and priority disputes, property matters, subrogated matters and coverage. The firm has also built a plaintiff-side class proceedings practice led by Sean Brown and Christopher Lupis, with cases involving privacy breaches, healthcare standards and lawyers' negligence. Managing Partner Frank A. Benedetto was admitted to the Ontario Bar in 1999, appears at all levels of court in Ontario, acts as a mediator and has taught insurance law at Queen's Law School.
fortier-law-firm:
Fortier Law Firm is a family-run Greater Sudbury practice, in operation since 1972, covering real estate, corporate, family and wills and estates law.

The firm is a father, son and daughter team raised in Sudbury, made up of Fred, Carter and Krista Fortier. Carter Fortier advises on corporate and business law, including buying and selling businesses, over more than 25 years, and Krista Fortier handles family law including parenting time and decision-making. Real estate work covers single-family homes, cottages, multi-unit residential, recreational, vacant land and commercial property, along with mortgages from banks and private lenders. Max, the office dog, greets visitors.
forum-law-llp-edmonton:
Forum Law LLP is an Edmonton full-service firm handling family law, civil litigation and business law for individuals and small and medium-sized businesses.

The firm was founded in 2020 and now has 18 lawyers working across 10 areas of law. Its office is in Northwest Edmonton, and it serves Calgary, Edmonton and communities across Alberta, including through a Calgary litigation and dispute resolution practice. Integrity and honesty are its founding principle, and each matter is handled in a client-centred way.
forward-law-llp:
Forward Law LLP is a Kamloops firm handling estate planning, probate, business, employment, construction and Indigenous law.

Its areas include estate planning, commercial work, probate, business, bidding, municipal, expropriation and First Nations law, and it supports survivors of Federal Indian Hospitals. The firm's name reflects a wish to help clients move forward, whether that means starting a business, resolving a dispute or preparing a will and power of attorney. It is a friendly Kamloops firm with offices on Summit Drive.
fosters-law-llp-london:
Fosters Law LLP, founded in 1975, handles personal injury cases and insurance litigation from its London, Ontario office. Its lawyers act for injured people in motor vehicle accident, wrongful death and medical or professional malpractice matters, and for insurers, businesses and property owners across Ontario in insurance defence and advisory work.

Insurance work covers property damage disputes, subrogation and coverage questions, and the firm takes a technology-forward approach to efficient litigation. It has served clients across Ontario for almost 50 years.
fox-mcnevin-mackay-llp-lawyers-windsor:
Fox McNevin MacKay LLP is a Windsor family law firm handling divorce, separation, property division, custody, access and support.

Its services include collaborative family law, marriage, separation and cohabitation agreements, uncontested divorce, mediation and arbitration, litigation and appeals. Tanya McNevin earned her law degree from the University of Windsor in 2010, was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2011 and spent ten years in the legal field beforehand. Thomas MacKay and Mary Fox are also part of the team. The firm develops a custom strategy with each client and uses mediation, collaborative processes and litigation.
fp-legal-calgary:
FP Legal is a full-service Calgary firm handling real estate, personal injury, civil litigation, corporate and family law. Its office is on 17 Avenue NW.

Founder Nelson Osamudiamen earned his Juris Doctor at the University of Calgary in 2013, articled at Dentons and was licensed by the Law Society of Alberta in July 2014; he has appeared before all levels of court in Alberta. Real estate work covers residential and commercial transactions, corporate clients receive contract drafting and negotiation support, and family law includes agreements for couples entering, living in or ending a relationship.
fraese-aymont-family-lawyers-calgary-cal:
Fraese Aymont is a boutique family law firm in Calgary handling divorce, separation, parenting, support and property division.

Family law is all the firm does. Its downtown Calgary office serves Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks and Chestermere, and its services also include family agreements such as separation and cohabitation agreements, mediation, arbitration and court proceedings. Brandi Aymont works with her paralegal Devonna McFarlane. The firm offers child support and spousal support calculators along with a guide to divorce and separation in Alberta that discusses negotiation, mediation, arbitration and court procedure.
freedom-family-law:
Freedom Family Law is a Victoria practice focused on prenuptial, cohabitation, postnuptial, common-law and separation agreements.

The firm's entire practice is family agreements, and it does not litigate, reasoning that most family disputes are preventable and most often settled by agreement. It is remote-first and serves clients across British Columbia. Mathais Sarrazin is the barrister and solicitor and Zoe the designated paralegal. Agreements let couples set their own terms instead of relying on the default rules of the Family Law Act.
frenkel-tobin-llp-toronto:
Frenkel Tobin LLP is a downtown Toronto boutique firm focused exclusively on family and divorce law.

Its lawyers act for clients in Ontario, across Canada and internationally, including mothers, fathers, grandparents, seniors, LGBTQ clients, people with limited finances and those with high net worth. Areas include separation, parenting schedules and decision-making for children, child support and spousal support. David Frenkel has practised only family law since 2008, has published in the Canadian Family Law Quarterly, Law Times and the Globe and Mail, and has spoken at the Law Society of Ontario's Family Law Summit; David Tobin and several other lawyers also practise with the firm.
fridman-co-immigration-law-office-winnip:
Fridman & Company is a Winnipeg immigration law office handling permanent residence, temporary residence, provincial nominee and family sponsorship files. Its lawyers have more than 25 years of experience in Canadian immigration, refugee and citizenship law.

The practice covers permanent residence, temporary residence, provincial nominee programs and family sponsorships. The multilingual team speaks to clients in their native languages and predominantly serves new Canadians, and treats each file as if it were its own. The office is at 83 Garry Street, Suite 201.
frouhar-law-ottawa:
Frouhar Law is an Ottawa criminal defence firm defending assault, impaired driving, drug, sexual assault, homicide and fraud charges.

The firm serves Ottawa, Brockville and Eastern Ontario and maintains an emergency line available around the clock. Mash Frouhar was admitted to the Ontario Bar in 2009, previously worked as an Assistant Crown Attorney and as a defence lawyer with Legal Aid Ontario, and offers services in English, French and Farsi. Connie D'Angelo was admitted in 1993 and has practised only criminal law, including representing police officers before the Special Investigations Unit and at Police Services Act hearings. Micaela Rodriguez is also on the team.
gad-pariente-montreal:
Gad Pariente is a Montreal immigration lawyer who handles spousal and common-law partner sponsorship applications for clients across Canada.

Licensed by the Barreau du Québec since 2006, he practises as a sole practitioner through Gad Pariente Avocat Inc. and spent years in public relations and communications before law. His work covers both inland and outland sponsorship files, with posted flat fees and a federal-only path. All client work is conducted remotely, with office visits by appointment for Montreal-area clients. Service is offered in English or French to clients in Quebec, Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta and the U.S.
gagan-law-pc-mississauga:
Gagan Law PC is a Mississauga firm offering real estate, wills and estates, business law and immigration services. Principal lawyer Gagan Dadiala leads the firm from the Streetsville village area of Mississauga and serves clients in Mississauga and Brampton.

Business law work includes business name and sole proprietorship registrations, contracts, policies, terms of service and memoranda of understanding, as well as guidance on buying and selling dental practices. The firm works to keep its fee structure transparent and predictable and offers a range of billing arrangements.
gagan-nahal-criminal-lawyer:
Gagan Nahal Criminal Lawyer is a Surrey criminal defence practice handling assault, drug, theft, fraud, weapons and other charges across British Columbia.

Gagan Nahal practises exclusively in criminal defence and started his own practice upon admission to the British Columbia bar. The charges addressed include assault with a weapon, aggravated assault, sexual assault, attempted murder and murder, kidnapping, child pornography and driving offences. Services are offered in English, Punjabi and Hindi. He received a 2025 King Charles III Coronation Medal and has been asked by television and radio news channels to discuss legal issues.
gagnon-avocats:
Gagnon Avocats is a Chicoutimi firm in Saguenay handling civil, commercial, family and employment law, from hidden defects to divorce and dismissals.

Its civil work includes civil liability, contracts, estate disputes, insurance, real estate issues such as rights of way and boundary marking, neighbour disturbances and construction law. Business work covers incorporation of companies, shareholder agreements, financing, bankruptcy and insolvency, and corporate restructuring. On the family side it handles separation, custody, support, family patrimony and the separation of de facto spouses, with youth protection, employment contracts and labour standards also among its areas.
gagnon-tasse-gagnon-avocats:
Gagnon & Tassé-Gagnon Avocats is a Saint-Jerome firm handling criminal law, penal law and young offender cases since 1990.

The firm has been rooted in Saint-Jerome from the start and takes clients, individuals or companies, through the criminal and penal system from arrest to trial. It acts in the judicial districts of Terrebonne (Saint-Jérôme), Laval, Labelle (Mont-Laurier), Joliette and Montréal. Examples of matters handled include impaired driving, assault causing injury in domestic violence cases, seizure of firearms, unlawful presence in a dwelling and road safety code tickets.
galbraith-law-edmonton:
Galbraith Law is a northwest Edmonton firm handling real estate, small business, and wills and estates law, and has served clients since December 1987.

It began as a single-lawyer operation in Westmount Shopping Centre and is now a team of lawyers. Real estate work covers residential and commercial purchases, sales and closings, business work includes incorporation, employment, subcontractor and financing agreements and the purchase or sale of businesses, and estate work covers enduring powers of attorney, personal care directives and estate administration. The ground-level office on 178 Street NW is accessible.
gale-law-professional-corporation-toront:
Gale Law Professional Corporation, a Toronto firm led by mediator Kim Gale, concentrates on estate litigation. Its work covers will challenges, capacity disputes, powers of attorney and guardianship disputes, elder abuse, dependant support applications and recovering money owed by a deceased person, along with probate and estate administration.

The firm has offices in downtown Toronto and North York. Its lawyers include Kim Gale, Mitchell Reiss, Palak Mahajan and Jessica Campolucci, and mediation is offered as a route to resolving estate disputes.
galileo-partners-montreal:
For employers with Canadian, Quebec and American immigration needs, Galileo Partners is a Montreal business immigration firm.

The firm acts for domestic and international companies through a bilingual, turnkey service that manages complete immigration files, with the aim of lightening the load on human resources and legal teams. It handles more than 2,500 files a year for over 1,000 companies, with more than 15 lawyers working in immigration law. A blog follows Quebec, Canada and US immigration developments, including work permits expiring in 2026. Its office is on Avenue Union.
gardiner-roberts-llp:
Gardiner Roberts LLP is a mid-sized Toronto law firm advising businesses from global enterprises to start-ups and entrepreneurs.

The firm traces its beginnings to 1913, when H. Fred Parkinson graduated. A partnership called Parkinson and Gardiner operated on Broadview Avenue, Parkinson, Gardiner, Willis formed in 1935 and Harry D. Roberts arrived in 1948. The name Gardiner Roberts first appeared in 1967. Today the firm takes a cross-disciplinary, one-team approach that pairs the breadth of a full-service firm with the agility of a mid-sized one.
garson-immigration-law-north-york:
Immigration law is the only practice of Garson Immigration Law, a North York firm acting for corporations and individuals. It handles Canadian immigration as well as U.S. immigration for Canadians.

Founding partner David Garson has led immigration firms in Toronto and is certified by the Law Society of Ontario in the field. The firm advises on Canadian immigration, including Express Entry, provincial nominee programs and family sponsorship such as the Parents and Grandparents Program, and assists Canadians who want to immigrate to the USA. Clients include businesses and professionals across a range of industries.
gauthier-and-mines-criminal-lawyers-vanc:
Gauthier & Mines Criminal Lawyers is a Vancouver firm that has defended criminal charges across British Columbia since 1993.

Formerly Mines & Company, the firm includes Michael Mines, Ian Gauthier, Patrick Johnston, Courtney McLaughlin and Ishnoor Dhillon, whose practice is focused solely on criminal law, civil forfeiture and Motor Vehicle Act defence. Charges handled include assault, driving, drug, sexual assault, theft and fraud, weapons, murder and other serious offences, plus driving prohibitions and professional discipline. The firm appears in courts throughout Metro Vancouver and the rest of the province, has conducted cases in Alberta, Ontario, Quebec and the Yukon, and uses Alternative Measures programs that can end a prosecution without a criminal record.
gauthier-avocats-brossard:
Gauthier Avocats is a Brossard family law firm handling divorce, separation and child custody matters for spouses and parents in the Montreal area.

The firm has practised family law since 2009 and serves clients in Brossard, Longueuil, Montreal, Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu and Saint-Hyacinthe. Its approach rests on long experience in family matters and close attention to each client. The office is on Boulevard Lapinière in Brossard, and legal aid mandates are not accepted.
gauthier-bedard:
Gauthier Bedard is a Saguenay law firm, founded in 1932 and based in Chicoutimi, whose listed practice area is employment law.

Its themes include notarial law, mediation and psychosocial risk management, and its lawyers look for strategic solutions in a competitive setting. The firm helped apply the Labour Code provisions on maintaining services for the population, acting for the CPE Le Jardin de Robi in Roberval during a general strike that began on 22 October 2025. The Tribunal administratif du travail ordered minimum child care services in two decisions of March 2026, with Me Sylvain Bouchard directing the employer's representation.
gauthier-tousignant-avocats-inc:
Gauthier & Tousignant Avocats is a Saint-Jerome firm defending people charged with criminal and penal offences.

The lawyers are Me Pierre M. Gauthier and Me Meghann Tousignant, and the charges handled include sexual assault, driving offences, drug possession, production or sale, theft or fraud, and assault and threats. The firm takes on clients in Quebec or Ontario, a lawyer travels between Joliette and Gatineau to meet them, and a defence is available around the clock, every day.
gbv-avocats-quebec-city:
Since 1998, GBV Avocats has practised in Quebec City, covering civil and commercial litigation, corporate and banking law.

The firm has offices in Quebec City, Lévis, Trois-Rivières, Montreal and Sherbrooke, and acts for individuals, small, medium and large companies, insurance companies and financial and banking institutions. Practice areas include real estate, environment, energy and natural resources, family and estates, administrative, municipal and constitutional law, access to information, mergers and acquisitions, labour and employment, and public law. Its philosophy rests on intensity, rigour and humility.
gelman-and-associates:
Gelman & Associates is a family law firm in North York and across Ontario handling divorce, separation, child custody and access, and support.

Services include adoption, alternative dispute resolution, child protection, child support, divorce and separation, domestic contracts, spousal support and property division. The firm has offices in Aurora, Barrie, Cambridge, Grimsby, Hamilton, Mississauga, North York, Scarborough, St. Catharines and Whitby, and serves Toronto and communities throughout Ontario. Its lawyers explain options in clear language and shape an approach around each client's circumstances and priorities.
george-lee-law-corp-burnaby:
