George Lee Law Corporation is a Burnaby firm handling family, civil, immigration and criminal matters from its Metrotown office. George Lee has practised since 2002, and the firm serves Vancouver, Burnaby and the rest of British Columbia in English, Mandarin and Korean.

Lawyers George Lee and James Lee approach disputes by first looking for a practical resolution such as clear advice, a firm letter, negotiation, a four-way meeting or mediation, and they prepare the evidence for court when it becomes necessary. The firm also takes selected solicitor matters including conveyancing, and offers virtual meetings when appropriate.
george-murray-shipley-bell-llp:
George Murray Shipley Bell LLP is a full-service Sarnia firm covering real estate, corporate and commercial law, wills and estates, and family law. Its work includes residential and commercial purchases, sales, mortgages and leases, as well as business start-ups, corporate reorganizations and complex contracts.

Estate work includes wills, powers of attorney, tax and succession planning, cross-border estate planning for Canada and the U.S., probate and trustee support. Its land development work covers severances, subdivision agreements, re-zoning applications and minor variances, while family matters include divorces, marriage contracts and guardianship applications. The firm was originally known as McCart, McEachran, serves the Sarnia-Lambton community from 222 Front Street North, and its lawyers include Faye Abbasi, D'Arcy Bell, Ryan Bell and Gregory Bernard.
georgia-pappis-montreal:
Montreal immigration lawyer Georgia Pappis handles Express Entry, family sponsorship, work and study permits and citizenship applications.

She has been a barrister and solicitor since 2004, is a member of the Quebec Bar and belongs to the Association of Quebec Immigration Lawyers (AQAADI). Her practice has been exclusively immigration law for more than 20 years. Matters include Quebec Skilled Workers, the Quebec Experience Program (PEQ), visitor visas, permanent resident card renewals, humanitarian and compassionate applications, criminal rehabilitation and record suspensions, along with advice on criminal matters that can affect immigration status. She works in English, French and Greek from an office on Boulevard Alexis-Nihon in Saint-Laurent.
gerami-law-pc-ottawa:
Gerami Law PC is an Ottawa immigration firm handling refugee protection, family sponsorship, study and visitor permits and citizenship applications.

Operating since 2011, the firm has its headquarters in Ottawa and remote offices in Toronto and Vancouver. Founder Arghavan Gerami has practised in Ontario for over 15 years, and the team also includes Elham Tarahimofrad, Ana Paula Aguilar Gomez and Nathan Knoble Kenna. Its refugee work covers application forms, narratives, hearing preparation and submissions before the Board, while an urgent practice group deals with removals, admissibility hearings and pre-removal risk assessments.
gerry-law-thunder-bay:
Gerry Law is a Thunder Bay personal injury firm that also takes on sexual assault and slip and fall cases in Ontario.

The practice is built around lawyer Natalie Gerry, who holds a Juris Doctor from the Bora Laskin Faculty of Law and an honours B.A. from Trinity College at the University of Toronto, and has selected reported decisions to her name. Legal fees are not charged until a file is resolved, and initial case evaluations are limited to personal injury and sexual assault matters. The office is at 34 Cumberland Street North.
gertsoyg-and-company-burnaby:
Gertsoyg and Company is a Burnaby firm handling family law, estate litigation, disability benefit denials, personal injury and wrongful dismissal. It also acts in human rights and commercial litigation matters and has locations in Vancouver, North Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey, Langley and Kelowna.

Clients are served by an experienced lawyer supported by five law assistants, all with university education. Disability work covers appeals of denied benefits and other insurance disputes, while personal injury work includes cases against ICBC, and family work extends to estate litigation.
ggfi-law-llp-kitchener:
GGFI Law LLP is a Kitchener general practice firm handling wills, powers of attorney and a wide range of matters for individuals and companies.

The firm was founded in 1981 and is a diversified general practice that develops practical strategies for changing personal and business needs. It is community-minded. Its work on wills and powers of attorney covers the role of the estate trustee, beneficiaries and updating a will through a codicil, and the firm is staffed by lawyers, support staff and students.
ghabryal-law-professional-corporation-to:
Ghabryal Law is a Toronto firm whose lawyer studied law in the United States before returning to practise in Canada.

The practice includes immigration matters such as work permits, study permits, permanent residence and citizenship, along with partnership and shareholder agreements, commercial leases, marriage contracts and spousal support. The lawyer is a member of the Canadian Bar Association and the Law Society of Upper Canada.
ghasemi-law-professional-corporation-ric:
Ghasemi Law Professional Corporation is a Richmond Hill firm handling immigration and real estate matters for clients in Toronto and the GTA. Founder and director Sara Ghasemi is a licensed barrister and solicitor with a background in both the legal and banking industries, and her real estate practice covers sales, purchases, refinancing, mortgages, title transfers, bridge financing, assignments, interim closings and lease agreements.

Ghasemi is a member of the Law Society of Ontario and the Iran Central Bar Association and is a licensing candidate with the State Bar of California. The firm works on a flat-rate fee structure with transparent charges and no unexpected closing costs.
giardino-law-edmonton:
Giardino Law is an Edmonton firm handling real estate closings, wills and personal injury matters, with remote signing across Alberta.

The firm has 20 years of experience in real estate transactions for buyers, sellers, realtors and mortgage lenders. Its site says its fees, including disbursements, are set out up front.
gibson-meardi-barristers-and-solicitors-:
Gibson Meardi is an Edmonton firm handling real estate, commercial law, commercial litigation, family law, and wills and estate planning.

Damien Meardi was called to the bar in November 2013. The lawyer is a University of Saskatchewan graduate who previously worked in business development consulting and as an analyst.
ginakes-law-office-winnipeg:
In Winnipeg, Ginakes Law Office brings together independent lawyers in estate planning, real estate, notarial services and corporate law.

The firm practises under the name Dobrowolski, Boonov & Ginakes, Barristers & Solicitors. Services include lifetime and estate planning, probate and estate administration, residential and commercial real estate, business and corporate law for companies from start-ups to large family-run businesses, and notarial services, since all of its lawyers are authorized by the Manitoba government to act as notaries. The firm moved in 2022 into an office it owns on Main Street.
ginzburg-legal-montreal:
Ginzburg Legal is a Montreal criminal defence firm handling DUI, violent, drug, cybercrime, theft and weapons charges.

From an office on Saint-François-Xavier in Old Montreal, the firm defends charges ranging from sexual assault and fraud to impaired driving and drug offences. Its method is to assess the situation, study the evidence and case law, negotiate, and argue the case, with a discharge or acquittal as the goal. Practice areas include driving, violent, drug, cybercrime, property and weapons offences, and the firm publishes articles on topics such as judge-shopping and impaired driving.
girard-avocats-inc:
Girard Avocats is a Sherbrooke firm handling family law and civil law, from separation and divorce to hidden defects and construction disputes. It has teams in both Sherbrooke and Granby.

On family matters the firm handles child custody, support, sharing of children's expenses, and division of the house, furniture and debts. Civil law services include neighbour disturbances, debt recovery, contract drafting, non-compete clauses, confidentiality agreements, service and employment contracts, protection regimes and succession. The firm develops practical strategies with each client, and the Sherbrooke office is on Rue King Ouest.
glass-gavel-professional-corporation-bar:
Criminal charges, bail and driving offences are the focus of Glass Gavel Professional Corporation, a Barrie paralegal firm. It is owned and operated by Larissa Kushwara, a licensed paralegal and Notary Public in Ontario, and acts for people charged with criminal offences who do not qualify for Legal Aid, with flat fees and payment plans.

Areas include assault, breach of court order, break and enter, cannabis and drug offences, currency and financial offences, environmental offences and firearm offences. Ms. Kushwara grew up in Blind River, Ontario, has represented clients in courtrooms across the province, and started the firm to make legal services more accessible in Northern Ontario.
gluckstein-lawyers:
Gluckstein Lawyers is a Toronto personal injury firm handling car accidents, medical malpractice, birth injury, disability matters and mass torts.

The firm was founded in 1962 and has grown through partnerships with personal injury lawyers across Ontario. It serves people during difficult periods of their lives, and legal fees are not charged until a case is settled. Recent announcements concern conferences on birth injury law and on civil sexual assault litigation, and the firm's office is on Bay Street in Toronto.
go-law-vancouver:
Go Law is a Vancouver firm handling real estate, business and estate planning matters, including probate. Nick Go founded the firm after completing his Juris Doctor at the University of British Columbia in 2015 and practising with senior lawyer Dick W. Eng and at Bell Alliance LLP.

Real estate work covers residential and commercial purchases and sales, private lending, refinancing, commercial leases and Land Title Office filings such as subdivisions, stratifications and easements. Designated paralegal Teng Fong has more than 15 years of experience with conveyancing, corporate and estate files and serves clients in Cantonese and Mandarin.
gobeil-lapierre:
Gobeil & Lapierre is a Levis family law office, operating under the name Gobeil Avocats, that offers mediation, divorce and separation work.

The office has served Lévis since 1980. Its family law matters include divorce, separation, child custody, division of property and child support, together with family mediation, youth law and civil law. The firm's approach is human, rigorous and strategic, and in mediation an impartial mediator helps parents reach an agreement.
godinho-zager-kraska-llp-mississauga:
Former criminal prosecutors make up the partnership at Godinho Zager Kraska LLP, a Mississauga criminal defence firm. Partners Mike Godinho, Reyam Zager and Robert Kraska bring more than 20 years of experience as criminal prosecutors and now defend people charged with offences ranging from murder, impaired driving causing death, armed robbery, drug trafficking and home invasion to petty theft and minor assault.

The firm acts at every stage of the criminal justice system, from bail through trial, and in quasi-criminal and regulatory matters. Services cover assault, criminal harassment, uttering threats, sexual assault, DUI and other driving offences, property crimes, fraud, firearms and drug offences, as well as record suspensions and pardons.
godwit-law-office-brampton:
Immigration sits at the centre of Godwit Law Office, a Brampton firm that also handles family law and real estate. Its immigration work includes permanent residency, spousal sponsorships, citizenship, and work permits such as LMIA-based permits, open work permits and extensions, and it represents clients in appeals and hearings after applications are refused.

Services are offered in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu, and the firm uses flat-rate pricing. From its office on Conestoga Drive it assists clients in the GTA, across Canada and abroad, including individuals and families in border regions such as Buffalo, Plattsburgh and Minneapolis who want to visit, study, work or immigrate to Canada.
gogna-immigration-inc-edmonton:
Gogna Immigration Inc., based in Edmonton, is a team of regulated immigration consultants handling Canadian visas, citizenship and immigration applications.

The company serves clients across Canada and overseas, and covers nearby communities including St. Albert, Leduc, Sherwood Park, Fort Saskatchewan and Spruce Grove. Rather than limiting itself to one category or program, it helps with a broad range of applications. Neha has worked in immigration consulting for more than a decade, and the company's aim is to simplify immigration steps for people whose applications affect their families and futures.
gold-family-law-brampton:
Gold Family Law is a Brampton firm practising family law across Peel Region, formerly known as Wood Gold LLP.

Founding partner Frances Wood was appointed a judge of the Superior Court of Justice. The firm says it sees the big picture and offers practical solutions, and it invites prospective clients to book a free telephone call or virtual meeting with one of its lawyers.
gold-law-north-york:
Gold Law is a criminal defence and civil litigation firm whose founder has practised exclusively in criminal law for over a decade.

Before founding the firm, the lawyer was a partner at a Toronto boutique criminal law firm. The site lists clients charged with offences including assault, sexual assault, murder and attempted murder, drug trafficking, firearm offences, and impaired and dangerous driving.
goldengate-barristers-and-solicitors-pro:
GoldenGate Lawyers is a firm handling refugee claims, immigration, real estate and criminal law, and it also provides notary public services.

The lawyers have over 20 years of collective experience and say they tailor each strategy to the particular case. The firm says it aims for excellence in every matter, whatever its scale or complexity.
goldman-associates:
Goldman Associates is a Vancouver immigration law firm handling provincial nominee, sponsorship and humanitarian applications.

The firm is managed by Ian Goldman, who has more than 30 years in Canadian immigration law, and it is a law firm rather than an immigration consultancy. Services include spousal and common-law partner sponsorship, entrepreneur applications, compliance inspections for employers, and rehabilitation for criminal inadmissibility. The firm also covers work permits, student permits, permanent residence, citizenship and settlement services, and prepares clients for interviews and border entry.
goldman-sloan-nash-and-haber-llp:
Goldman Sloan Nash & Haber LLP is a mid-sized downtown Toronto firm handling corporate and commercial law, banking and finance, real estate and arbitration.

The firm has helped businesses, entrepreneurs and individuals for more than 40 years and advises across all major practice areas, including litigation and alternative dispute resolution. Its aim is to combine the personal service of a boutique with the sophistication of a larger firm. Pooneh Sooresrafil and Jana Smith are recent additions as lawyers, and another lawyer was quoted in a Lexpert special edition on infrastructure. The firm also issues a newsletter with bulletins and updates.
goldwyn-law-professional-corporation-mar:
Goldwyn Law is a Markham firm handling real estate, corporate and commercial, secured lending, wills and estates, and mortgage enforcement.

Its work includes residential and commercial real estate closings, incorporations and start-up planning, financial services and secured lending transactions, and estate planning. It also addresses mortgage defaults from both the borrower and the lender side. Notary services for affidavits and statutory declarations are available, in person or virtually. The firm acts across Ontario, and its mission is to be a friendly and practical presence for first-time homebuyers, investors and entrepreneurs.
goodfellow-and-schuettlaw-calgary:
Goodfellow & Schuettlaw is a law firm with offices in Calgary and Edmonton, practising mainly in construction and real estate law.

The firm also handles corporate and commercial, condominium, builders' lien, private lending, litigation and estate planning matters, including development projects that involve financing and permitting. Its site notes that it can act for clients in other provinces and territories.
goodfellow-and-schuettlaw-edmonton:
Goodfellow & Schuettlaw is an Edmonton firm with offices in Edmonton and Calgary, practising mainly in construction and real estate law.

The firm's construction work covers builders' lien, condominium construction and development projects with financing and permitting. It also handles corporate and commercial, litigation, private lending and estate planning matters, and says it has acted in other provinces and territories.
gooselaw-immigration-law-firm-mississaug:
GOOSELAW Immigration is a Canadian law firm that files work permit applications for tech and multi-industry employers.

The firm works mainly with companies that need several work permits each month, in fields such as software development, hardware manufacturing, IT services, biotech, engineering and digital media. Its preferred clients have five or more files a month, and the firm offers a free 30-minute strategy call to employers considering the process.
gosal-and-company-surrey:
Gosal & Company is a Surrey firm that acts for injured workers in WorkSafeBC cases and appeals across British Columbia. Its lawyers handle appeals of WorkSafeBC decisions, including appeals to the Workers' Compensation Appeal Tribunal, as well as case management and the reopening of closed files. Sarj Gosal has represented more than 5,800 injured workers since 1993, and the lawyers have over 50 years of combined experience with WorkSafeBC matters.

Clients come from construction, transportation, healthcare, retail, hospitality, manufacturing, forestry, education, aviation and government, and include tradespeople, drivers, nurses, care aides and first responders. The firm has locations in Vancouver, Victoria and Surrey and also assists injured workers remotely across the province.
gowling-wlg-canada-llp:
Gowling WLG (Canada) LLP is a sector-focused, full-service law firm in Toronto that is part of an international group.

Its Canadian team numbers more than 700 legal professionals in seven cities, within a worldwide group of over 1,500. Services include advertising and product regulatory, banking and finance, competition and antitrust, construction, corporate and M&A, data protection and cyber security, employment and labour, ESG, and restructuring and insolvency. The firm holds that legal matters are people matters, and Gowling WLG International Limited, an English company, coordinates its members, which operate as independent entities.
gowling-wlg-canada-llp-calgary:
Gowling WLG (Canada) LLP is part of an international law firm and has a Calgary office covering energy and insolvency matters. It is a sector-focused practice with more than 1,500 legal professionals around the world.

The firm believes legal matters are people matters and that closer relationships between people and teams lead to better outcomes. It works on artificial intelligence and workflow automation, trade, digital transformation and intellectual property enforcement in China, and runs diversity, equity and inclusion programs led by regional heads, including one for Canada. The Calgary office is at 421 7 Ave SW.
gray-criminal-defence-toronto:
Gray Criminal Defence, also known as Gray Defence, is a Toronto practice led by founder George Gray that defends people charged with criminal offences.

George Gray was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2009 and has spent more than fifteen years defending the accused, first as a criminal litigator at a national firm. He has appeared at all levels of court in Ontario and prepared written advocacy for the Supreme Court of Canada. The firm takes an evidence-based approach, and Chetanaya Gupta and Kinza Siddiqui are on its team. Its service area includes Brampton, Newmarket, Milton, Hamilton and Brantford, and its commentary covers disclosure delays and searches of devices at the border.
grayer-law-office-family-lawyer-vancouve:
Grayer Law Office is an East Vancouver family law firm on Commercial Drive offering family mediation, collaborative law, negotiation and litigation.

The aim is to settle cohabitation, separation and divorce issues with as little conflict and expense as possible, including parenting and children, property division, and child and spousal support. Patrick is a fully trained and accredited family mediator and a member of the Mediate BC Roster. In mediation, the participants shape the outcome rather than a court, with or without lawyers present.
great-lakes-law:
Great Lakes Law is a Sarnia firm handling residential and commercial real estate, mortgages, wills, powers of attorney and trusts. It serves individuals and businesses, with Chelsea Cooper as principal lawyer and Sarah Craig as associate lawyer.

The real estate side covers first-home purchases, refinancing, home-improvement financing, investment property, commercial leasing, multi-unit residential projects and municipal applications, and residential purchases and sales are a core part of the firm's work. A team of real estate and mortgage staff and an office management team support the lawyers at 236 Napier Street.
grechi-carter-professional-corporation-t:
Grechi Carter Professional Corporation is a boutique Midtown Toronto firm handling real estate, private mortgages and mortgage enforcement. It acts on the purchase, sale and refinancing of condominiums, houses, cottages and commercial or industrial property, and for private mortgage lenders in Ontario, closing hundreds of private mortgages per year.

The firm has also acted for both borrowers and lenders in contested and uncontested mortgage enforcement actions. Its office is at 1 Eglinton Avenue East, Suite 803, in Toronto.
green-and-spiegel-llp-toronto:
Green and Spiegel LLP is a Toronto immigration firm practising Canadian and U.S. immigration law for corporations and individuals.

Mendel Green established the firm in 1962, and it has practised only immigration law since. It moved into the U.S. market in the 1990s and established Green & Spiegel U.S. in 2012. Its head offices are in Toronto and Philadelphia. Services are organized into corporate immigration, covering global mobility and compliance for businesses, and individual immigration, with separate Canadian and U.S. practices.
greg-monforton-partners:
Greg Monforton & Partners is a Windsor personal injury law firm formed in 1981 that represents accident victims.

The firm was formed to provide legal services to people who had little access to lawyers, and it became the first Ontario law firm to advertise on television once the Law Society lifted its advertising restrictions in 1987. Founder Greg Monforton wrote a newspaper legal column, You & the Law, for more than 15 years. Injury cases are handled on a contingency fee basis, with fees payable only when a recovery is obtained, and compensation categories include medical costs, lost wages, and pain and suffering.
gregg-alfonso-law-corporation:
Gregg Alfonso Law Corporation is a boutique Kelowna firm handling real estate, wills and estates, estate litigation and business law.

The firm has operated in the Okanagan Valley for more than 20 years from an office in downtown Kelowna, on Sunset Drive. Its real estate team works alongside a client's realtor and mortgage broker on purchases and sales, and its areas of practice include wills, estates and probate. The firm aims to build lasting relationships with clients and also practises in further areas beyond its main four.
grenier-law-notary-public:
Grenier Law is an Ottawa firm led by Monick Grenier that handles criminal defence and civil litigation, with notary services.

Monick Grenier was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2012 after more than 20 years working in civil litigation, including in plaintiff personal injury and insurance defence firms and seven years as a land claims researcher. She has appeared before the Superior Court of Justice, argued appeals in the Divisional Court, and acted in Small Claims Court and before immigration, labour, human rights and landlord and tenant tribunals. grewal-law-firm-ottawa:

grover-law-firm-calgary:

gss-law-firm-edmonton:

guberman-appleby-immigration-lawyers-tor:

gunn-law-group-edmonton:

gupta-law-firm:

gurna-law-corporation-surrey:
Gurna Law Corporation is a Surrey immigration firm handling permanent residence, family sponsorship, business immigration and citizenship. gurpreet-ghag-law-group-vancouver:

h-and-h-law-group-mississauga:

habib-and-associates-law-office:

hammer-injury-law-edmonton:
Hammer Injury Law is an Edmonton personal injury firm focused on motor vehicle accident injuries, serious injury and wrongful death.

hammerco-lawyers-llp-vancouver:
Hammerco Lawyers LLP is a Vancouver firm handling class actions, commercial litigation, estate litigation, personal injury and medical negligence.

handa-law-professional-corporation-bramp:

hansen-and-company-calgary: Hansen & Company is a Calgary law firm whose practice areas include immigration, wills and estates, and personal injury. hansra-law-toronto:

hnt-law-guelph:

hoare-claxton-criminal-defence:

hoffman-law-toronto:

houlihan-law-sarnia:

howard-and-howard-ottawa:

immigration-law-firm-of-matthew-jeffery-:
Matthew Jeffery's immigration firm handles family sponsorship, Express Entry, permanent resident card renewals and citizenship.

The firm has experience with spousal and common-law partner sponsorships and also handles U.S. immigration to Canada. Prospective clients can complete a free assessment form so the firm can check whether they may qualify.
immigration-rh-avocats-inc-quebec-city:
Visas, work permits, permanent residence, citizenship and refugee matters are the work of Immigration RH, a Quebec City firm.

The firm was founded and is led by Me Anouar Bouraoui, a member of the Barreau du Québec and a regulated immigration representative, and it acts for individuals, families and businesses. Its work covers visitor and transit visas, new and renewed closed or open work permits, the Quebec Selection Certificate (CSQ) and permanent residence, and citizenship applications through to the oath. It represents clients before the Immigration and Refugee Board, assists with asylum applications and applications to challenge decisions at the Federal Court, and helps businesses with international recruitment from its office on rue Graham-Bell.
immiland-montreal:
Immiland is a Montreal immigration consulting company that helps families, workers and students plan a move to Canada, and it works in Spanish.

Its services cover immigration, recruitment, education, translation and settlement, along with support for working in Canada, studying in Canada and tourist visas. The company holds more than 100 education agreements with colleges, universities and institutes recognized as Designated Learning Institutions, which lets it process study permits. It also addresses practical settlement questions such as choosing a neighbourhood. Immiland is regulated by the Law Society of Ontario and the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants, and its office is on Rue Parthenais.
imtiaz-ahmad-law-office-toronto:
Immigration, real estate and business law are handled at Imtiaz Ahmad Law Office, a Toronto firm on Danforth Avenue. Its immigration work covers the Federal Skilled Worker program, International Experience Canada, the Start-Up Visa Program and family sponsorship.

Real estate services include residential and commercial purchases, sales and leasing, development matters such as land acquisition and zoning, mortgages and refinancing, and title searches, for individuals, businesses and developers across Canada. Business law services extend from entity formation for start-ups to mergers and acquisitions for established corporations. The office, at 1100 Danforth Avenue, is open Monday to Friday from 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
incorporation-gatineau:
Incorporation Gatineau is a Gatineau business law service covering incorporation, registration and legal structure for new companies. It works under the Décarie Avocats name, and the team consists of business lawyers in Gatineau and Sorel-Tracy.

Incorporating brings a patrimony separate from that of the shareholders, limited personal liability, a lower tax rate than for an individual, and the ability to keep earnings in the company for later use. The lawyers advise on whether and when to incorporate, file the incorporation and registration with the government, and help avoid common structuring errors. The address is 3 Rue de Picardie, Suite 200.
infinity-law-firm-mississauga:
Infinity Law Firm in Mississauga offers real estate, immigration, notary and business law services in Ontario. Real estate work covers residential and commercial purchases, sales and leasing as well as property disputes, while immigration services include visa applications and status adjustments.

Notary services cover document verification, signatures and attestations, and business law services cover formation, contracts, compliance and dispute resolution. Arashdeep Sidhu is part of the team, and the office is on Thamesgate Drive.
infinity-law-victoria:
Infinity Law is a Victoria, BC firm offering real estate, corporate, family, estate and immigration services on Vancouver Island.

The firm was founded in 2013 through the union of two Victoria law firms. It has two Victoria offices, Broadmead and Downtown, plus offices in Mill Bay, Nanaimo and Vancouver. Its service area covers Sidney, Sooke, Esquimalt, Oak Bay, Saanich, Langford, Colwood and Metchosin, and its work extends across Vancouver Island. Practice areas also include estate planning and administration, commercial litigation and immigration services in Victoria and Nanaimo.
inna-kogan-law-office-toronto:
Led by lawyer Inna Kogan, Inna Kogan Law Office in Toronto handles Express Entry, permanent residence, permits, sponsorships and Federal Court appeals. Kogan is a member of the Law Society of Ontario and a public notary, and the firm also covers provincial nominee programs, humanitarian and compassionate applications, refugee protection, temporary resident permits, citizenship, and business and investor immigration.

It challenges refusals and delays at the Federal Court, including through mandamus applications, and appears before the Immigration and Refugee Board. Kogan oversees each file personally, and the team works in English, Ukrainian, Russian, Hebrew and Persian. Meetings are held online by Zoom, and the office is on Eglinton Avenue East in Toronto.
insight-law-professional-corporation:
Insight Law Professional Corporation is a Toronto firm handling real estate, business and corporate law, wills and estates, and notary services.

Its lawyers have over 23 years of combined experience and have represented more than 1,100 clients across Ontario. Real estate work covers residential, commercial, recreational and rural purchases, sales, refinancing, leasing and condo status matters. Offices are in Toronto, near Yonge and Eglinton, and in Ottawa. The lawyers work in English, French, Turkish and basic Italian. The notary side of the practice handles affidavits, certified true copies, travel consent letters and witnessed signatures.

(Yehuda) Levinson, Elham Akhoondan and Mohammad Shirazi, the office and finance manager.
jag-virk-lawyers-hamilton:

jahanshahi-business-law-firm-north-york:

jbrennan-law-london:

jeffrey-i-reisman-north-york:
Jeffrey Reisman is a criminal defence lawyer in North York serving Toronto and the GTA on bail hearings, impaired driving, assault and drug charges.

Practice areas include sexual and domestic assault, probation violations, fraud and theft, property offences and murder. The firm is available around the clock.
jeffrey-r-horricks-law-corporation-vanco:
Jeffrey Horricks Law Corporation is a Vancouver practice handling real estate, corporate and estate law.

Jeffrey Horricks was born and raised in Vancouver, studied at the University of Victoria and earned his Juris Doctor from Bond University in Australia. After returning in 2012 he worked at a corporate and securities firm and then at a boutique criminal law practice, and he established Horricks Law in 2014. The firm serves individuals, families and businesses across Vancouver and the Lower Mainland, with real estate work covering strata properties, mortgages and financing, and development and investment deals. Clients speak directly with the lawyer, and flat-fee options are offered.
jeremie-john-martin-montreal:
Jérémie John Martin is a bilingual Montreal litigation lawyer who practises and pleads in both French and English.

jeremy-m-feuer-real-estate-wills-winnipe:
Jeremy Feuer Law Corporation is a Winnipeg firm handling real estate, wills and probate, with offices in Winnipeg and Selkirk.

jessie-s-brar-criminal-defence-winnipeg:

Simmonds, K.C. His office is at 444 St Mary Avenue.
jim-dean-law-professional-corporation-lo:
Jim Dean Law Professional Corporation is a London, Ontario firm focused on criminal law and wills and estate planning.

jing-zhang-law-firm-mississauga:

jiwa-law-corporation-surrey:

jk-law-corporation-surrey:

Services include examining employment offer letters and contracts, performance management and improvement issues, and non-solicitation and non-competition clauses. The office is on Queen Street West.
lambert-law-victoria:
Lambert Law is a Victoria firm handling personal injury, medical malpractice, motor vehicle tribunal matters and general litigation.

Rory Lambert and his legal team have represented members of the Victoria community for more than 30 years. On medical malpractice, the firm works with doctors, nurses and other medical professionals who assess a case before a decision to sue, and litigation against medical professionals can be costly and take several years. In British Columbia a general two-year limitation period applies, measured from the last date of the treatment alleged to be negligent.
lamont-law-hamilton:
Lamont Law is a Hamilton personal injury firm that focuses on serious and catastrophic injuries, accident benefits and long-term disability denials.

Cases for Hamilton and the GTA include motor vehicle accidents, dog attacks, slip and falls, medical and nursing home negligence, wrongful death, brain injuries and spinal cord injuries, and the firm only takes catastrophic injury matters with an estimated value above $50,000. Erica Lamont, who was born in Hamilton, studied at the University of Waterloo and the University of Calgary and was admitted to the Law Society of Ontario in 2014. She is joined by lawyer Braden Adsett and paralegals Carrie Stewart and Phil Vivian.
lamprey-law-professional-corporation-bar:
Lamprey Law is a Barrie firm handling real estate, mortgages, wills, powers of attorney and estate administration for clients in Barrie and Simcoe County.

Peter Lamprey graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School in 1979, began practising in 1981 and has worked exclusively in the Barrie area since. Jenna Goorts, an Osgoode graduate of 2017 who first worked at the firm as a summer student, practises real estate and wills and estates, and serves on a Simcoe County board for MADD Canada. After years in an early twentieth-century house on Worsley Street, the firm moved to Bayfield Street, where the office has parking and is wheelchair accessible.
landings-llp-toronto:
Landings LLP is a downtown Toronto law firm acting in refugee, immigration, citizenship and human rights matters. It represents people seeking refugee protection and temporary or permanent status, handles appeals to the Immigration Appeal Division and Refugee Appeal Division, humanitarian and compassionate applications, pre-removal risk assessments, detention and inadmissibility issues, and acts in constitutional litigation, including at the Supreme Court of Canada.

Partners Jacqueline Swaisland, Warda Shazadi Meighen and Erin V. Simpson lead the team. Its lawyers include former adjudicators of the Immigration and Refugee Board, lawyers who have worked with the United Nations and law school adjunct faculty, and the firm also advises non-governmental organizations and works with clients internationally.
lange-law-winnipeg:
Lange Law is a Winnipeg firm focused on real estate, wills and estate planning, and estate administration, with service at the client's door.

The firm prefers to help first-time home buyers, people selling a long-held family home, those building a dream home and families settling a loved one's estate, rather than banks or large corporate clients. Under its at-your-door service, a team member known as the Runner brings the documents to the client's home and returns them to the office, so clients can avoid travelling downtown. The firm assists several generations of the same family.
laperle-bouchard-avocats:
Laperle Bouchard Avocats is a Drummondville firm handling criminal law, penal law and youth law from an office at 164 Rue Saint-Georges.

The lawyers also accept legal aid mandates, and the firm presents settlement options when a trial is not needed while remaining ready to go to court when it is. Its lawyers negotiate and regularly plead before the courts. The firm's values are trust, competence and friendliness, and it handles family law alongside criminal matters.
laredo-law-toronto:
Laredo Law is a Toronto estates firm preparing wills, trusts and tax-aware succession plans and acting in estate administration.

The firm was founded in 2007 by Lisa Laredo, a Certified Trust and Estate Practitioner through STEP Canada who belongs to the Canadian Bar Association, the Ontario Bar Association and the Estate Planning Council of Canada. She also teaches accredited programs for lawyers and writes for legal journals. Associate lawyer Ana Wagner and a legal administrative assistant are on the team. The firm also has a real estate law practice and publishes a blog on wills and estates topics in plain language. The office is on Davisville Avenue.
larson-lawyers-professional-corporation:
Larson Lawyers Professional Corporation is a Thunder Bay firm handling real estate, wills, powers of attorney and probate.

The firm has served Thunder Bay since 1996, and its founder, Rene Larson, has worked with people on legal issues for five decades. It keeps traditional personal service alive, including house calls and hospital visits for wills and powers of attorney. Real estate work covers drafting offers, closings, family transfers, refinancing, land development for builders, zoning variances and appearances before the Ontario Land Tribunal. It also handles family law, corporate work and trusts, and its office is on Victoria Avenue East.
lawden-kunal-kapoor-law:
LawDen, run by Kunal Kapoor Law Professional Corporation in Brampton, handles real estate, immigration, family, criminal and civil matters. Its practice areas also include insurance matters.

Litigation work covers contract and property disputes and employment issues, from pre-trial negotiations and mediation through to the courtroom. Kunal Kapoor is the barrister and solicitor, Ambica Kapoor is office manager, and a team member is listed as Saurav K. The firm offers tailored legal strategies, confidentiality and flexible payment options for individuals and businesses. Its office is on Camberley Crescent in Brampton.
lawpoint-north-york:
Lawpoint is a North York immigration firm handling visa refusal appeals, inadmissibility, permanent residence and work permits. Licensed in Ontario since 2008, it acts for individuals, families and businesses worldwide on matters from a first visitor visa to citizenship, including Express Entry, provincial nominee programs, study permits, LMIA applications and spousal and family sponsorship.

Litigation work includes inadmissibility hearings, mandamus applications and Federal Court proceedings after refusals, alongside humanitarian and compassionate applications, refugee matters and the restoration of permanent resident status. Immigration lawyer Tatiana Gulyaeva practises with the firm. Visits to the Yonge Street office near Finch Station are by appointment only.
lawrence-al-kabain-laval:
In Laval and Montreal, Lawrence Al Kabain practises civil law, covering real estate, insurance, estates and contract disputes.

Practice areas are real estate, insurance, estates, and civil and commercial law, with services offered across Quebec. Matters that bring people to the practice include problems discovered after buying a house, such as water infiltration, foundation or roofing defects; refusals or low valuations by insurers; landlord disputes over repossession and rent increases; contested wills and slow estate liquidations; unpaid invoices addressed by formal demand letters; and disputed contracts.
laws-and-beyond-calgary:
Laws & Beyond is a Calgary firm handling family law, civil litigation, wills and estates, real estate and employment matters.

Family matters include separation, divorce, emergency protection orders, spousal and child support, parenting arrangements, marital agreements and family violence, and Alberta now frames custody as decision-making responsibility and parenting time. The firm uses negotiation, mediation and other alternative dispute resolution where feasible but is prepared to go to court when required. It also offers notarization and commissioning services, and its approach is tailored to each client's goals and circumstances.
lawstop-criminal-lawyers-brampton:
In Brampton, LawStop Criminal Lawyers defend people under police investigation, at bail hearings and against criminal charges. When a person is being investigated, the firm communicates with police on that person's behalf, and its defence work runs from minor offences to complex cases.

Lawyers work in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu. The firm serves Brampton, Mississauga, Caledon, Toronto, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville and Burlington from its office on Pertosa Drive, and also takes civil litigation matters.
lawyer-up-canada-richmond-hill:
Lawyer UP Canada is a Richmond Hill criminal defence firm representing people charged with offences such as fraud, theft and assault in Ontario.

The firm provides full criminal defence services to people charged with criminal offences who also face related legal consequences. The charges it covers in plain language include fraud, theft, assault, robbery, mischief, failure to remain at the scene of an accident, and harassment and uttering threats. The office is located on Highway 7 in Richmond Hill.
lawyerg-calgary:
LawyerG is a Calgary law office led by Gurpreet Aulakh, handling real estate, corporate and commercial law, wills and family matters.

The firm is full service, with a focus on real property and on corporate and commercial work. For home buyers and sellers it covers real property reports and land title transfers; for families it also prepares prenuptial and cohabitation contracts, and it offers notary services such as travel documents. Civil litigation and personal injury are also practice areas. Gurpreet Aulakh holds law and business degrees, a cyber crime investigation certification, and memberships in the Law Society of Alberta, Legal Aid Alberta and the Calgary Bar Association.
lawyerrealtor-ca-toronto:
Anita Verma works as both a lawyer and a realtor at LawyerRealtor, a Toronto practice covering real estate, immigration and wills and estates. Operating as Verma Law P.C., the practice also prepares family law contracts and small business contracts.

For home buyers and sellers, it offers a land transfer tax calculator, information on the first-time home buyer rebate and non-resident vendors, and checklists for purchases, sales and refinancing. Anita has communicated with clients over WhatsApp, and meetings at the Liberty Street office are by appointment only.
lazar-law-firm-london:
Lazar Law Firm is a London, Ontario firm covering real estate, business, wills and estates, family law and paralegal services.

Its real estate practice handles residential and commercial purchases and sales, mortgage refinances and private mortgages, with title searches and closing coordination. The business side covers asset and share transactions, business purchases and sales, commercial leasing, start-ups and incorporation. Wills services include single, multiple and mirror wills for couples, plus estate administration and applications for a Certificate of Appointment of Estate Trustee. Its paralegal and civil services extend to lower-value civil court matters, the Landlord and Tenant Board and Provincial Offences Court.
lazarus-legal-montreal:
Established in 1967, Lazarus Legal is a Montreal law firm that advises clients in emerging industries.

Edwin D. Monzon, called to the Quebec Bar in 2004, is managing partner and works in the gaming and corporate industry. The firm's people include Patrick Baghdisar, Audrey Baillairgé, Tim Buckingham, Marc Charbonneau, David Chislaru, Ian Cook, Alexander Di Giovanni, Vanessa Di Tullio, René R. Gauthier and John Giammarella. A notarial division handles real estate acquisitions, refinancing and condominium projects, along with non-contentious family law procedures, in English, French and Italian. The firm's core values are kindness and respect, trust, teamwork, success, growth and innovation, and courage and optimism.
lca-avocats-inc:
LCA Avocats is a Terrebonne firm, with offices in Repentigny and Rosemère, handling civil, real estate, construction, business, labour and family law.

Its mission is to provide a full range of legal services to individuals, entrepreneurs and small and medium-sized businesses. Its fields also include housing law, municipal law and regulatory penal law, and the lawyers act as legal advisers and business partners. Recent publications cover an employer's duties for company vehicles and employees' driving licences, a Tribunal administratif du logement ruling on pet clauses in leases, and Quebec's new régime d'union parentale.
lcg-avocats-inc-quebec-city:
Formed by a 2022 merger, LCG Avocats is a Quebec City firm covering civil, family, business, criminal, immigration and labour law.

The name stands for Labadie Carrier Guay, created from the merger of Côté Carrier avocats and L2 avocats. Civil litigation work includes commercial disputes, personal injury and medical liability, professional liability, wrongful dismissal, psychological harassment, construction law, latent defects, consumer protection, defamation and class actions. Other practice areas are public and administrative law and professional law and ethics, with an office on Chemin Sainte-Foy.
ld-law-llp-toronto:
LD Law LLP is a Toronto firm handling real estate closings, mortgage refinances, title issues and title insurance across Ontario.

The firm acts for buyers, sellers and owners of residential and commercial property, and also takes on real estate litigation. Further practice areas include wills and estate planning, family law and business law, along with employment, corporate and commercial matters. David Baptista dos Reis and Daniel La Gamba are the lawyers named, and real estate services are also offered in Brantford.
ldr-law-professional-corporation-toronto:
Founded in 2022 by Leslie Robinson, LDR Law Professional Corporation handles real estate, wills and estates for Toronto clients. Mr. Robinson works with individuals, families and businesses across Toronto and the GTA on purchases, sales and refinancing, new condominiums, cottage and waterfront properties, private lending, title transfers and Land Registry corrections.

Estate planning and administration are the other main areas, supported by tax planning knowledge and an advanced wills and estates program from Osgoode Hall Law School. Clients range from first-time home buyers to people with corporate holdings who need succession planning, and the firm also provides commissioner of oaths and notary services. Before law school, Mr. Robinson worked in social work.
le-cabinet-m-saint-jerome:
Le Cabinet M is a Saint-Jerome firm that acts for people seeking compensation after an accident, a crime or a disability.

Founded in 1980, the firm works only on compensation matters: road accidents handled through the SAAQ, workplace accidents and occupational diseases before the CNESST, victims of crime (IVAC), pension applications to Retraite Québec, medical errors, disability insurance and childhood family violence. Its lawyers and their team act across Quebec, including the Greater Montreal area, and the firm works in French.
le-groupe-campeau-raymond-inc-montreal:
Criminal and penal defence at trial and on appeal, up to the Supreme Court of Canada, is the work of Le Groupe Campeau Raymond in Montreal.

Lawyers Campeau and Raymond have acted in matters including a stay of proceedings in a large drug investigation, a stay for unreasonable delay on securities-law fines above 240,000 dollars confirmed by the Quebec Court of Appeal, an acquittal on unstamped tobacco fines above 200,000 dollars, and a Court of Appeal order for a new trial in a first-degree murder case. Me Raymond appeared for the AQAAD, the Quebec defence lawyers' association, before the Supreme Court of Canada in Sharma, on conditional sentences.
leadright-law-barrie:
From its Barrie office, LeadRight Law offers real estate, family, criminal, immigration and estates services.

Principal lawyer Sreejith Subrahmanian has more than a decade of experience and worked with domestic and international law firms before founding the practice. Services are offered in English, Malayalam, Hindi and Tamil. Real estate work includes the purchase, sale and lease of commercial property and the drafting of contracts and leases, family work includes pre-nuptial agreements and parenting plans, and notary services include powers of attorney for selling overseas property. Fees may be flat fees or limited scope retainers.
league-and-williams-lawyers-victoria:
League and Williams Lawyers is a Victoria, BC firm handling personal injury, estate, business, marine and real estate law.

The firm is headquartered in Victoria with offices in Vancouver, Duncan, Campbell River and Kelowna, and serves clients from around the world with legal issues in British Columbia. It brings more than 160 years of experience to its areas of law. Its work covers car accidents, estate planning and disputes, including who can dispute a will in BC, and marine matters such as boating accidents, seized boats and anchoring or mooring concerns.
leblanc-dingman-avocats:
Leblanc & Dingman Avocats is a Sherbrooke firm handling criminal defence and penal matters, with youth law also among its areas of practice. It operates from an office on Rue Belvedere Nord.

The lawyers work on defence for people facing an investigation, a charge or a trial, and follow the case through each stage of the procedure. The firm takes time to understand each situation, assess what is at stake and build a strategy suited to the client, anticipating how a file may develop rather than only reacting. Confidentiality and a personalized approach are central to its practice.
lebrun-provencher-trois-rivieres:
Founded in 1947, LeBrun Provencher is a Trois-Rivieres firm whose lawyers practise criminal and penal law.

Its office is on rue Hart in Trois-Rivieres. The team has built up experience in criminal and penal matters over the years, and its lawyers are attentive to the concerns that a court process can raise and to the individual needs of each client. The firm's approach is based on discretion, efficiency and competence, delivered with professionalism and respect.
lecker-and-associates-north-york:
Lecker & Associates is a North York employment law firm acting only for employees in wrongful and constructive dismissal and severance matters.

Founded in 1984, the firm has worked for Ontario employees for over 40 years and has acted for more than 10,000 clients. Its subjects also include discrimination, harassment, denied disability benefits and forced resignation from toxic workplaces. Its lawyers have litigated precedent-setting cases, and the firm serves Toronto and North York, working for Ontario workers.
lee-and-associates-north-york:
Lee & Associates is a North York personal injury firm acting for injured people in litigation, arbitration, mediation and negotiation. The firm was started in 2006 by Andrew, a former named partner at another firm, to focus on acting for plaintiffs, and its practice is limited to injured individuals rather than insurance companies or corporations. Fees are billed on contingency, so no fees or expenses are owed unless money is recovered.

The multicultural staff offers services in Arabic, Armenian, Belarusian, Bengali, Cantonese, French, Greek, Gujarati, Hindi, Italian, Korean, Malayalam, Mandarin, Punjabi, Russian, Tamil, Urdu and Vietnamese. Clients are seen at an office on Yonge Street.
lee-and-company-north-york:
Lee and Company is a North York boutique immigration firm focused on litigation, appeals and removals defence. Active since 2001, it acts for people whose cases were refused overseas or who face deportation in Canada, and has appeared before all divisions of the Immigration and Refugee Board, the Federal Court and the Federal Court of Appeal.

Humanitarian and compassionate applications, appeals to the Immigration Appeal Division and temporary resident permits to overcome inadmissibility are among the routes it pursues. Lawyer Wennie Lee appears regularly at the Federal Court, and the team includes immigration consultants Marko Vitorovich and Mohamed Abuzayed and Ray Radojevic, who retired from Citizenship and Immigration Canada as a Canada Immigration Centre Manager.
legal-focus-llp:
Legal Focus LLP is a Windsor firm handling personal injury, estates and probate, real estate and civil litigation matters.

Partner Marcela S. Aroca was appointed a judge of the Tax Court of Canada. The team includes a partner in civil litigation and personal injury, associates in civil, tax and estate litigation, wills and estates, property disputes, corporate, commercial and real estate work, and law clerks who are also licensed paralegals. The firm is guided by integrity, transparency and client education, and its personal injury work covers motor vehicle accidents and slip and fall cases.
legal-route-brampton:
Business, family, real estate, criminal, personal injury and estate law are all offered by Legal Route, a full-service firm in Brampton.

Founder Vinay Thapliyal conceived the firm in 2017 while studying law at the University of Windsor, after noticing that many firms practise in only a few areas. The practice also covers civil litigation and construction law, and its business law work includes formation, contracts, compliance, mergers and acquisitions. Meetings take place virtually or in person, and clients are served across the Greater Toronto Area and in cities such as Ottawa, Hamilton, London, Kitchener and Windsor.
legal-solutions-law-firm-toronto:
Legal Solutions Law Firm is a Toronto practice handling criminal, family, traffic, landlord-tenant and civil litigation matters. Founded in 2012 by Ryan Manilla, a barrister, solicitor and notary public, it also acts in regulatory proceedings and in disputes over unpaid goods and services, and serves Scarborough, North York, Mississauga, Brampton, Markham, Richmond Hill and Vaughan.

Manilla graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School and spent two years at a New York City law firm before returning to Toronto. The firm offers flat fees and payment plans, and its Scarborough office is on Milner Business Court.
leiter-rahme-attorneys-inc-montreal:
Leiter Rahme Attorneys is a Montreal firm handling Canadian and American immigration law for clients around the world.

The firm has its head office in Montreal and additional offices in the Middle East and the Gulf. Clients come from dozens of countries, among them China, Iran, Lebanon, France, Mexico, India, Nigeria, Brazil and the Philippines. The lawyers serve clients in English, French, Mandarin, Spanish, Arabic, Portuguese, Romanian, Italian and Hebrew, and assist applicants with temporary or permanent visa applications and with challenging decisions by immigration authorities.
lemieux-litigation-barrie:
Lemieux Litigation is a Barrie boutique litigation firm handling personal injury, employment and family law matters.

Its local lawyers serve all of Simcoe County, including Barrie, Innisfil, Orillia, Midland and Alliston, as well as Bradford, Newmarket and Collingwood. Injury work covers motor vehicle accidents, slip and falls and long-term disability. On the employment side the firm handles wrongful termination and workplace sexual harassment. Family law matters include divorce, child and spousal support, custody and access, and separation and parenting agreements. Nicole Meringolo and Melissa Ritter are the lawyers featured.
lerners-llp:
Lerners LLP is a full-service law firm based in London, Ontario, with additional offices in Toronto, Waterloo Region and Strathroy.

The firm has served clients across Ontario for more than 95 years and now has more than 130 lawyers. Its approach centres on listening to the client's story before shaping an outcome. Topics the firm addresses include workforce planning for manufacturers, structuring manufacturing facility acquisitions to limit real estate risk, and how long estate litigation takes in Ontario, from mediation through discovery, trial and appeals.
leveille-et-associes:
Leveille et Associes is a Gatineau firm established in 1996 handling family law, criminal law, housing disputes, and civil and commercial matters. A team of lawyers works across many areas of law.

Family services include divorce, separation, child custody and access, child and spousal support, division of property, amicable agreements and preparation for mediation. The firm also acts in criminal defence and in landlord and tenant matters before the housing tribunal, the Régie du logement. The office is at 255 Boulevard Saint-Joseph in Gatineau.
levitt-llp-toronto:
Levitt LLP is a Toronto labour and employment law firm that represents employers and employees across Canada.

The firm says it has been practising for over 40 years. It advises on wrongful dismissal, terminations, layoffs, severance, employment contracts, human rights and discrimination matters, and union certification and grievances, and it acts at all levels of court and before labour relations boards, grievance arbitrators and human rights tribunals.
lewis-et-associes-sencrl:
Lewis et Associes SENCRL is a Montreal-listed firm practising immigration and refugee law, from refugee protection to family sponsorship.

Operating as Lewis & Associates LLP, the firm has its office in Toronto at Yonge and Eglinton and was founded in 1991 by Jacqueline Lewis. Services include super visas, temporary resident visas, supported work permits tied to labour market impact assessments, family class sponsorship, pre-removal risk assessments, humanitarian and compassionate applications and Immigration Division admissibility hearings. The firm also handles Federal Court appeals of study permit and visa refusals. It has more than 30 years of immigration experience and a team of 25 immigration and refugee lawyers.
lex-magnus-law-professional-corporation-:
Lex Magnus Law is a Toronto firm serving the GTA in criminal defence, family law, immigration, civil litigation, real estate and wills and estates.

The name combines the Latin words lex, meaning law, and magnus, meaning great. The firm describes its work as client-centred advocacy for individuals, families and businesses.
li-cheng-business-and-real-estate-law-ha:
Serving Hamilton, Burlington and Oakville, Li Cheng Business & Real Estate Law handles residential and commercial real estate and business law. The firm has been in practice for more than ten years.

Li Cheng previously worked for all three levels of government advising on major public land development projects, and now acts for developers, lenders, businesses and home buyers and sellers. His work includes residential development projects ranging from $10 million to $200 million, as well as purchases, sales, refinancing, title transfers and private mortgages. Offices serve Hamilton, Burlington, St. Catharines and the Niagara Region, and services are available in English, Mandarin, Cantonese and Arabic.
liberty-law-llp-edmonton:
Liberty Law LLP is an Edmonton criminal defence firm that represents people charged with offences at every level of Alberta courts.

The firm practises criminal defence only. Its lawyers appear in Provincial Court, the Court of King's Bench and the Court of Appeal, and matters include murder, sexual assault, drug and weapon offences, domestic violence, impaired driving and appeals. Besides its downtown Edmonton office, it has offices in Grande Prairie and Fort McMurray, and it serves Alberta, Saskatchewan and the Northwest Territories. A team of more than twenty lawyers includes senior trial and appellate counsel.
licata-law-north-york:
Licata Law is a boutique firm in North York handling real estate, family, commercial and mining law matters. Its fertility work covers surrogacy and IVF agreements.

Real estate services cover residential and commercial properties and power of sale procedures, while the family practice covers contracts and litigation. In mining, the firm acts for small, medium-sized and large businesses in the mining and natural resources sector in South America. Caterina Licata founded the firm, which serves clients across Toronto from its Yonge Street office. Most of its business comes from existing clients and referrals.
linq-law-edmonton:
LinQ Law is a full-service South Edmonton firm covering family law, real estate, business law, bankruptcy and insolvency, and estates. The firm has served Edmonton since 2016.

Family work includes divorce, child custody, child support, adoption and mediation. The practice also takes on personal injury, criminal defence and civil litigation, and it advises both lenders and borrowers on real estate matters. Through a network of partner lawyers it also supports Canadian firms looking to do business and expand, and it offers flexible payment structures.
lions-gate-law-corporation-vancouver:
Lions Gate Law Corporation is a Vancouver firm handling real estate conveyancing, mortgage refinances, incorporations, and wills and estates.

Services include commercial conveyancing and mortgage refinances, and its lawyers are mobile. The firm's office is on West Georgia Street in downtown Vancouver. Its lawyers hold degrees from the University of British Columbia, the London School of Economics and McGill University.
llf-lawyers-llp:
LLF Lawyers LLP is a Peterborough firm, founded in 1993, with a second office in Bobcaygeon and practice in business, real estate, estates and litigation.

The firm has 16 lawyers and more than 50 professionals in total, and acts for individuals and corporations with a collaborative, budget-conscious approach. It also advises nonprofits and charities on governance and procedural matters. Partners include Phil Aldrich, Jim Baird, Emmet Connolly, Jeff Lanctot, Pete Lawless, Le Nguyen, Chris Russell and Tammy Williams. Recent articles cover the October 2026 ONCA deadline for share capital social clubs and new ISC registry rules. The Peterborough office is on Aylmer Street North.
lm-law-group-toronto:
LM Law Group is a Toronto immigration firm handling study permits, work permits, permanent residence, visitor visas, Express Entry and citizenship applications.

Founded in 2007, the firm has a team of about 25. Partners are Elizabeth Long, Aadil Mangalji and Ziah Sumar, with associates including Erin Levitsky and Catanne Boan-Mitchell. Services are organized by client group: employers, students, permanent residents, workers, visitors, citizens and entrepreneurs. Each case is assessed individually so that the immigration path fits the person, with an empathy-focused approach.
lmrt-immigration-services-montreal:
LMRT Immigration Services is a Montreal team of regulated immigration consultants handling asylum cases, family sponsorship and Express Entry.

The firm has worked on refugee and sponsorship files since 2017, and its founder, Loujin Khalil, is a regulated consultant authorized to appear before the Immigration and Refugee Board. His background includes business immigration streams such as entrepreneur programs, the Start-up Visa and owner-operator. Services are offered in English, French, Arabic and Persian, Quebec programs are covered, appointments can be held online, and guides are published on topics such as the four divisions of the Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada.
longfield-law-professional-corporation-b:
Longfield Law Professional Corporation is a family-operated Brampton firm covering real estate, wills, estates and trusts, and corporate and business law.

Randall A. Longfield founded the firm in 1986, his son Michael joined in 2013, and Meaghan Longfield joined in 2019 to oversee the corporate department. Clients are served throughout Peel and Halton, including Caledon, Bolton, Georgetown, Halton Hills, Oakville, Burlington, Mississauga and Milton. Real estate work includes residential and commercial purchases and sales, mortgage financing and refinancing, private mortgages and title insurance. The estates side prepares wills and powers of attorney, and assists executors with administration and probate.
loopstra-nixon-llp:
Loopstra Nixon LLP is a full-service business and public law firm in Etobicoke, Ontario, with practice groups ranging from real estate to municipal law.

Practice areas include banking and financial services, litigation and dispute resolution, land use planning and development, municipal and insurance litigation, sports law, franchising, technology and intellectual property, labour and employment, wills, trusts and estates, and bankruptcy, insolvency and restructuring. Partners include Jason Beitchman, Mark J. Lieberman, Daniel Steinberg and Matthew Vella, and the firm works beyond Canada through affiliates in the LawExchange International network.
lou-vadala:
Lou Vadala Professional Corporation is a Kingston law office, founded in 2000, handling real estate, wills and estates, corporate and family matters.

Real estate, wills and estates and corporate law are the main areas, with family law, litigation and notary public and Commissioner of Oaths services among other practice areas. The team has served clients across the province and worldwide for more than 20 years. Team members include Lou Vadala, Anthony Vadala, Jake Wright, Steven King, Dianne LaFortune and Josh Vaters. Corporate work is aimed at entrepreneurs, founders, owners, lenders, partnerships and small businesses.
lt-lawyers-llp-calgary:
LT Lawyers LLP is a Calgary boutique firm representing injured people and those denied long-term disability benefits in Alberta and British Columbia.

Co-founders Ryan Lee and Peter Trieu lead the firm; Lee previously acted for insurance companies in personal injury cases and has appeared before the Alberta Court of King's Bench and the Supreme Court of British Columbia. Two of its lawyers are former criminal prosecutors, and Daniel Gelb, Faye Gelb and Bridget Belsher are also on the team. Matters include car crashes, injuries caused by negligence and long-term disability denials and terminations, with strategies ranging from settlement to trial.
lucenti-orlando-professional-corporation:
Lucenti Orlando Professional Corporation is a North Bay firm practising family, estates, corporate, real estate, tax and civil litigation law.

Robert Lucenti joined the established firm of Ernest Loukidelis and Michael G. Bolan in 1969, and several of the firm's lawyers were later appointed to the Superior Court of Ontario. Sandro Orlando joined in 1984, Mark Lucenti in 2009 and Ryan Leckie in 2017. Family law work highlights collaborative family law, separation, marriage and cohabitation agreements, divorce and support. Civil litigation covers employment disputes and debt collection, and the firm has practised in North Bay for more than 55 years.
luk-associates:
Luk & Associates is a Markham law firm offering family law, real estate, corporate, immigration, and wills and estates services across Ontario.

The office is on Highway 7 in Markham, Ontario. The firm's five practice areas together cover personal matters such as family separations and estate planning, property purchases and sales, and corporate and immigration work. Details about individual lawyers or the firm's history are not given in this profile, which sets out only the firm's location, the area it serves and its practice areas.
lydia-h-thomson-law-corporation-kelowna:
Thomson Law is a small Kelowna firm centred on family law and family mediation, serving Kelowna, West Kelowna and Lake Country.

Lydia Thomson, whose practice operates as Lydia H. Thomson Law Corporation, opened the firm in the summer of 2007 after years at a local firm. She graduated from the University of Saskatchewan College of Law, has practised in Kelowna for 18 years and is accredited by the Law Society of British Columbia as a family law mediator. Other services are wills and estates, committeeship and residential conveyancing, along with help for parents involved with the Ministry. Brandon is another lawyer on the team, and many referrals come from past clients.
lyon-stern-immigration-law-winnipeg:
Permanent residence, work and study permits, sponsorship and business immigration are covered by Lyon Stern Immigration Law, a full-service Winnipeg firm.

The firm, also known as Lyon Stern Partners, works through a global network of lawyers, consultants and other immigration professionals and acts for individuals, families and businesses.
