Tweyman, Rachel Nusinoff, Farzana Jiwani, Zachary Biggs and Gary Stern. Service areas include North York, Scarborough, Newmarket, Oshawa, Vaughan, Markham and Richmond Hill, and meetings can take place by video or audio link.
monique-j-charlebois-oakville:
Estate administration, will drafting and dispute resolution are the practice of Monique Charlebois, a bilingual lawyer in Oakville. She has more than 20 years of experience in Ontario estates law and is a former Senior Estates Counsel with the Ontario Office of the Public Guardian and Trustee.

Services include advising estate trustees, obtaining a Certificate of Appointment of Estate Trustee with or without a will, acting as estate trustee, preparing wills, living wills and powers of attorney for property and personal care, and locating missing beneficiaries. She also helps beneficiaries understand the distribution of a deceased person's assets. The office is on Cornwall Road in Oakville.
monkhouse-law-employment-lawyers:
Monkhouse Law Employment Lawyers is a Toronto firm representing employees in wrongful dismissal, severance and constructive dismissal matters.

Founded in 2013 by Andrew Monkhouse, the firm has grown to 23 employment lawyers and 14 paralegals. It acts for employees and independent contractors in Toronto and throughout Ontario, from advice and negotiation through mediation, trial and appeals. Subjects also include employment contracts, layoffs, human rights, disability and accommodation, and compensation disputes. Its lawyers have appeared in more than 100 reported court decisions, and the firm has employment class action experience. Managing partners include Andrew Monkhouse and Alexandra Monkhouse.
mont-walker-law-corporation:
Mont & Walker Law Corporation is a Nanaimo firm handling real estate, wills and estates, and corporate and commercial law.

Lawyers Rod Mont, Sonya Parkin, Esther Robson, Chris Murphy and Abby Morrison work with a support staff of 11, and the group has around 100 years of legal experience between them. The firm is one of the oldest in Nanaimo and the successor of a practice founded before 1920. Rod Mont moved to Nanaimo in 1993 but is not currently taking new clients.
montgomery-miles-stone-law-firm:
Montgomery Miles & Stone Law Firm is a Kelowna firm handling real estate, corporate law, wills, trusts and estates for Okanagan individuals and businesses.

It is a solicitors' boutique, with lawyers Richard Montgomery, Dave Miles, Deanna Stone, Peter Borszcz and Allisa Wu. Its office is on the fifth floor of the Landmark 2 building. Many clients live and operate businesses throughout the Okanagan, and the firm also represents clients across Canada and internationally.
moph-legal-calgary:
Moph Legal is a Calgary firm serving individuals, businesses, developers and lenders across Alberta on real estate, private lending and business transactions.

Its services also include wills, enduring powers of attorney, personal directives and notary services. The firm says its work is tailored to each matter and begins with a clear understanding of the client's goals.
mor-fisher-llp-barrie:
Mor Fisher LLP, based in Barrie, defends people and businesses facing criminal, quasi-criminal and regulatory charges across Ontario. The firm does defence work only, covering impaired and dangerous driving, domestic and sexual assault, drug trafficking, firearms offences, fraud, robbery and youth criminal charges, as well as bail hearings, criminal appeals and dangerous offender applications. It also advises people and businesses under investigation and handles provincial offences and professional discipline.

The team includes Jaime Mor, Jeffrey Fisher, David Wilcox and David Lakie, who appear at courthouses across Central and Northern Ontario. The main office is in downtown Barrie, steps from the Superior Court of Justice, and the firm also serves Orillia, Collingwood, Midland, Bradford, Parry Sound and Toronto. Legal Aid certificates are accepted, and flat-fee billing is offered for most matters.
morasse-avocats:
Morasse Avocats is a Montreal criminal and penal law firm defending people charged with offences such as impaired driving and traffic violations. It works in French and was founded to offer a full defence to people facing criminal accusations, guided by the presumption of innocence.

Billing is flat-fee, tied to the outcome sought. Its publications cover defences such as duress, alibi, mental disorder, impossibility and involuntary intoxication, as well as solicitation of sexual services under section 286.1 of the Criminal Code. Matters have included a jury-trial acquittal and a withdrawal of charges at the Quebec Court of Appeal. Offices are at Place d'Armes in Montreal.
moreau-family-law-professional-corporati:
Divorce, spousal support, child support and property division are the focus of Moreau Family Law Professional Corporation in Barrie. The practice also prepares separation agreements and cohabitation or marriage contracts.

It advises on changes in circumstances involving children or finances and explores alternative dispute resolution with each client, aiming for low-cost, low-conflict outcomes. Litigation is recommended and handled when needed. Clients come from Barrie, Orillia, Midland, Collingwood, Angus, Alliston, Innisfil, Springwater, Oro Medonte, Bracebridge and the Muskoka area.
morneau-family-law-and-legal-innovation-:
In Kitchener, Morneau Family Law & Legal Innovation offers separation agreements, mediation and collaborative law. David Morneau Jr. serves families in the Waterloo Region and holds the title of Creative Evolution Officer at the firm.

Services also include cohabitation agreements and marriage contracts, education and training, and mentoring. He speaks at seminars, conferences and symposiums on conflict definition, management and resolution. His approach, built around a written vision, mission and set of values, treats family separation as mostly emotional rather than legal and aims to reduce polarization and improve communication.
morrison-williams-llp-oakville:
Oakville families facing divorce, support, custody or property division are served by Morrison Williams LLP, a family law firm. Its lawyers have practised family law exclusively throughout their careers, and matters also include access, spousal support, common-law settlements and the global settlement of a separation.

The process is chosen to suit the family: negotiation, collaboration, mediation, arbitration or litigation. The lawyers work as a team to bring different perspectives and strategy to each matter, and involve other professionals such as financial planners where helpful. The firm focuses on timely service and on a solicitor-client relationship tailored to each client's circumstances.
mosaicstone-law-calgary:
Mosaicstone Law is a small Calgary firm handling estate planning and family law matters, including divorce, separation and child custody.

The firm also offers mediation services and says it aims to keep the process clear for clients dealing with family transitions.
motevalli-law-group-toronto:
Motevalli Law Group defends criminal charges in Toronto and across the Greater Toronto Area. Hossein Motevalli's practice centres on criminal law and litigation, including impaired driving, assault in its various forms, domestic assault under section 266 of the Criminal Code, theft, fraud, and drug possession, trafficking and importing charges.

The firm acts in Toronto, North York, Mississauga, Brampton, Scarborough, Aurora, Newmarket and Oshawa and also takes family law and civil litigation matters. Fees can be arranged as flat rates or payment plans, and the office is on Church Street in Toronto.
moyal-immigration-lawyers-north-york:
Moyal Immigration Lawyers, the Law Offices of Moyal & Moyal, is a North York firm practising only Canadian immigration law. Its work covers inland and overseas applications, including independent and skilled worker, humanitarian and compassionate, provincial nominee and Express Entry applications, sponsorships and work permits.

Lawyer Henry Moyal began working in immigration in 1988, before graduating from Osgoode Hall Law School, and has acted for many members of the Filipino community. He writes a weekly column called Immigration Newsweek for community newspapers and travels abroad to give seminars on Canadian immigration.
mrk-law-professional-corporation-mississ:
MRK Law Professional Corporation is a Mississauga boutique firm covering criminal defence, civil litigation, solicitor services and family law.

Mina R. Khalil is the lawyer and principal, and the firm is rooted in Peel and Halton Region while serving clients across Ontario, including Brampton, Milton and Oakville. Civil work includes employment disputes, wrongful and constructive dismissal and mediation. Solicitor services cover commercial leases, partnership, joint venture and shareholder agreements, and employment or contractor agreements, while family work includes marriage contracts. The firm accepts legal aid certificates for most criminal matters.
mtl-avocat-inc-montreal:
MTL Avocat Inc., also known as Mehdi Tenouri Legal, is a Montreal firm handling immigration to Canada and business law for individuals and companies.

The immigration side covers permanent residence, investor files, study permits and work permits, and the business side covers incorporation, shareholder disputes, commercial disputes, dissolution, bankruptcy and insolvency. The firm works in French and also offers guidance on cybersecurity and cybercrime for small businesses. Me Mehdi Tenouri practised for 12 years in France and taught business and banking law at the Paris bar school. He is an accredited mediator for small-amount civil disputes, and the firm has offices in Montreal and the Montérégie.
muenz-criminal-law-calgary:
Muenz Criminal Law is a Calgary criminal defence firm whose lead lawyer has practised exclusively in criminal law since 1992.

Rick Muenz leads the firm, and Alvin Luximon, Maria Muenz and Giuliana Di Lorenzo are also part of the team. He holds admissions in Alberta (1993) and British Columbia (2001), has worked on cases in five provinces and the Yukon, and teaches in the Advanced Criminal Law Course at the University of Calgary Faculty of Law. Charges handled include sexual assault, domestic assault, impaired driving, drug trafficking, theft and fraud, and youth offences. Staff can walk clients through the legal process in French, Spanish and Italian, and the firm works with The Pardon Group on record suspensions, U.S. entry waivers and digital fingerprinting.
muldoon-and-company-vancouver:
Muldoon & Company are Vancouver trial lawyers handling criminal law, impaired driving, drug charges and personal injury.

The offices are in the historic Marine Building. Don Muldoon has practised since 1981. In 1982 he and Michael Bolton started the criminal firm Bolton & Muldoon, and that tradition continues. Work includes drug possession, trafficking and production, assault including spousal and sexual assault, Immediate Roadside Prohibitions and Administrative Driving Prohibitions. The firm is based in downtown Vancouver and handles cases throughout British Columbia, and its recent cases include a civil forfeiture matter.
mullen-and-company-calgary:
Mullen & Company is a South Calgary firm handling wills, estate, real estate and business law for small-business owners and individuals.

Paul Mullen has been part of the Alberta legal community for more than 40 years. The firm offers services in English and Spanish, provides notary public and commissioner of oaths services, and serves clients in Calgary, Okotoks and High River.
munro-and-crawford-vancouver:
Munro & Crawford is a Kerrisdale firm in Vancouver handling wills, trusts, probate, real estate and business law since 1952.

The firm began as a single office opened by founding partner William Munro, and Peter Crawford joined him in 1973. Its client base has since spread across the Lower Mainland and to other provinces. Estate services include guidance for executors, wills and trusts, and elder care matters. On the business side it handles incorporation, acting as registered and records office, minute books, shareholder and joint venture agreements, and advice on purchases, sales and reorganizations.
murphy-battista-llp:
Murphy Battista LLP is a Vancouver civil litigation and class action firm acting for people who have been injured, abused or financially harmed.

The firm has focused on litigation since 1982, and its practice areas are class action lawsuits, medical malpractice, personal injury cases and MCFD abuse cases. Its class action team challenges governments and corporations on behalf of class members, and clients come from across British Columbia as well as nationally and internationally. Murphy Battista has offices in Vancouver, Surrey, Kelowna and Vernon, and works as a team in which a lawyer with primary responsibility for each file works alongside colleagues.
murray-and-associates-llp-st-catharines:
Murray & Associates LLP is a Niagara Region firm covering real estate, wills and estates, corporate, mortgages, power of sale, family and municipal law.

Formerly Heelis, Litle, Almas and Murray LLP, the practice has served the region for nearly 50 years from 14 Church Street in St. Catharines. Lawyers include H. A. Patrick Little, Bryce W. B. Murray, Adam DiFruscia and William Heelis. Its blend of legal service and client rapport has kept generations of business owners, families and residents returning, and its broad range of practice areas lets it compete with larger firms.
my-visa-source-legal:
My Visa Source Legal is a Toronto immigration firm handling spousal sponsorship, work permits, visitor visas and appeals for families and employers.

The firm is based in Toronto and Vancouver and has been in practice for more than a decade. Its founders are Sonia Mann and Sunny S. Dhillon, who lead a team of immigration lawyers and licensed practitioners. Services are organized around temporary residence, permanent residence, and inadmissibility and litigation, covering misrepresentation, organized criminality, refusals, refugees and Federal Court matters. It also handles Canadian and US visas and publishes immigration news.
myers-llp-winnipeg:
Myers LLP is a Winnipeg-based firm with several practice areas, including administrative law, acting for businesses, unions, governments and First Nations.

The firm opened in 1956 as Tapper and Pollock. Clients also include not-for-profit organizations and Crown corporations, and its lawyers appear at all levels of court, including the Manitoba Court of Appeal and the Supreme Court of Canada, as well as in arbitration. The firm is linked to the annual Mel Myers Labour Conference, and the Manitoba Legislature has recognized the life and legacy of Mel Myers. Recent announcements include new associates and summer students.
nadon-professional-corporation-ottawa:
Real estate and estate planning for Orléans and Ottawa clients is the work of Nadon Professional Corporation. Marc Nadon has more than 25 years of experience in residential real estate law and wills and estate planning, acting for people selling and buying homes or investment properties and working with homeowners and mortgage brokers.

Real estate services cover the purchase, sale and refinancing of residential property for first-time buyers and seasoned investors. Estate work includes powers of attorney for personal care and property, probate applications and estate administration. Christopher Tesseyman is also a lawyer at the firm.
naimark-law-toronto:
Naimark Law is a Toronto personal injury firm representing seriously injured people and their families. Its lawyers all previously defended insurance companies before switching sides, and founder Ryan Naimark did that work for 20 years while also acting for accident victims.

Naimark graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School, was called to the Ontario bar in 1998, became a partner at an insurance defence firm in 2004 and argues cases at all levels of court in Ontario. Because employers are not always sympathetic to employees who are off work after an accident, he also advises injured clients on employment issues, including wrongful dismissal. The office is on Adelaide Street West.
nancy-goncalves-law-office-winnipeg:
Nancy Gonçalves Law Office is a Winnipeg practice offering real estate, wills and estates, family, corporate and notary services.

Nancy M. Gonçalves is a lawyer and notary public who has been in practice since 2006. Areas of practice are real estate transactions, wills and estates, family law, corporate and commercial law and notary services. She holds a B.A. (Honours) from the University of Winnipeg, with a major in psychology and a minor in sociology, and a Juris Doctor from the University of Manitoba. The office is at 883 Notre Dame Avenue.
nanda-associate-lawyers:
Nanda & Associate Lawyers is a Mississauga firm founded in 2003 that began in immigration and real estate law.

Jagmohan S. Nanda started the firm in Mississauga with a primary focus on immigration law and real estate, assisting newcomers to Canada as well as families and small businesses. It is now a full-service firm serving clients across Ontario from the Greater Toronto Area, and meetings can be held in person or by video on Zoom or Microsoft Teams. Its values are client focus, integrity, inclusivity and respect.
nanda-family-and-divorce-lawyers-mississ:
Nanda Family and Divorce Lawyers is a Mississauga firm handling divorce, child custody, child support and financial issues after separation.

The family law team guides clients through the legal steps of ending a marriage, sets up child arrangement orders on where children live and how decisions about their upbringing are made, and addresses financial adjustments after separation. Its Mississauga family lawyers aim for fair resolutions and keep the well-being of children in focus. The office is on Robert Speck Parkway.
nanuq-law-victoria:
Nanuq Law is a Victoria boutique firm handling personal injury, employment law and estate litigation, with real estate and wills also offered.

The firm dates to 2011 and takes its name from Nanuq, the master of the polar bears, comparing the animal's strength to its own approach. Marlisa H. Martin is one of its lawyers. Practice areas include motor vehicle accidents, slip and fall injuries, medical malpractice, injuries at work, pedestrian and bicycle injuries, estate litigation, real estate purchases and leases, and wills and power of attorney. Motor vehicle accident work is taken on a contingency fee basis.
natalia-svechin-law-corporation-winnipeg:
Natalia Svechin Law Corporation is a Winnipeg firm handling immigration, real estate, wills and estates, and notary public matters in four languages. Clients are served in English, Russian, Ukrainian and Hebrew.

Natalia Svechin is licensed by the Law Society of Manitoba and is also an active member of the Israeli Bar Association. She was born in Kyiv, moved to Israel with her family in 1991, was admitted to the Israeli bar in 2008 and founded a firm there in 2009. After her family settled in Winnipeg in 2015, she received a Certificate of Qualification through the National Committee on Accreditation and was admitted to the Manitoba bar. Family law is also among her areas.
nathens-siegel-llp-north-york:
Family law and divorce clients in North York and Mississauga are served by Nathens, Siegel LLP, a firm founded in 1995.

Ken Nathens and Brahm Siegel started the firm, and both are certified in family law by the Law Society of Ontario. Barbara Kristanic and Glen Schwartz are also partners. Lawyers can serve clients in English or French. Matters are resolved by agreement, alternative dispute resolution or in court, and topics include the date of separation and how spousal support is calculated. The lawyers write and speak on family law, and the two offices serve families across the Greater Toronto Area.
nav-law-firm-ottawa:
NAV LAW FIRM is an Ottawa practice handling real estate, family law, wills and estates, immigration and notary public services. Navdeep Singh, its president, graduated from the G.N.D.U law school in Punjab, India in 2007 and practised there in real estate, family law, civil litigation, wills and immigration. After moving to Canada he passed the NCA licensing exam, was licensed in Ontario and became a partner at Ngieme & Associates Law Professional Corporation in Ottawa before opening his own firm.

He has appeared before the Superior Court of Justice in civil and family matters and has handled sales and purchases of residential property. The firm provides family law services to Ottawa and the surrounding area, along with mortgage work, from an office on Somerset Street West.
nazarian-law-toronto:
Nazarian Law acts for Toronto families in divorce, custody, support and property division matters. Its family law work also covers domestic contracts and agreements, separation, parenting arrangements, financial support, alternative dispute resolution and family litigation.

The firm also takes on real estate transactions and business law matters, and Armen Nazarian is among its lawyers. Daniel Luz serves as Director of Operations. Its working values are being accessible, adaptable, collaborative and professional, and its office is on Queens Quay East in Toronto.
ndiaye-enokou-avocats-gatineau:
Ndiaye Enokou Avocats is a Gatineau firm handling immigration, criminal, family and business law in French and English.

The firm, which also uses the name N&E Avocats, operates three offices in Quebec, in Gatineau, Trois-Rivières and Sherbrooke. Immigration work covers temporary and permanent residence, study and work permits, family sponsorship and asylum applications for individuals, families, students and professionals who want to settle in Canada or bring relatives. The firm represents clients before the competent courts and tailors its approach to each situation.
ndm-law-mississauga:
Founded by Navnit Dhillon, NDM Law serves Mississauga and the GTA in family, criminal, corporate, real estate, personal injury and estate law. The office is in Streetsville, and the firm acts for individuals and for corporations, including companies throughout Canada and globally.

Legal services are available in English, Hindi, Polish, Portuguese and Urdu. Ms. Dhillon completed a Bachelor of Law at the University of Leicester in 2008, joined the Ontario bar in 2011 and founded the firm shortly afterward. She has spoken about legal topics on television and radio and gives education seminars.
neha-bains-law-corporation-surrey:
Neha Bains Law Corporation is a Surrey firm focused on immigration and citizenship law, with family law and wills and estates work alongside.

The firm says it serves clients in the Lower Mainland and across Canada, and it lists 13 years of experience. Its site describes its approach as transparent and accurate about each client's legal matters.
neil-brooks-law-corporation-victoria:
Neil Brooks Law Corporation is a Victoria criminal defence firm acting in Charter applications, trials, impaired driving and serious charges. One senior trial lawyer handles each file from intake to verdict, so the lawyer a client meets is the one who argues the case at every appearance.

Matters include drug offences, assault and domestic violence, sexual offences, firearms and weapons offences, bail, sentencing and appeals, before judge and jury and in Provincial Court and the Supreme Court of British Columbia. The practice serves clients across the province, including Victoria, Nanaimo and Duncan, and the lawyer's earlier career ran from a commercial fishing deck to First Officer of Navigation on a large cruise ship.
neinstein-personal-injury-lawyers-toront:
Neinstein Personal Injury Lawyers is a Toronto firm that represents seriously and catastrophically injured people across Ontario.

Its lawyers have practised personal injury law in Ontario since 1970, a span of more than 55 years. Matters include serious car accidents, motorcycle accidents, long-term disability insurance disputes and slip and fall injuries. The firm has argued complex trials in courts across the country and negotiated multi-million dollar settlements, and it works with clients on a contingency basis. Areas served are Toronto, Ontario and Canada.
nelligan-law:
Nelligan Law is an Ottawa multi-practice firm handling employment and labour, estates, real estate, litigation and business matters.

The firm was founded in Ottawa in 1963 by John Nelligan and Denis Power, with Power later appointed to the Ontario Superior Court of Justice, and it now has more than 100 lawyers and business professionals. It serves individuals, families, businesses, nonprofits and associations in Ottawa and across Ontario. Its practice areas also include personal injury, intellectual property, insurance and construction, and it has acted in several major class actions.
ng-sidhu-law-surrey:
Ng Sidhu Law is a Surrey full-service firm handling personal injury, ICBC matters, real estate, wills and estates, criminal, family and immigration law.

The firm has nine offices across British Columbia and serves the Lower Mainland, including Abbotsford, Delta, Langley, New Westminster, Port Coquitlam, Richmond and Vancouver. Services are provided in English, French, Punjabi, Hindi, Mandarin, Cantonese, Sinhalese, Tamil and Spanish. Shawn Sidhu and Zachary Ng are on its team, and its work highlights medical malpractice, ICBC Enhanced Care matters and a communication-first way of working on every file.
nichols-law-professional-corporation-mar:
Nichols Law Professional Corporation is a Markham firm covering real estate, wills, powers of attorney, business law and notary services.

The firm has served clients since 1983 and is run by partners Graham Nichols and Keith Nichols, with associates Zeinab Khan and Ryan Dzingala. Graham Nichols was admitted to the bar in 1983, served as president of the Markham Board of Trade, and chaired the Markham Stouffville Hospital board in 2001. He has practised on Markham Main Street since 1993. Its work covers home refinancing, private lending, executor duties, and starting a business, with clients ranging from young families to growing companies.
nicola-circelli-law-london:
Nicola Circelli Law is a London, Ontario criminal defence practice handling impaired driving, assault, drug and fraud charges.

Nicola Circelli was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2016 after articling with Circelli Law. She holds a history degree from McGill, a law degree from the University of Leicester, and a master's in international human rights law from the National University of Ireland, Galway. Practice areas also include weapons offences, bail hearings, mental health law, hearings for people found not criminally responsible, and the Consent and Capacity Board. The firm takes urgent matters at any hour, and impaired driving cases involve licence suspensions, impoundment and mandatory minimum penalties.
nika-law-llp-etobicoke:
Wills, estates, trusts and elder law, including estate litigation, are the work of NIKA LAW LLP, a boutique firm in Etobicoke.

The name joins the names of founders Nithila Murugadas and Kavina Nagrani, who practise on the Etobicoke and Mississauga border. Kavina Nagrani is certified in estates and trusts law by the Law Society of Ontario and holds the TEP designation. The firm handles both planning and litigation, including will challenges, dependants support applications, estate accounting, probate and cases of financial elder abuse and power of attorney abuse. Lawyers meet clients in the office, which sits above Islington subway station, or at home.
nirwal-law-brampton:
Led by Manbir Nirwal, Nirwal Law is a Brampton firm that defends people charged with assault, impaired driving, drug and fraud offences. The firm practises criminal defence exclusively and serves clients across the GTA and Southern Ontario. Its areas include assault, DUI and impaired driving, drug offences, sexual offences, theft, fraud, firearms offences and stunt driving.

Manbir Nirwal earned his law degree at the University of Leicester, articled at a multidisciplinary firm in Mississauga and worked as an associate at a criminal defence firm in downtown Toronto, appearing in the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice. Clients deal directly with him, and appointments can be arranged for evenings and weekends.
nirwan-law-corporation-surrey:
Nirwan Law Corporation is a Surrey personal injury firm handling car, pedestrian, bicycle and motorcycle accidents and slip and falls. Founded in 2014, the firm acts for people injured through someone else's negligence.

It operates from two head offices, one in British Columbia and one in Washington state, and its lawyers are licensed to practise in British Columbia, Alberta, Washington, Texas and other American jurisdictions. The firm handles each case from the first meeting with a client through to litigation.
nk-lawyers-professional-corporation-nort:
NK Lawyers Professional Corporation, a North York practice, acts for clients in real estate and immigration matters. Its approach rests on clear communication and prompt service, with the aim of giving clients personalized and cost-effective solutions to their legal problems.

The team includes Nilofar Ahmadi, a barrister, solicitor and notary public, and Khesrau Ahmadi, and both hold B.A., M.A. and J.D. degrees. The office is in the Madison Centre at 4950 Yonge Street, Suite 2200, in North York.
nolan-ciarlo-llp:
Nolan, Ciarlo LLP is a Hamilton law firm offering employment, personal injury, disability, estates and real estate services.

The firm has more than a century of practice in downtown Hamilton. Constance McLean became one of Ontario's first woman lawyers in 1935, and John Hunt Nolan and Dermot P. Nolan formed a partnership with Robert E. Forsyth in 1975. Files are handled start to finish by a lawyer rather than passed to law clerks or paralegals. Areas of practice include group benefits long-term disability, wrongful dismissal, small business law and survivor litigation.
nolan-persaud:
Nolan Persaud is an Oshawa firm of barristers, solicitors and notaries handling real estate, family law and estate planning for clients in Durham Region.

Oshawa, Whitby and Courtice are among the communities served, and the firm treats law as a helping profession. Its history runs from Elliott & Hughes, formed in 1992 by Glenn Elliott and Jayne E. Hughes, through Elliott & Hills after Hughes became a Superior Court judge in 2008, to Hills Nolan in 2019 and Nolan Persaud in 2023, when Aruna Persaud joined Helen Nolan as a managing lawyer. Services include separation, divorce, custody and support matters, estate planning and settling estates. The office is on Stevenson Road South.
non-coupable-longueuil:
In Longueuil, Non Coupable defends criminal and penal charges at trial and on appeal, from statements of offence to murder cases.

Operating as Elayoubi Raymond, the firm has been in practice since 2002 and takes only criminal and penal files. Its lawyers appear before the municipal court, the Court of Quebec, the Superior Court, the Court of Appeal and the Supreme Court. Areas include impaired driving by alcohol or drugs, crimes against the person, sexual offences, economic crime, drug offences, youth cases and appeals. Lawyers are available around the clock in an arrest or emergency, and the firm covers greater Montreal and most judicial districts of the North Shore and South Shore.
noohi-law-north-york:
Noohi Law is a North York personal injury firm acting for people hurt in accidents, including slip and fall injuries. The firm has practised for over 23 years, offers legal advice, support and litigation across Canada, and provides its services in multiple languages. Its team includes Kathy Noohi and Ali Nobahar.

Its slip and fall work addresses injuries that follow a fall, including broken bones and traumatic brain injury, and the firm has handled slip and fall settlements for more than 20 years. Its office is on Sheppard Avenue East, and clients come from Toronto and elsewhere in Ontario.
nora-law-professional-corporation-london:
Nora Law Professional Corporation is a London, Ontario firm covering family, immigration and refugee, child protection and business law.

The firm acts for parents and caregivers in Children's Aid Society proceedings, and handles refugee protection cases, humanitarian applications, PRRA matters, sponsorships, work and study permits and permanent residence applications. Business services include incorporations, shareholder agreements and contract drafting. Nora Eze is licensed in Ontario and Nigeria and has anti-money laundering compliance certification, and Krupa Patel is also on the team. The firm offers direct access to counsel and careful preparation.
north-road-law-and-notary-public-burnaby:
North Road Law & Notary Public is a Burnaby firm handling home and business transactions, including real estate, business and corporate, and wills matters.

Managing partner Jenny Cho focuses on real estate, business and corporate law. Before joining the firm, Jenny practised corporate, business and U.S. immigration law as a New York-licensed lawyer in Seoul. The firm also offers notarial services.
northern-law-llp:
Northern Law LLP is a Greater Sudbury firm handling complex litigation, family and estate matters, and real estate, construction and property disputes.

The firm recently moved to 298 Larch Street. Spencer D.W. Ball is partner and Paul J. Frinak is associate, with Jordan E. Duplessis, Carly Harris, Bhishm Khanna and Morgan L. Zyma among its lawyers. Every file gets a team-based approach, with a focus on cost-effective service and access to justice and regular litigation against large corporations, insurance companies and municipalities. Its blog covers topics such as decision-making responsibility for parents after separation and dependant support claims in estate law.
norton-law-pc-oshawa:
Norton Law PC is an Oshawa criminal defence practice led by Steve Norton, representing people charged with offences across the Greater Toronto Area.

Steve Norton earned a Juris Doctor at Bond University while completing a master's in business administration in Australia, where he also clerked at criminal and commercial litigation firms. He holds a B.A. with honours from York University and is in good standing with the Law Society of Ontario and the Criminal Lawyers Association. Topics covered include bail hearings, police questioning, the presumption of innocence and the right to a bail hearing within 24 hours, with material for charges in Ajax and Richmond Hill.
norton-rose-fulbright-canada-llp:
Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP is the Canadian arm of a global law firm, based in Toronto and focused on energy, infrastructure, mining and defence.

Recent deal news includes a court-supervised sale of Ravines Senior Suites to Verve Senior Living, a management buyout of Brightstone Financial Group, and Altus Group's sale of its development advisory business to Newmark. Commentary addresses federal infrastructure approvals legislation, private investment in airports, defence procurement rules for Canadian companies, Bill C-39 and Ontario accessibility reporting. Practice topics include ESG and white-collar, regulatory and investigations work.
norton-rose-fulbright-canada-llp-calgary:
Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP has a Calgary office at 400 3 Ave SW, with energy and mining as its practice areas.

The firm is a global law firm offering corporations and financial institutions a full business law service. Its work spans project finance, securitization, blockchain law, insurance regulation and environmental, social and governance topics. It advised Mexico's development bank Bancomext on a US$168 million financing for the exploration and production company Consorcio Petrolero 5M del Golfo. Local detail for the Calgary office is limited to the address and practice areas.
nspc-law-firm-ottawa:

onyx-law-group-vancouver:

osra-avocats-laval:

porcelli-d-angela-llp-mississauga:

portfolio-estate-law-etobicoke:

posner-craig-stein-llp-toronto:

potvin-immigration-montreal:

ppd-law-office-brandon:

precision-law-and-notary-law-firm-calgar:

preferred-immigration-services-edmonton:

prestige-law-richmond-hill:

primus-immigration-montreal:

pringle-law-edmonton:

progressive-legal-solutions-barrie:

prudentia-law-professional-corporation-m:

pushor-mitchell-llp:

quail-warfe-kreder-llp-mississauga:

r-k-sidhu-law-office-edmonton:

raluca-m-soica-barrister-and-solicitor-n: Raluca Soica, Barrister & Solicitor is a general practice law office in North York, Ontario. rana-u-hameed-criminal-law-mississauga:

rathore-baig-professional-corporation:

ratuski-law-office-winnipeg:

recovery-family-law-surrey:

reich-law-calgary:

resolutions-law-corporation:

richards-and-jurusik-us-immigration-lawy:

ricketts-harris-llp:

rja-law-edmonton:

rlc-law-north-york:

robb-macdonald-toronto:
