robertson-llp-calgary:
Robertson LLP is a Calgary firm, founded in 2012, practising commercial and residential real estate, business law, wills and estates, and litigation. Ryan Robertson started the firm with national firm and in-house experience, aiming to give clients predictable pricing.

Offices are in Calgary and Okotoks, and clients include home buyers and sellers, small and medium-sized businesses, lenders, home builders, developers, REITs, investors and condominium corporations. Commercial work covers purchases and sales, financing, leasing, construction law, builders' liens and franchise law. Madison Steenson is among the firm's lawyers.
robins-appleby-llp:
Robins Appleby LLP is a Toronto firm advising on corporate and commercial matters, tax, and dispute resolution from the financial district.

The firm has provided practical legal advice for over 70 years to entrepreneurs, businesses, financial institutions and foreign companies doing business in Canada. Its areas include trusts and estates, real estate, corporate and commercial litigation, labour and employment, and tax law. Recent publications cover the tax-debt rules of section 160 and negotiation over earnouts for business sellers, and Michael Robson joined its litigation and dispute resolution group in October 2026.
robinson-llp-edmonton:
Robinson LLP is an Edmonton firm handling personal injury and medical malpractice claims for people hurt by someone else's negligence.

Its practice areas include motorcycle, slip and fall, dog and animal bite, and spinal and brain injury claims. The firm says it helps clients deal with lost income and unplanned costs while they focus on recovery.
rocky-mountain-german-law-ltd-calgary:
Rocky Mountain German Law is a Calgary firm advising Canadians on German citizenship, inheritance and tax law.

The firm works with a network of lawyers and tax advisors in Germany, and its team includes a foreign legal consultant registered in Alberta. It provides advice on German law issues on site in Canada.
rohan-hate-litigation-lawyers-toronto:
Insurance and personal injury litigation across Ontario is the main work of Rohan Haté Litigation Lawyers, based in Toronto. Rohan Haté was called to the bar in 2012 after earning a Juris Doctor from Santa Clara University School of Law and attending Osgoode Hall Law School for a Master of Laws. He acts for injured people and their families through the insurance process and also advises insurers on occupiers' liability, motor vehicle tort, accident benefits and coverage.

He appears regularly in the Ontario Superior Court of Justice, has conducted jury trials and has appeared before the Financial Services Commission of Ontario and the License Appeal Tribunal. The firm has offices in Oakville, Toronto and Mississauga and acts for clients throughout Ontario, with home and hospital visits where necessary.
rohit-sharma-law-etobicoke:
Rohit Sharma Law is an Etobicoke general practice serving Toronto and the GTA in family, criminal, real estate and civil litigation matters. Lawyer Rohit Sharma holds a Master's degree in law, was called to the Ontario bar in 2019 and appears before the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice, the Divisional Court and the Landlord Tenant Board. His matters have included contested custody and access, foreign divorce, real estate and employment disputes, and criminal cases.

Before practising in Ontario he spent three years as a litigation lawyer in the District Courts and High Court at Delhi, India, on criminal, family and civil matters. The firm's services also include corporate law, notary public services and wills and estate law, and its office is on Albion Road.
ronald-kumar-law-corporation-vancouver:
Ronald Kumar Law Corporation is a Vancouver firm handling estate litigation, wills and estate administration, and personal injury matters.

Its estate work covers will and inheritance disputes, wills variation claims, grants of probate or administration, and professional executor services. The firm also handles civil litigation and sports and entertainment law.
ronalee-carey-law-ottawa:
Ronalee Carey Law is an Ottawa immigration law practice handling visas, permanent residence, refugee cases and citizenship.

Ronalee Carey has practised law in Ontario since 1998 and has worked only in immigration since 2008. The small team handles visitor visas, study permits, post-graduate and open work permits, and family sponsorship, but does not assist with employer-specific work permits or LMIA applications, and does not serve clients in French. Ronalee belongs to the Canadian Bar Association's immigration section, the Ontario Bar Association's citizenship and immigration section, and two refugee lawyers' associations. The office dogs are Milo and Indy.
ronen-kurzfeld-immigration-lawyer-toront:
Ronen Kurzfeld Immigration Lawyer Toronto is a North York practice handling spousal sponsorship, Express Entry, citizenship and immigration appeals.

The firm is a licensed and insured immigration law office headquartered in the Toronto area. Ronen Kurzfeld graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School, studied in its intensive immigration and refugee law programme, and has more than twenty years in the field with over 2,500 clients worldwide. Services include business applications and enforcement matters, and the team can represent clients in almost any language. Payment plans are available, and the firm publishes articles on refugee cases and refusal appeals.
ross-mcbride-llp:
Ross & McBride LLP is a full-service Hamilton law firm that traces its roots to 1890 and serves the Hamilton area and beyond.

The firm serves individuals, families and businesses. Its articles discuss whether older homeowners should make adult children co-owners, who is at fault in weather-related car accidents, and whether an insurance medical examination must be attended. The firm is also involved in the community through volunteer work, board membership and contributions to local charitable groups and events.
roy-beaulieu-boudreau-belanger:
Roy Beaulieu Boudreau Belanger is a Rimouski firm operating as Avocats BSL, with practice areas from administrative law to family law.

Avocats BSL is one of the larger independent law firms in Eastern Quebec and one of the oldest legal practices in the province. Its fields include health and social services law, occupational health and safety, cross-border and private international law, insurance, civil and commercial litigation, real estate and family mediation. It also handles administrative matters such as access to information, employment insurance, housing tribunal cases, SAAQ benefits, the Federal Court, immigration and professional discipline, and offers bilingual services.
roy-johnston-tds-brandon:
Roy Johnston TDS is the Brandon office of Thompson Dorfman Sweatman LLP, serving Westman in corporate, family, estates, real estate and farm law.

The local team has five lawyers and seven support staff and also runs a part-time office in Boissevain. Clients include primary producers, large farm operations, small and medium-sized businesses, individuals, financial firms and developers. Its areas include commercial law, financial services, wills and estates, residential real estate, and commercial property and development. Through the larger Winnipeg office, clients can reach over 30 areas of law, and Thompson Dorfman Sweatman was founded in 1887.
royalridge-law-calgary:
Royalridge Law is a Calgary full-service firm with practice areas in real estate, corporate, wills and estates, criminal law and civil litigation.

The firm describes itself as a young and dynamic group of legal professionals who work with precision and personal attention. Its real estate work covers residential and commercial purchases, sales, financing, refinancing and property matters.
rpb-family-law-ottawa:
RPB Family Law is an Ottawa firm focused on family matters such as divorce, child custody, spousal support and property division.

The firm uses technology and cloud services to keep files moving and clients informed. It handles separation agreements, adoption, domestic violence and parenting issues through negotiation, settlement agreements and litigation, for families in Ottawa and Eastern Ontario. The team includes Ronan Blake, Gisele Alexander, Maria Ilie-Draga, Michael Randazzo and Jeremiah Kalyniak, and the office is on Churchill Avenue North.
rpc-personal-injury-lawyer-richmond-hill:
Based in Richmond Hill, RPC Personal Injury Lawyer handles car accidents, slip and falls and other personal injury cases.

The practice also covers pedestrian and motorcycle accidents, dog bite incidents, public transit accidents, orthopaedic injuries and traumatic brain injuries. Operating as RPC Law, it has offices in Richmond Hill, Vaughan and Georgetown and belongs to the BARAPP Law Alliance. Its staff are multilingual, and its lawyers deal with insurance adjusters on behalf of injured people.
rple-law:
RPLE Law is a Vancouver trial firm handling class actions, personal injury and complex litigation, with sexual assault matters among its practice areas.

The firm's full name is Rice Parsons Leoni & Elliott LLP, and its team numbers between 11 and 50 people. Its injury trial practice acts for clients across Canada. For sexual assault matters, initial meetings can take place by Zoom, at the office on Howe Street or at another location, and people need share only what they are comfortable telling the firm. The firm supports the Parkinson's Society of British Columbia and Canuck Place.
ruberto-sheikh-llp:
Ruberto Sheikh LLP is a Thunder Bay firm, founded in 2022, practising civil litigation, family law, real estate, wills and estates and child protection law.

The firm was started by two experienced lawyers and is a local office with knowledge of Northwestern Ontario court procedures. Its lawyers represent clients across Ontario, including Fort Frances, Kenora, Dryden, Newmarket and Toronto. Family law work covers property division, equalization of net family property, spousal support, child support and parenting and decision-making issues. The firm also uses the short name RUSH LLP, and its office is on May Street North.
rudner-law:
Rudner Law is a Markham employment law firm advising employers and employees throughout the Greater Toronto Area on HR, workplace and employment matters.

The firm works with employees and with employers, including on post-employment obligations such as non-competition, non-solicitation and confidentiality. It also offers alternative dispute resolution, with a lawyer named Stuart providing mediation, arbitration and med-arb. Rudner Law treats employment relationships as an extension of interpersonal ones, and sees its clients as facing business decisions rather than abstract legal issues.
rupinder-singh-dhaliwal-professional-cor:
Rupinder Singh Dhaliwal Professional Corporation is a Brampton practice offering real estate legal services and wills and affidavits.

Rupinder Singh Dhaliwal became a member of the Law Society of Upper Canada in July 2019 and holds a B.A. and an LL.B. He practises as a barrister and solicitor. The firm's approach is timely representation and practical solutions, and it works virtually with quick responses. The Brampton office handles property matters and the document work that goes with wills and sworn affidavits.
russell-alexander-collaborative-family-l:
Russell Alexander Collaborative Family Lawyers is a Toronto family law firm handling divorce, separation, parenting time, support and collaborative practice.

Founder and senior partner Russell Alexander established the firm in 1998, and it has eight offices serving Ontario and Alberta. Services include adoption, child protection, child support, spousal support, marriage contracts, separation agreements and family mediation. The firm practises family law only, and each client is assigned one lawyer and one law clerk. Collaborative practice is an out-of-court route to divorce built on open communication and cooperation.
ryan-edmonds-workplace-counsel-toronto:
Ryan Edmonds Workplace Counsel is a Toronto employment law firm advising Ontario employees and employers on severance, contracts and workplace disputes.

Ryan Edmonds founded the firm to offer innovative legal solutions tailored to each client's workplace, whether a small business, an employee in transition or a founder. For employees it handles severance package assessment and negotiation, wrongful dismissal, contract negotiation, workplace discrimination and disability accommodation. Its lawyers also act for management, which gives them insight into how employers think. Its values are honesty, transparency and quality, with some humour added.
s-and-s-lex-pc-mississauga:
Immigration, real estate and criminal defence matters across Ontario are handled by S & S LEX PC, a Mississauga law firm.

Directors Shivangi Bansal and Shubham Bansal bring backgrounds in both Canadian and international law. Real estate work covers residential and commercial transactions, title transfers, mortgage refinancing and contract drafting. Immigration work covers visa processing, sponsorship, citizenship and permanent residence applications and appeals, and Shivangi Bansal has taken challenges to IRCC decisions to the Federal Court. The firm also prepares powers of attorney and defends criminal charges in the Ontario justice system.
s-athwal-law-professional-corporation-mi:
S.Athwal Law is a Mississauga criminal defence practice handling assault, impaired driving, sexual offence and weapons charges.

Sahej Athwal holds a Master of Laws from Osgoode Hall Law School and belongs to the Law Society of Ontario and the Criminal Lawyers' Association. He appears at trial in the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice and works in English, Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu. Practice areas also include drug offences, bail, property offences and youth criminal justice. The firm serves Toronto, Brampton, Vaughan, North York, Richmond Hill, Newmarket and Markham, and is available around the clock.
s-s-loomba-law-professional-corporation-:
Immigration, real estate, civil litigation and family law are handled at S S Loomba Law Professional Corporation in Brampton. Managing director Shubinder Singh Loomba is a member of the Law Society of Ontario whose practice covers civil litigation, real estate, immigration, corporate and family law.

He has assisted with matters in the Superior Court and the Ontario Court of Justice, and completed a Master of Laws in Canadian common law at Osgoode Hall Law School and a Master of Laws in corporate law at Amity Law School. The firm serves clients throughout the Greater Toronto Area, offers flexible appointment times and works with flat fees and payment plans.
s-zalman-haouzi-avocat-montreal:
Zalman Haouzi Avocat is a Montreal boutique handling criminal defence for clients in Longueuil, Laval, Valleyfield and surrounding areas.

Founded in 2011, the practice treats a criminal charge as a problem to be solved and works with first-time offenders to avoid a criminal record. It assists from the first interaction with police through to resolution of the file, and prefers negotiated outcomes over trial where possible. Zalman Haouzi, who has practised in Montreal for more than a decade, is the lawyer behind the firm, and the work centres on minimizing the consequences of an accusation.
sabio-law-llp-brampton:
Sabio Law LLP is a Brampton firm handling real estate, business, estate and litigation matters across Ontario and the Greater Toronto Area.

The firm acts on residential and commercial real estate transactions, development work such as zoning and planning, financing, leases and joint ventures, and disputes including mortgage enforcement. Its clients include brokers, developers, investors and private lenders. Gurpreet heads the litigation practice group, which covers complex litigation and arbitration. Sabio Law uses value-based pricing and favours resolution and restructuring over litigation where it can.
safi-law-group-edmonton:
Safi Law Group is an Edmonton firm focused on personal injury and motor vehicle accident law, with family, estates and civil litigation work. Sangin (Sam) Safi founded the firm in 2019 after working at two general practice firms in Edmonton and area.

Injury matters include car and motorcycle collisions and injuries such as whiplash, chronic pain, neck injuries, brain injuries and spinal cord injuries. The firm also handles family law and divorce, wills and estates, and civil litigation from its office on Jasper Avenue.
saguy-barchichat:
Saguy Barchichat is a bilingual Montreal boutique firm practising Canadian immigration law for individuals and businesses. Services include family sponsorship to Canada and work visas.

The office is on the third floor at 2047 Mansfield Street in downtown Montreal. The firm values client relationships, innovation and clarity, and its approach pairs attention to the big picture with the details that matter to each client, for both individuals and small businesses.
salloum-and-company-edmonton:
Salloum & Company is an Edmonton firm acting in criminal defence, immigration, family law, real estate and civil litigation. The office is in the Bell Tower on 103 Avenue NW.

The lawyers act for individuals and businesses facing criminal charges, civil disputes, family matters and property issues, and handle residential real estate from purchases and sales to refinancing. The team brings experience across real estate, civil litigation, family law and criminal defence, and works closely with each client to protect their rights.
samfiru-tumarkin-llp:
Samfiru Tumarkin LLP is a Toronto firm practising employment law and disability matters, with its office at 350 Bay Street in Toronto, Ontario.

The firm's practice areas are employment law and disability. This entry is limited to the firm's name, city, address and those practice areas, and does not describe individual lawyers, services or approach.
samphir-law-office-winnipeg:
In Winnipeg, Samphir Law Office handles real estate, wills and estates, small business and immigration law for clients in Manitoba and Ontario.

In operation for more than 25 years, the firm acts for sellers, purchasers, investors and developers in residential and commercial real estate, including Winnipeg homes and cottages in the Lake of the Woods area. Wills and estates work covers wills, powers of attorney, probate applications and executor services, with a focus on inter-provincial estates. Small business services include incorporation, contracts and licensing, and immigration services cover permanent and temporary residence, including complex cases and refusals. Notary and commissioner for oaths services are available by appointment or in an emergency.
samy-ziada-avocat-montreal:
Samy Ziada Avocat, also known as ZS Avocats, is a Montreal practice handling civil and commercial litigation, immigration and business law.

The firm works in French. Me Samy Ziada, a member of the Barreau du Québec, is one of the few Montreal lawyers combining immigration with civil and commercial litigation. Litigation work spans housing, employment, real estate and insurance disputes. Immigration files include sponsorship, asylum applications and temporary or permanent residence. The firm serves Montréal, Laval and the Rive-Nord and Rive-Sud, with an office on Place d'Armes, and meetings can be held in person or online.
sanctuary-lawyers-aurora:
With offices in Aurora and Toronto, Sanctuary Lawyers is a family-run firm handling criminal defence and personal injury. For over a decade it has represented individuals across Southern Ontario, defending charges such as assault, domestic assault, assault with a weapon, drug offences, theft and fraud, impaired driving and youth offences. It also handles bail hearings and criminal appeals.

Beyond criminal defence, the firm acts in personal injury, civil litigation and family law matters. Its Aurora office is on Yonge Street, and its service area stretches across Southern Ontario, including Barrie, Brampton, Burlington, Cambridge and Ajax.
sandrine-bourgon-avocate-droit-criminel:
Sandrine Bourgon is a Saint-Jerome lawyer who practises criminal law, with an office at 468 Rue Laviolette.

She is a criminal defence lawyer in Saint-Jerome, part of the Réseau des professionnels du droit du Québec network for the Laurentides region. This entry is limited to her name, office address, city and criminal law practice, and does not describe the offences she handles or the courts where she appears.
sankoff-criminal-law-edmonton:
Sankoff Criminal Law is a boutique Edmonton criminal firm that handles complex trials and appeals for clients and supports other defence lawyers.

Its work includes criminal trials, criminal appeals, leave applications, jury charge analysis and consulting for lawyers, including preparing legal applications and strategic advice. Charges it handles include sexual assault, murder, fraud and theft, regulatory offences, drug offences, firearms offences, serious violent offences and youth criminal justice matters. Peter Sankoff is a lawyer other criminal counsel turn to on difficult points of evidence and appellate strategy. Steven Penney is Professor in Residence, assisting with research, and the team includes student lawyers.
sarao-law-pro-corp-etobicoke:
Sarao Law Professional Corporation is an Etobicoke firm handling real estate transactions and wills and estate planning. On property transactions the firm conducts title and off-title searches to confirm that a buyer has the correct property, clear of liens and encumbrances, arranges title insurance for residential and commercial property, and helps clients understand land transfer tax, property tax, HST and income tax implications.

Estate planning services include wills, living wills and powers of attorney for property for clients in Toronto. Fees are stated upfront, and the firm works to the values of integrity, ethics and client-centredness from its office on Westmore Drive.
sas-ing-immigration-law-centre:
Sas & Ing Immigration Law Centre is a Vancouver firm advising on work and study permits, permanent residence, citizenship and Federal Court immigration matters.

The centre is a partnership between Catherine Sas Law Corporation and Victor Ing Law Corporation, established in November 2015. Clients range from corporations transferring personnel to individuals who want to live, work or study in Canada or reunite with family, and services include Express Entry, provincial nominee programs, family sponsorship and citizenship appeals. Catherine A. Sas, KC, opened her own firm in 1990, Victor Ing was appointed to the board of directors of CILA, and a continuing education seminar is scheduled for October 21, 2026.
satnam-grewal-criminal-defence-and-immig:
Satnam Grewal Criminal Defence and Immigration Lawyer practises in Kitchener, handling impaired driving cases, family sponsorships and work permits. The practice is led by Satnam Singh Grewal. On the criminal side it deals with impaired driving, driving under the influence and dangerous driving charges. On the immigration side it handles family class sponsorships for spouses, children and parents, as well as visitor visas, work permits and study permits.

Clients are served in Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, Brantford, Woodstock, Hamilton and Milton. The office is on Roy Street in Kitchener, and fees are offered as flat rates or through flexible payment plans.
savard-defoy-avocats:
Savard Defoy Avocats is a Levis firm whose lawyers defend criminal and penal charges, including youth offender cases.

The firm also appears under the name Savard & Plouffe Avocats. Its team has more than 25 years of experience and includes Me Yves Savard, Me Sophie Plouffe and Me Marie-Maxime Tremblay. Me Savard was admitted to the Barreau in 1995, concentrates on criminal and penal law and has pleaded before courts up to the Supreme Court of Canada. The firm also covers family law and youth law, and family law is a listed practice area.
savoie-savoie:
Savoie & Savoie is a Repentigny law firm practising family, business, construction, real estate, debt recovery, estate, civil and penal law.

The firm has its office on Boulevard Brien in Repentigny and is a Quebec practice covering these fields together rather than a single focus. It offers tailored legal advice to clients. This entry does not name individual lawyers, courts or dates.
schaffer-schaffer-law:
Schaffer & Schaffer Law is a Kitchener firm covering real estate, personal injury, family, estates, business and criminal law.

Lawyers Gerry V. Schaffer, Zack G. Schaffer and Sam M. Schaffer practise at the firm, with clerks assigned to real estate, wills and estates, and family law and litigation. Zack handles real estate work while Gerry concentrates on criminal and matrimonial cases, and the firm works throughout the Kitchener-Waterloo area.
sean-fagan-criminal-defence-lawyer-calga:
Sean Fagan Criminal Defence Lawyer is a Calgary practice defending assault, driving, drug, sexual, theft and fraud charges, and handling bail matters.

Sean Fagan grew up around his father's Calgary criminal practice, focused on criminal defence in law school, took first place at the MacIntyre Cup and medalled at the Sopinka Cup national trial advocacy finals. He was lead counsel in a Supreme Court of Canada case that ended in acquittal and re-established the defence of extreme intoxication. The practice also covers breaches and failures to appear, and recent matters include charges withdrawn or stayed. The firm does not handle traffic tickets, and Devlin Gavigan also practises there.
sean-kelly-law-ottawa:
Based in Barrhaven, Sean Kelly Law handles real estate, wills and estate planning for clients across Ottawa. Sean Kelly is a second-generation lawyer, born and raised in Ottawa, with more than 15 years of experience.

He acts for first-time home buyers and seasoned investors, prepares agreements of purchase and sale, acts for borrowers or lenders in private financing, and handles title transfers between spouses or family members. The firm also prepares wills and advises on estate planning, and serves all neighbourhoods in Ottawa and surrounding areas.
sebastien-gagnon-avocat-criminel:
Sebastien Gagnon, Avocat Criminel is the Gatineau practice of Me Sébastien Gagnon, handling criminal charges and statements of offence. He is a partner at CSG Avocats with more than 20 years of experience in criminal and penal law, and also practises disciplinary law.

The practice handles impaired driving, sexual assault, dangerous driving, drug offences, assault, theft and fraud, as well as administrative law, and also appears before the Commission des transports du Québec and the youth court in young offender and youth protection matters. The client meets the lawyer from the first day, with emergency availability at any hour. The office is at 166 Rue Wellington.
seif-law-firm-richmond-hill:
Seif Law Firm is a Richmond Hill practice serving the Greater Toronto Area, with real estate, wills, powers of attorney and notary services.

The firm's main focus is real estate law, covering buying, selling and refinancing, and it also handles private mortgages, family law and litigation. Adam Seif is licensed in Canada and in the US, belongs to the Florida Bar and opened his own practice in 2011 after articling. The team includes lawyers, law clerks and legal assistants, a live person answers around the clock, and the multilingual team includes French.
sg-injury-law-ottawa:
SG Injury Law is an Ottawa firm whose only practice areas are personal injury, long-term disability insurance and employment law.

The lawyers are former insurance defence lawyers. Their injury work covers car accidents, including no-fault accident benefits, and slip and fall cases, while the employment group handles wrongful dismissal, employment contracts, severance pay and termination package assessment. The firm acts in Ottawa and in Eastern Ontario communities such as Pembroke, Cornwall, Kingston, Brockville, Perth and Arnprior. It walks clients through the steps of an injury case, from a notice letter and examinations for discovery to mediation, pre-trial conference and trial.
shaffie-law-toronto:
Shaffie Law is a Toronto criminal defence firm that focuses on domestic assault and sexual assault charges across Ontario.

Shayan Shaffie is a former Crown Attorney who began at the Crown Attorney's Office in Hamilton and worked as a trial Crown for several years before entering private practice. He holds a law degree from the University of Toronto. The firm has spent over a decade on domestic violence charges, and addresses topics such as orders barring communication, what to expect at a first court appearance, the role of victims and the use of affidavits.
shapiro-llp-north-york:
Shapiro LLP is a North York law firm serving the Greater Toronto Area in residential and commercial real estate, business law, and wills and estates.

The firm's work also includes commercial matters and private mortgages, and it provides legal services across Canada. The practice is at Sheppard Avenue East in North York. Its practice areas are grouped under real estate, business and commercial law, private mortgage work and wills, estates and trusts.
share-lawyers-calgary-calgary:
Share Lawyers, listed in Calgary, is a long-term disability insurance practice with a Toronto base and service across Canada.

The firm opened in 1987 and has focused on denied and delayed disability benefits, both employee group benefits and privately purchased coverage. It deals with insurers such as Manulife, Sun Life, Canada Life, OTIP, Desjardins and Blue Cross, and has helped more than 10,000 people pursue benefits. Co-founder David Share has practised since 1985 and taught trial advocacy at Osgoode Hall Law School. Other lawyers include Steven Muller, Samantha Share and Janice E. Grevler.
sheard-law-professional-corporation-toro:
Family law and estate litigation are the core of Sheard Law Professional Corporation, a Toronto firm founded in 2005. Its work also includes probate, estate administration and mediation, and it serves Danforth Village, Riverdale, Leslieville, Playter Estates and East York.

John Sheard has more than 20 years of legal experience and training in family mediation. His approach is to organize the issues, run the calculations and seek resolution first, litigating only when necessary. For nearly ten years he has also acted as an agent for the Office of the Children's Lawyer, representing children in high-conflict custody disputes. The firm practises in association with Longo Lawyers, which adds a second office at Yonge and Sheppard.
sherritt-greene-immigration-law-calgary:
Sherritt Greene Immigration Law is a Calgary firm founded in January 1998 that practises exclusively in immigration law.

Senior partners Michael Greene and Michael Sherritt founded the firm, which handles permanent residence, Federal Court immigration litigation, refugee protection, citizenship, temporary residence and foreign worker matters. The firm also supports Express Entry and Provincial Nominee Program applications.
shilpa-bhadoria-barrister-solicitor-winn:
Shilpa Bhadoria, Barrister & Solicitor, is a Winnipeg lawyer practising real estate law at S Lawyers LLP, 104 Riverbend Crescent, in Manitoba.

This entry is limited to the name, address, city and real estate practice area; no further detail on approach, history or services is provided.
shimon-segal-criminal-lawyer-winnipeg:
Shimon Segal Criminal Lawyer is associated with Gindin Wiebe Segal Law, a downtown Winnipeg firm handling criminal defence and immigration cases.

The firm has criminal lawyers and a full-service immigration team in the same office on Broadway. Practice topics include impaired driving, driving with a blood alcohol level over .08 and provincial administrative driving prohibitions. Non-citizens charged with criminal offences face particular immigration risks, including deportation, and the firm's lawyers understand both fields. Jeff Gindin, KC, is a founding partner who has appeared at all levels of court in Canada, including the Supreme Court.
shivji-law-calgary:
Shivji Law is a boutique Calgary firm focused on residential real estate, with wills and estates and employment law as additional services.

Its real estate work covers purchases, including new condominiums, foreclosure properties and houses bought from builders, as well as sales, refinancing and construction draw mortgages. The team includes Farouk Shivji, Madisyn Gilbert, Abi Poxon and Mizghan Darwishan. The office sits just outside the downtown core, with parking for clients and access from all quadrants of the city.
shore-and-johnston-barristers-at-law-ott:
Shore & Johnston, Barristers-at-Law is an Ottawa criminal defence firm handling bail, driving, drug, domestic, sexual and homicide charges.

The firm has helped clients through criminal charges in Ontario for fifty years under the Criminal Code and the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act, and has also acted in regulatory prosecutions ranging from the Ontario Highway Traffic Act to the Canadian Lobbying Act. Its lawyers appear at bail hearings, on guilty pleas and sentencing, in judge-alone and jury trials, and on appeal. Michael Johnston is among its lawyers, and the practice addresses Charter rights, including the presumption of innocence.
shory-law-llp-calgary:
Shory Law LLP is a Calgary firm offering immigration, business and real estate law, and has served the city and surrounding areas since 1998. Its practice areas are brought together in one office on Westwinds Drive NE.

Immigration work covers permanent residence, work permits and appeals, while business immigration includes intra-company transfers and routes for entrepreneurs and investors who want to buy or start a business in Canada. Business law covers incorporation, mergers and acquisitions, corporate finance and securities, compliance, commercial agreements and governance. The real estate team handles residential and commercial transactions and refinancing.
shulman-and-partners-llp:
Shulman & Partners LLP is a Toronto family law firm handling divorce, separation and related matters, with a second office in Ottawa.

The firm has Toronto and Ottawa locations and a team-based approach in which each client has the support of a group of lawyers rather than a single adviser. Every family matter is unique, and the firm aims to give clients workable solutions to their concerns. Its practice areas include family law, divorce and separation agreements.
siddiky-law-montreal:
Siddiky Law is a Montreal immigration firm handling permanent residence, visitor visas, work permits, family reunification and citizenship applications.

Its lawyers are Sohana Sara Siddiky and Shadman Siddiky, working from an office on René-Lévesque Boulevard West. Permanent residence applications, visitor visas for temporary stays and work permits for employment in Canada make up the core of the practice. Clients are kept informed of progress at each stage of their file, and the firm's values are justice, equality and resilience.
silaw-group-family-lawyers-surrey:
SiLaw Group Family Lawyers is a boutique family law and mediation firm founded in 2019 in Surrey, British Columbia.

The firm practises family law only, covering divorce, uncontested divorce, child custody and parenting, and separation agreements. It is based in South Surrey near White Rock, and its site notes services in English and Punjabi.
silver-immigration-montreal:
Silver Immigration is a Montreal firm advising Canadians on US immigration, including work visas, green cards, student visas and entry waivers.

Matthew Silver, a Montreal-based US immigration attorney, founded the firm, which has served Canadians since 2019 and serves both Montreal and Ottawa. Its services cover E-2 and E-1 treaty visas, EB-5 investor green cards, employment-based permanent residence, TN and L-1 work visas, O-1 visas, B-1/B-2 visitor travel, F-1 student visas, OPT after graduation, and Form I-192 waivers for people with a criminal record or DUI. The office is on rue de la Gauchetière Ouest.
simeson-law-oshawa:
Simeson Law LLP is an Oshawa firm handling personal injury, criminal defence, family and employment law matters.

The firm has acted for accident victims for over 35 years, in matters such as car, bicycle and boating accidents, brain injuries, catastrophic injury, slip and falls, animal attacks, medical malpractice, product liability, accident benefits, and disability, life and property insurance disputes. Its criminal practice covers Criminal Code, provincial and Highway Traffic Act offences, and employment work addresses wrongful dismissal. Alastair H. Simeson is the partner in charge of litigation and a former president of the Oshawa Chamber of Commerce, and Sean M. Simeson is an associate lawyer.
simmonds-and-associates-winnipeg:
Simmonds and Associates is a Winnipeg criminal defence firm of six lawyers handling bail hearings, Charter applications, drug and assault charges.

The firm was formed by Saul Simmonds, and its lawyers practise criminal defence exclusively. The team includes two King's Counsel, Saul B. Simmonds and Katherine L. Bueti, along with Laura M. Nagy, Chelsea J. Suderman, Jade DeFehr and Seth Lozinski. Other areas include intimate partner violence, impaired driving and Highway Traffic Act matters. The firm serves clients in and around Winnipeg and across Manitoba, and has represented clients elsewhere in Western Canada.
simmons-da-silva-llp:
Simmons da Silva LLP is a Brampton firm, also called SDS, offering business law, litigation, family law, real estate, and wills and estates services.

The firm has served clients since 1969, advising entrepreneurial business owners and managers on commercial matters and individuals on personal issues. Its approach is hands-on, with common-sense solutions to legal problems. It also publishes practical guidance for lenders and borrowers on mortgage enforcement by power of sale in Ontario, including the Mortgages Act requirement of at least 35 days' notice of sale.
simplyclose-real-estate-law-windsor:
Simplyclose Real Estate Law is a Windsor firm handling home purchases, sales, refinancing, title transfers and private mortgages across Ontario.

Clients receive an all-in quote up front, with signings in person at the Erie Street office in Windsor or remotely. One lawyer is assigned to each file. The work behind a closing includes title searches, mortgage instructions, Land Transfer Tax, statements of adjustment, mortgage discharges and lien payouts. The firm also handles new builds, condos and independent legal advice, and sale proceeds are disbursed the same day where the file allows.
singh-law-winnipeg:
Singh Law is a Winnipeg general practice covering residential and commercial real estate, family, criminal and immigration law, and corporations.

The firm also handles elder law and real estate work such as sales and purchases, commercial leases, refinancing and discharges, and foreclosures. Immigration work includes removal and deportation defence, employer compliance and appeals, and corporate work includes incorporations, winding-up and sales or purchases of businesses. Clients speak with someone who knows their file, quotes are provided before a matter starts, and advice is plain-speaking and practical. The office is on Border Street in Winnipeg.
singha-law-professional-corporation-toro:
Singha Law Professional Corporation is a full-service Toronto firm covering real estate, family, immigration, wills and litigation. Litigation matters include contract and employment disputes, real estate disputes, will challenges and estate conflicts, and the firm also offers notary public services and private mortgage work for both lenders and borrowers.

Founder Jayanta Kumar Singha, known as Jay, holds an LLB from the University of Calcutta (2001) and an LLM, and has more than 24 years of legal experience across Canada, India and Bangladesh. He qualified to practise in Ontario through the National Committee on Accreditation. The office is on Kingston Road in Scarborough, and the firm serves individuals, families and businesses across Ontario.
sirois-avocat-quebec-city:
Sirois Avocat is a Quebec City firm practising immigration, business and civil law, founded in 2021 by Me Sirois.

He earned an LL.B. from Université Laval in 2019, has belonged to the Barreau du Québec since February 2020, and has focused on immigration in private practice. The firm's approach rests on efficiency, personal service and information technology. Me Sirois received the 2021 firm start-up grant of the Jeune Barreau de Québec and has been a member of the Association québécoise des avocats et avocates en droit de l'immigration since 2020. He guides clients through temporary and permanent residence applications and helps entrepreneurs meet their legal obligations.
sitka-law-group-victoria:
Sitka Law Group is a Victoria, BC firm of lawyers and notaries handling real estate, estate planning, estate administration, business law and civil litigation.

The firm has merged with Salmond Ashurst, which has practised since 1994. It works collectively, with each client having a named lead lawyer. Real estate services include purchases, sales, refinances and mortgages, commercial lending, construction contracts, co-ownership agreements and tenancy agreements. The firm serves Esquimalt, Oak Bay, Saanich, Saanichton, Sooke, Sidney, Langford and Colwood, and also offers notarizations.
siu-law-professional-corporation-richmon:
Siu Law Professional Corporation is a Richmond Hill real estate law firm handling purchases, sales, mortgages and refinancing.

The lawyer, Andrea, was admitted to the Ontario Bar in 2011 after graduating from Osgoode Hall Law School, and earlier spent seven years at a chartered bank. Her experience spans legal aid clinics, boutique and Bay Street firms in immigration, civil litigation, wills and estates, and real estate. Purchase services include agreements of purchase and sale, condominium status certificates, title searches and title insurance. The firm also closes new construction purchases in Alberta, and handles powers of attorney, corporate work and notarizing.
skyline-law-corporation-surrey:
Skyline Law Corporation is a Surrey firm handling family law, criminal defence, residential tenancy disputes, and wills and estates. Founder and principal lawyer Nav Randhawa leads the firm, which serves clients in Surrey, including Fleetwood and Guildford, and in Vancouver.

Family matters include separation, divorce, child custody disputes, and the division of property and debt. The firm also acts on criminal charges, landlord and tenant disputes and estate planning, negotiating out-of-court settlements where it can and pursuing litigation when needed.
slater-vecchio-llp:
Slater Vecchio LLP is a Vancouver firm handling class actions, personal injury, insurance matters and long-term disability denials.

Its legal services include class actions, insurance matters, sexual abuse, personal injury, wills and estates and LTD denials, and the same team works for individuals with a single personal injury matter and for members of a wider group in a class action. The firm uses a team approach refined over twenty years. Partners include Anthony A. Vecchio, K.C., James U. Buckley, James A. Richards, Aimee A. King, Saro J. Turner and Nicole M. Kelly. The office is on Dunsmuir Street, and the firm also runs a student program that involves chambers applications, mediations and examinations for discovery.
slc-law-mississauga:
Business, corporate and intellectual property law for owners and startups is the focus of SLC Law, a boutique firm in Mississauga. Services include incorporations and minute books, shareholders' agreements and governance, contract drafting, commercial lease negotiation, asset and share purchases, reorganizations and IP strategy, along with employment and litigation matters.

One of its lawyers, Michael, is also a trademark agent in Canada who represents clients before the Canadian Intellectual Property Office. The office is on City Centre Drive in Mississauga, and the firm serves Port Credit, Streetsville, Meadowvale, Erin Mills, Clarkson, Cooksville, Lorne Park, Toronto, Woodbridge, Oakville, Brampton, Milton, Vaughan and Hamilton.
slipacoff-immigration-law-ottawa:
Slipacoff Immigration Law is an Ottawa-area practice handling immigration refusals, appeals, study permits, visitor visas and sponsorships.

Adam Slipacoff, a fourth-generation Canadian and Ottawa native, studied at Carleton University and Osgoode Hall Law School. The firm serves Toronto and Ottawa and represents clients challenging refusals through appeals and judicial applications to court, responds to procedural fairness letters and works on inadmissibility. Other services are Express Entry, spousal sponsorship, citizenship applications and PR card renewals. The office address is in Kanata, and the firm also provides guidance on settlement services for newcomers.
smith-employment-law-toronto:
Smith Employment Law is a Toronto practice that acts for both employees and employers in employment law matters.

The firm is led by Waheeda Ekhlas Smith, who practises as WES Law Professional Corporation and worked as a legal assistant for many years, beginning at age 18, before becoming a lawyer. The practice handles severance negotiations and assessments of job offers and employment contracts, and seeks early resolution before matters reach court while staying ready to advance or defend a client's position when necessary. Community involvement, education, representative work and speaking engagements are also part of Ms. Smith's profile.
smith-thompson-law-llp-edmonton:
Smith Thompson Law LLP is an Edmonton litigation firm handling car accidents, personal injury, employment and harassment matters. It was founded in 2018 by Mark Alexander Smith and Brian E. Thompson and is a small firm of litigation lawyers.

Litigation work also covers slip and fall cases, fatalities, professional negligence, medical and dental malpractice, insurance policy denials, real estate disputes and contract disputes. Employment matters include wrongful and constructive dismissal and employment contracts, and confidential legal support is offered in sexual misconduct cases. Injury files can be handled on a contingency basis, with fees collected only when a settlement is reached.
smithen-family-law-professional-corporat:
Kathryn Smithen leads Smithen Family Law Professional Corporation, a North York firm handling divorce, custody, support and property division. She has practised family law for over fifteen years and acts for women and families in contested and uncontested proceedings, including high-conflict and high-worth cases.

Her work draws on the Family Law Act, the Divorce Act, the Children's Law Reform Act, the Spousal Support Advisory Guidelines and the Federal Child Support Guidelines. The firm also handles separation and cohabitation agreements, mediation and other dispute resolution, and family law for same-sex and LGBTQ+ families, serving the GTA including York and Peel regions.
smitiuch-injury-law-etobicoke:
Smitiuch Injury Law is an Etobicoke personal injury firm acting for people hurt in car, truck and motorcycle accidents. Founded in 2001 by Michael Smitiuch, it takes injury and wrongful death cases through to trial and has concluded matters by negotiated settlement and jury verdict. Investigation work includes gathering evidence, collecting police reports and medical records and interviewing witnesses.

Fees are contingency-based, so clients owe nothing unless compensation is recovered. The firm serves Toronto, Etobicoke and the wider Greater Toronto Area from its office on Bloor Street West.
smukowich-law-corporation-vancouver:
Smukowich Law Corporation is a Vancouver firm handling wills and estates, corporate law and litigation for clients across British Columbia. Andrew Smukowich, a Métis lawyer, founded the practice in 2020 as a virtual firm with predictable pricing, and it is Indigenous owned.

Litigation work includes small claims, Supreme Court civil matters, residential tenancy disputes and arbitration. Corporate services cover incorporation, records management, governance and contract drafting, and estate work covers advance directives, powers of attorney, letters of wishes and representation agreements. The firm has experience in Aboriginal corporate governance and economic development initiatives in BC, and Andrew holds an MBA and a Bachelor of Commerce.
snow-lawyers-professional-corporation-lo:
Snow Lawyers is a London trial law firm defending impaired driving, drug, weapons and assault charges across southwestern Ontario.

The firm was established in 2019 and handles over 80, guns and weapons, domestic assault and sexual assault matters. Geoff Snow focuses on complex trials and applications in the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice, and holds a Master of Laws in criminal law and procedure. The team also includes Danielle D'Alonzo and Delia Matias. The firm keeps clients' privacy in mind and prepares for trials that last from hours to months.
snowdon-and-terepocki-llp-abbotsford:
Snowdon & Terepocki LLP, known as GS&T LLP, is an Abbotsford criminal defence firm handling driving offences across the Fraser Valley. It was opened by former colleagues Tonia Grace, Ondine Snowdon and Chris Terepocki as Grace, Snowdon & Terepocki LLP.

Criminal work includes drug offences such as possession, trafficking and production, while driving work covers immediate roadside prohibitions of 3, 30 and 90 days and violation tickets. The firm also handles civil litigation, family law, human rights, prison law and administrative law, appears in courts from Abbotsford and Chilliwack to Vancouver, New Westminster, Surrey and Port Coquitlam, and is available around the clock on driving matters.
snowdrop-immigration-services-ltd-edmont:
Snowdrop Immigration Services Ltd is an Edmonton firm offering permanent residence, study permit, work permit and visitor visa services.

The firm is registered and regulated and works only on Canadian immigration. Its services include Express Entry, family sponsorship, provincial nominee applications, the Rural and Northern Immigration Pilot, the Atlantic Immigration Pilot, work permits and work permit extensions, as well as super visa support. The team studies each client's background and eligibility before planning a pathway.
sobirovs-law-firm:
Sobirovs Law Firm is an Etobicoke business immigration firm helping entrepreneurs, investors and executives move to Canada through business programs.

The firm started in 2012 with two lawyers who had come to Canada as newcomers, Rakhmad Sobirov, who arrived from Uzbekistan in 2005, and Feruza Djamalova. Its work covers start-up and entrepreneur work permits, intra-company transfers, high-wage LMIAs and LMIA exemptions, Provincial Nominee Programs and permanent residence for business people. It also offers online eligibility calculators, including province-specific ones, and serves clients across Canada.
sodagar-and-company-law-corporation-vanc:
Sodagar & Company Law Corporation is a Vancouver firm handling business, real estate, estate, litigation and intellectual property matters. For more than two decades it has acted for domestic and international businesses and entrepreneurs, led by principal Ali Sodagar, who is both a lawyer and a Trade-Mark Agent.

Business services include commercial leases, business formations, non-disclosure and non-competition agreements, business transactions and the purchase and sale of intellectual property rights. Associates Jatinder Sharma, Alireza Fazeli and Kriti Chopra and senior litigator George Gregory complete the legal team, which has appeared at all levels of court in British Columbia.
solomon-chiu-law-corporation:
Solomon Chiu Law Corporation is a Richmond firm handling business, real estate and probate law for clients in Metro Vancouver.

The firm's approach is legal advice built on integrity and purpose. Its practice falls under real estate and wills and estates, and the office is on Number 3 Road in Richmond, British Columbia. Solomon Chiu is the lawyer named in the firm's biography, and further details about its services are limited.
soloway-wright-llp:
Soloway Wright LLP is an Ottawa firm, with an office in Kingston, handling litigation, construction law, corporate matters and real estate.

The firm has operated since 1946 and was built on daily court work, both civil and criminal. Its litigation practice covers commercial disputes, insurance law, medical malpractice, personal injury, and employment, labour and public law. It also handles business and corporate law and corporate finance and securities. A ten-lawyer construction law group advises on risk across the life of a project, the firm runs a student program, and Krista Libman and Mike McDonald were recently appointed partners. Community support includes sponsorships and board service in Ottawa and Kingston.
sondhi-defence-professional-corporation-:
Criminal defence and real estate law are the two main practice areas of Sondhi Defence Professional Corporation, an Aurora firm. It represents people charged with criminal offences in Newmarket, Aurora, Minden and across the Greater Toronto Area, and it appears at bail hearings, where a person arrested in Newmarket or elsewhere in the GTA seeks release while the case is pending. The firm also handles civil matters.

Real estate work covers property transactions. The firm works from Yonge Street in Aurora and has an office on Gorham Street in Newmarket.
sorbaralaw:
SorbaraLaw is a law firm located at 31 Union St E in Waterloo, Ontario.

The firm aims to reach an outcome for every client and legal matter in the shortest possible time and at the least possible cost. Individual practice areas, lawyers and services are not specified for this entry, which is limited to the firm's name, location and stated aim.
sorbaralaw-markham:
SorbaraLaw is a Markham law office on Woodbine Avenue that takes on legal matters of every kind for its clients.

The firm aims to reach a good outcome for each client in the shortest possible time and at the least possible cost, whatever the legal matter entrusted to it. Individual practice areas, lawyers and a firm history are not specified, so this entry is limited to the firm's name, its Markham location and that approach.
soul-family-law-winnipeg:
Soul Family Law is a Winnipeg practice handling separation, divorce, custody, support and property division through the collaborative method.

Ms. Soul was admitted to the Manitoba bar in 2009 and has practised collaborative law since training in 2011. In the collaborative process, spouses agree not to file court materials and negotiate with their own collaboratively trained lawyers, sometimes alongside communication or parenting coaches, a financial professional or a child-focused adviser. If either spouse later chooses court, written notice is required and both must retain new lawyers. Meetings are held remotely over Zoom or by voice link.
spadafora-johnson-lepore-llp:
Spadafora Johnson Lepore LLP provides corporate, commercial and business law services to individuals and companies in Sault Ste. Marie and across Ontario.

Known as SJL, the firm works with local and multi-national clients through the full business cycle, from start-up and growth to succession planning or sale. Its corporate work includes organizing sole proprietorships, partnerships and corporations, and negotiating commercial agreements, purchase and sale agreements, shareholder agreements and joint venture agreements. The firm has built strategic partnerships with other law firms and professionals so clients can reach particular knowledge outside its own practice, and its office is on Queen Street East.
srk-law-group:
SRK Law Group is an Oakville firm handling real estate closings, family law, wills and probate, and general practice matters.

It has handled real estate work in Mississauga and Oakville since 2010, including closings, title insurance and the buying and selling of property. General practice areas include notary services, business incorporations, simple agreements, marriage contracts and criminal law offences under the Criminal Code of Canada. Lawyer Sachin Ryan Kharbanda focuses on residential and commercial real estate with over 15 years in the field, holds an LL.B. from the University of Leicester and was admitted to the Ontario Bar in 2010. He appears before the Ontario Superior Court of Justice in criminal defence matters.
stacey-r-ball-toronto:
Stacey Reginald Ball practises employment and labour law in Toronto, acting for employees, executives, professionals and employers. The practice dates from 1989 and operates as Ball Professional Corporation, and Mr. Ball has advised thousands of clients over more than 35 years. Matters include terminations, severance packages, resignations under pressure, allegations of just cause, employment agreements and wrongful dismissal, along with unfair labour practice complaints under the Canada Labour Code.

Mr. Ball is the author of Canadian Employment Law, a treatise published by Canada Law Book, and has acted as counsel in cases at every level of court, including the Supreme Court of Canada. He is called to the Ontario, Alberta and British Columbia bars and holds academic appointments at Osgoode Hall Law School and the University of Western Ontario's Faculty of Law.
stampone-law-hamilton:
Real estate, wills and family law are the work of Stampone Law, a Hamilton-area practice based in Stoney Creek. Siera Stampone is the owner and principal lawyer, and she also advises on estate planning, estate administration and corporate law.

She earned a Juris Doctor from the University of Ottawa in 2021, where she received the Corbin Estates Law Annual Prize and the STEP Canada Prize in wills and the law of succession. The firm is successor to the practice of Murray Mazza, who practised in Hamilton and the Niagara region for over 40 years, and it now has carriage of his files. Services include home purchases and sales, mortgage refinancing, powers of attorney, trusts and domestic contracts such as cohabitation agreements, marriage contracts and separation agreements.
star-legal-services-edmonton:
Star Legal Services is an Edmonton firm handling residential and commercial real estate, family law, motor vehicle injury and wills and estates matters.

Founding lawyer Gurkirtan Lali, born in Edmonton, earned her LLB at the University of Leicester in 2017 and was admitted to the Alberta bar in 2020; her practice centres on real estate, commercial and family law. The office also provides notary and commissioner for oaths services, and its team assists clients in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu from its Gateway Boulevard location.
state-law-firm:
State Law Firm is a Mississauga practice covering criminal defence, family law, real estate, accident benefits and civil litigation. It also handles wills and estates, and traffic matters such as speeding, careless driving, driving under the influence and driving without insurance, as well as CVOR offences.

The firm helps people charged with offences, handles marital breakdown and separation matters, and works through property purchases, sales and transfers. It also deals with insurance companies after car accidents and plans for end of life, illness and incapacity. The office is on Britannia Road West in Mississauga.
stayshyn-law-offices-hamilton:
Stayshyn Law Offices is a Hamilton personal injury firm serving Haldimand and Southern Ontario, including people denied insurance benefits.

Its work covers automobile accidents, slips and falls, trip and falls, premises liability, all-terrain vehicle accidents, boat accidents and motorcycle accidents. The firm also handles short and long term disability benefits and denials of critical illness and life insurance. It helps clients find treatment providers who can offer healthcare in their own language, and its team are litigators focused on personal injury.
stein-monast:
Stein Monast is a Quebec City business law firm whose services include insurance and liability, administrative and municipal law, and arbitration.

The firm has more than 60 years of history and more than 60 lawyers and notaries. The insurance team advises insurers, professional order insurance funds and financial institutions on professional liability, directors and officers liability, product liability and employment-related liability insurance. The administrative and municipal group covers access to information and privacy, government affairs, municipal taxation and assessment, and extraordinary remedies such as injunctions and court challenges to administrative decisions. The firm traces its lineage to figures including Louis St-Laurent, Jean Lesage and Paule Gauthier, and serves clients locally, nationally and internationally.
steinbergs-llp:
Steinbergs LLP is a North York firm handling business law, real estate, litigation, tax and wills and estate planning for clients of many sizes.

Irwin Steinberg founded the firm in 1972, and early clients in the pharmacy industry remain a key sector. In 2015 the firm added lawyers and established a tax practice, which few Toronto firms outside the downtown core offer. Its clients range from small owner-operated businesses to large multinational corporations. Common questions it addresses include being sued, partnership and shareholders agreements, and living wills, and it is a Toronto-based firm.
stellar-law-professional-corporation-nor:
Lawyers at Stellar Law Professional Corporation in North York act in civil litigation, family law and criminal defence. The practice also covers corporate commercial law and wills and estates.

Its lawyers, including Rana Nosratpanah and David Lee, have argued before provincial and federal courts. In family matters the firm works toward resolution through alternative dispute resolution or at trial. Flexible retainers are offered, and legal help is available outside business hours across the Greater Toronto Area, with an office on Sheppard Avenue East.
stemp-and-company-calgary:
Stemp & Company is a Calgary firm handling trademarks, patents and copyright, as well as real estate and wills and estates.

Trademark applications are prepared, filed and prosecuted in Canada, the USA and internationally, and patent work includes searches, applications and prosecution, with outside patent agents retained to assist. Industrial design is also covered. The firm prepares wills, personal directives and enduring powers of attorney, assists with probate and estate administration, acts on commercial and residential real estate, and handles litigation and incorporations.
stephane-cote-real-estate-lawyer-avocat-:
Stephane Cote Real Estate Lawyer/Avocat is a legal practice in Ottawa, Ontario, listed under real estate and wills and estates.

The office is at 2052 St Joseph Boulevard, and the practice name pairs the English word lawyer with the French avocat. Further detail about its lawyers, languages or services is not provided in this entry, which is limited to the name, address, city and listed practice areas.
stepup-immigration-inc-edmonton:
StepUp Immigration is an Edmonton firm of Registered Canadian Immigration Consultants assisting with visas, work permits and permanent residence.

The firm has served clients for over a decade and supports people who want to study, work or settle in Canada, from visa applications to permanent residency applications. It also offers post-landing guidance on banking, transport and renting or buying a home, along with application tracking. Topics it follows include new language test rules for permanent residence applications and open work permit changes for high-skilled workers as of January 2025.
stern-shapray-criminal-lawyers-surrey:
Stern Shapray Criminal Lawyers is a Surrey criminal defence firm acting in criminal, quasi-criminal and regulatory matters across British Columbia. Established in British Columbia in 1997, it is a multi-lawyer practice, so each file draws on the views of several lawyers rather than one.

Its lawyers defend people at every stage of the justice process, from investigation and arrest through trial, sentencing and appeal. The work ranges from serious criminal charges to regulatory offences under the Motor Vehicle Act and the Customs Act, as well as traffic tickets.
steven-chnaris-professional-corporation-:
Business, estate, family and court matters in Ottawa are handled by Steven Chnaris Professional Corporation, also known as SCPC Law Firm. The firm is led by Steven Chnaris, who acts as legal strategist and adviser to individuals and businesses.

Its services include counsel for businesses, representation in court, estate services and advice on family legal matters. The firm aims to keep clients informed with clear advice and to treat each client as an individual rather than a case number. The office is on Holly Lane in Ottawa.
steven-slimovitch-montreal:
Steven Slimovitch is a bilingual criminal defence lawyer in Montreal who has been in private practice since 1991.

He defends people under investigation or charged under the Criminal Code, the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act, the Income Tax Act and the Quebec Highway Safety Act, and acts in penal and Charter of Rights litigation for individuals and corporations. He has appeared at all levels of court, including the Supreme Court of Canada, in matters concerning freedom of religion and the validity of certain search warrants. His office is in the Old Port of Montreal, and he also represents clients elsewhere in Quebec and in provinces including New Brunswick, Ontario and Saskatchewan.
steven-tress-barrister-and-solicitor-tor:
Steven Tress, Barrister & Solicitor, practises immigration law in Toronto, handling family sponsorship, permanent residence and appeals. The firm has practised Canadian immigration law in Toronto for over 35 years, acting for spouses and family members seeking sponsorship, students applying for study visas, skilled immigrants and professionals seeking permanent residence, business people and investors, and employers arranging corporate transfers or foreign recruitment.

It also assists people in Canada who want to restore status or apply on humanitarian and compassionate grounds, and those facing admissibility or deportation proceedings, immigration appeals or Federal Court applications. Cases include criminal and medical inadmissibility, misrepresentation, rehabilitation and residency appeals. Criminal law services are also offered from the University Avenue office.
stewart-sharma-harsanyi-immigration-law-:
Stewart Sharma Harsanyi Immigration Law is a Calgary firm handling immigration applications, appeals and refugee protection matters. Its partners are former immigration officers and hearings officers who made decisions under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act, and a former Refugee Board member works with the team.

The practice acts for corporations, executives, families and people seeking refugee protection, and covers spousal and family sponsorship, financial and medical inadmissibility, and appeals to the Immigration Appeal Division and Federal Court. Family and divorce law and criminal defence are also practised, and the lawyers work where criminal and immigration law overlap. The office is in Calgary House on 6 Avenue SW.
stikeman-elliott-llp:
Stikeman Elliott LLP is a Toronto business law firm advising on corporate and M&A work and capital markets matters for clients in Canada and abroad.

The firm also has offices in Montréal, Ottawa, Calgary, Vancouver, New York and London. Recent work includes acting as Canadian counsel to Alimentation Couche-Tard on its US$8.6 billion tender offer for the shares of Żabka Group. The firm also handles insolvency and restructuring, with 29 of its lawyers featured in a Lexpert special edition on that field, and follows the effects of tariff measures on North American trade.
stikeman-elliott-llp-calgary:
Stikeman Elliott LLP is a Canadian business law firm with a Calgary office in Bankers Hall West, covering energy and corporate and M&A matters.

The firm provides Canadian legal services to clients around the world from offices in Montréal, Toronto, Ottawa, Calgary, Vancouver, New York and London. It acted as Canadian counsel to Alimentation Couche-Tard on a US$8.6 billion voluntary tender offer for Żabka Group, a private equity deal named Deal of the Year at an industry event, and 29 of its lawyers are featured in the Lexpert special edition on insolvency and restructuring for 2026. It also follows how tariff measures could affect North American trade.
stikeman-elliott-montreal:
Stikeman Elliott (Montreal) is the Montreal office of a Canadian business law firm that handles corporate and mergers and acquisitions work.

The firm also has offices in Toronto, Ottawa, Calgary, Vancouver, New York and London, and serves clients around the world. Recent work includes advising Alimentation Couche-Tard as Canadian counsel on its US$8.6 billion voluntary tender offer for all shares of Żabka Group. Its insolvency and restructuring lawyers are featured in a Lexpert special edition, and the firm follows how tariff measures could affect North American trade.
stirling-llp-vancouver:
Stirling LLP is a Vancouver business law firm handling corporate, commercial lending, real estate and conveyancing work. It also advises on estate planning and on natural resources and energy matters, and it shares office space with Langford Law while operating independently of it.

Corporate services include the purchase and sale of a business, incorporating BC and federal companies, limited partnerships, societies and not-for-profits, confidentiality and non-compete agreements, and settlement agreements, waivers, releases and indemnities. Commercial lending work covers collateral mortgages, secured lines of credit, security over Crown lands and First Nations lands, and Personal Property Security Act registrations.
stokes-law-llp-calgary:
Stokes Law LLP is a Calgary firm offering family law, mediation and civil litigation services in Alberta.

The firm describes itself as a collaborative team, where each lawyer draws on the knowledge of the whole firm. Its lawyers speak several languages, including Afrikaans, Hindi, Punjabi, Portuguese, Urdu and Yoruba, and the firm offers in-office notarization.
strategia-juridique:
Strategia Juridique is a business and commercial law firm in Longueuil, with an office in the Saint-Hubert area on boulevard Moïse-Vincent.

The firm's services cover incorporation and the keeping of corporate record books, as well as taxation for corporations, trusts and individuals. It belongs to the Réseau des professionnels du droit du Québec network for the Montérégie region. This entry does not give further detail on clients or courts.
stroll-law-group-vancouver:
Stroll Law Group is a Vancouver firm handling business, entertainment and immigration law for filmmakers, artists and entrepreneurs. Established in 2007, the practice is led by sole practitioner Orrin Stroll, a business and entertainment lawyer with more than 18 years of experience alongside independent film producers and production companies in Western Canada.

Entertainment work includes film and television agreements for every stage from development through production, post-production, delivery and distribution, as well as Errors and Omissions insurance. The firm also handles personal and business immigration matters under federal and provincial programs, plus general corporate and commercial work, and encourages clients to stay involved in and informed about their own legal matters.
suk-law-professional-corporation:
Suk Law Professional Corporation handles real estate, wills and estates, and corporate and commercial matters from its St. Catharines headquarters.

Nicholas J. Suk is the owner and sole lawyer. He holds an honours degree in political science from Brock University and a law degree from the University of Ottawa, was admitted to the Law Society of Ontario in April 2021, and has practised in wills and estates, real estate, corporate, municipal and construction law. The firm provides real estate services for buyers, sellers and investors in Niagara Falls and estate planning, probate and powers of attorney for clients in Fort Erie and Port Colborne, in person or virtually, with flat-fee options.
sullivan-law-ptbo:
Sullivan Law Ptbo is a Peterborough practice covering home purchases, family law, business law, wills, estates and notarizing documents.

The firm's approach is that of a lawyer for life, with kindness and respect toward clients, colleagues and the community as its values. Family work includes cohabitation and separation agreements, along with a private dispute resolution process for settling matters outside court. It also handles powers of attorney, estate administration and professional trustee services. The firm chooses local suppliers, gives community grants and shares a land acknowledgement, and its office is on Queen Street.
sullivan-law-winnipeg:
Business law and real estate are the primary practice areas of Sullivan Law, a boutique Winnipeg firm that also handles wills, estates and notary services.

The firm was re-established by John Sullivan and acts for individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses and organizations on matters of Manitoba law, including clients outside the province. sullivan-mahoney-llp:

sullivan-mcmullan-winnipeg:
Sullivan McMullan is a Winnipeg firm that practises only real estate law, from home purchases and sales to commercial and development work. It handles residential and commercial transactions, development, financing, leasing and dispute resolution.

summit-legal-group-calgary:
Summit Legal Group is a boutique Calgary firm covering real estate, wills and estates, business law, domestic contracts and notary services.

summit-point-law-edmonton:
Summit Point Law is an Edmonton immigration practice offering services in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu.

sunny-kaler-law-abbotsford:
Sunny Kaler Law is a criminal defence practice in Abbotsford, British Columbia, with its office on Townline Road in Abbotsford.

Criminal defence is the firm's practice area. Further details about its lawyers, services or court experience are not part of this entry, which is limited to the firm's name, its Abbotsford location, its street address and its practice area.
surrovik-law-corporation-surrey:
Surrovik Law Corporation is a Surrey firm handling family law and civil matters, including divorce, child support and personal injury. Jagriti Jaswal founded the firm, and its lawyers act for clients in Vancouver and the surrounding area.

surya-law-toronto:

susan-karpa-calgary:
Susan Karpa is a Calgary criminal defence lawyer handling assault, sexual offence, drug and firearms charges for clients across Alberta.

sutharsan-law-professional-corporation-t:
Sutharsan Law is a criminal defence firm that handles assault, bail, impaired driving, drug, fraud and sexual offence charges.

sutherland-criminal-defence-edmonton:
Sutherland Criminal Defence is an Edmonton firm led by Ellen Sutherland, handling sexual offences, domestic violence, driving charges and murder cases.

suzanne-desrosiers-professional-corporat:
Suzanne Desrosiers Professional Corporation is a Timmins firm practising employment law, real estate and estates, with workplace training for employers.

sv-law:
SV Law serves Guelph, Elora and Waterloo with business, condominium, construction, employment, family, farm and real estate law.

swift-law-calgary:
Swift Law is a Calgary real estate law practice, also called Swift LLP, handling residential purchases, sales and refinances.

The firm is a mobile practice based in Marda Loop, with flexible appointment options. swiftsure-law-victoria:
Swiftsure Law is a boutique family law firm in Victoria, BC, handling divorce, separation, parenting and child support matters.

szakacs-law-injury-lawyers-calgary-calga:
Szakacs Law Injury Lawyers is a Calgary personal injury firm that represented people hurt in car, truck, motorcycle and pedestrian accidents.

tabuchi-law-mississauga:
Tabuchi Law is a Mississauga firm handling wills, estate planning, probate, real estate and family agreements across Ontario.

taerk-family-law-toronto:
Taerk Family Law, on Queen Street West in Toronto, acts in divorce, separation, parenting, support and property division matters. The firm has more than 22 years of experience in family law and serves families across Toronto and the GTA.

tailor-law-professional-corporation-miss:
Tailor Law Professional Corporation is a Mississauga family law firm handling divorce, custody, support and property matters. tapper-cuddy-llp-winnipeg:
Tapper Cuddy LLP is a Winnipeg firm focused on civil litigation, commercial law and family law, with more than 20 practice areas in total.

tarnow-criminal-law-richmond:
Tarnow Criminal Law is a Richmond, British Columbia criminal defence firm acting for people charged with offences throughout Metro Vancouver.

tarnowecky-law-professional-corporation:
Tarnowecky Law Professional Corporation is a law practice in Kingston, Ontario, with its office on Arlington Park Place.

tas-law-firm-mississauga:
TAS Law Firm is a Mississauga family law practice offering uncontested divorce, separation agreements and child custody matters on flat fees.

tathgar-law:
Tathgar Law is a Victoria firm handling real estate, business and estate planning matters, with a second office in Nanaimo.

taurus-law-edmonton:

taylor-janis-workplace-lawyers-vancouver:
Taylor Janis LLP is a workplace law firm focused on labour, employment and related litigation for clients in Alberta and British Columbia.

taylor-law-calgary:
Taylor Law is a Calgary boutique firm handling real estate and estate planning for vendors, purchasers, mortgagors and mortgagees.

taylor-mccaffrey-llp-winnipeg:
Taylor McCaffrey LLP is a full-service Winnipeg firm acting for businesses, governments and individuals, with work extending to Manitoba, Ontario and Nunavut.

tc-legal-calgary:
TC Legal is a Calgary firm handling criminal defence and personal injury matters for clients who have been charged or injured.

tcj-brossard:
TCJ (Therrien Couture Joli-Coeur) is a Brossard firm of lawyers, notaries and financial analysts serving businesses, professionals and public bodies.

tcz-law-toronto:
TCZ Law is a Toronto family law firm handling divorce, separation, custody, support and domestic contracts, with services in English and Chinese.

team-law-group-llp-edmonton:
Team Law Group LLP is an Edmonton firm offering immigration, corporate and commercial, criminal defence and real estate conveyancing services.

temple-of-justice-legal-service-hamilton:

tessera-avocats-inc:
Tessera Avocats is a Montreal boutique firm handling corporate, commercial, real estate and financing matters, along with dispute resolution. It was founded by four lawyers whose practices complement each other.

tevlin-gleadle-curtis-vancouver:
Tevlin Gleadle Curtis is a Vancouver employment law firm handling wrongful dismissal, constructive dismissal and human rights matters. Murray Tevlin and Dan Gleadle founded it in 2000, and it acts for employees, groups of employees, employers and contractors across Canada.

the-criminal-law-team-north-york:

the-law-offices-of-nikolas-j-lust-ottawa:

the-law-portal-vancouver:
