the-legal-pillars-pc-mississauga:
The Legal Pillars is a Mississauga firm handling family, criminal and real estate matters, and it describes itself as advocates for justice in Ontario.

the-litigators:

the-myers-law-company-vancouver:
The Myers Law Company is a Vancouver criminal defence firm led by Justin Myers and Zack Myers, with traffic and family matters also covered.

the-riley-divorce-and-family-law-firm:

thind-law-enterprise-professional-corpor:
Real estate, corporate and immigration law are the main work of Thind Law Enterprise Professional Corporation in Brampton. The firm also takes on civil litigation and other matters for clients across Canada.

thompson-dorfman-sweatman-llp-winnipeg:
Thompson Dorfman Sweatman LLP, known as TDS, is a full-service Winnipeg firm with Manitoba roots dating to 1887 and offices in Brandon and Boissevain.

thomson-rogers-llp:

threshold-law-winnipeg:

tidal-law-llp-edmonton:
Tidal Law LLP is a full-service firm with offices in Calgary and Edmonton, serving individuals, entrepreneurs and businesses across Alberta.

Its practice covers commercial, corporate, real estate, civil litigation and family law matters. The family law pages explain divorce, separation, and parenting and financial issues.
tierney-stauffer-llp:
Tierney Stauffer LLP is a full-service Ottawa law firm handling business, real estate, employment, estates and personal injury matters.

tim-louis-and-company-law-firm-vancouver:
Tim Louis & Company Law Firm is a Vancouver practice handling long-term disability cases, wills and estates, personal injury and employment law.

tina-fasano-lindy-mcdonald-lawyers:
Tina Fasano & Lindy McDonald Lawyers is a Kingston firm focused on family law, with employment, wills and estates, mediation and real estate work as well.

titan-law-toronto:

tlc-family-law-prince-george:
TLC Family Law Practice is a Prince George firm handling divorce, parenting arrangements, support and property division under British Columbia family law.

tlc-legal-professional-corporation-ottaw:

tlm-avocat-divorce-montreal:

top-law-firm-north-york:
This North York law practice provides real estate legal services to clients in Toronto and the surrounding area. It is listed as a general practice, and its team handles the real estate legal needs of its clients.

torkin-manes-llp:
Torkin Manes LLP is a full-service business and litigation law firm in downtown Toronto.

toronto-civil-litigation-lawyers-toronto:

torys-llp-calgary:

traffic-tickets-toronto-toronto:
Traffic Tickets Toronto defends drivers charged with speeding, stunt driving, careless driving and other traffic offences in Ontario and Manitoba.

The business traces to Shelina Lalji, who joined POINTTS in 2008, became its master franchisee in 2015 and later launched the JUSTICEJOLT Legal Defence for Drivers brand. The team has more than 17 years of experience and offers paralegal-led defence aimed at protecting licences, records and insurance costs. Services include demerit point matters, handheld device violations, dangerous driving and related criminal charges, appeals, licence reinstatement and CVOR defence for commercial operators.
travers-law-guelph:
Travers Law is a Guelph firm with a high-volume real estate, wills and estates, and business law practice across four Ontario offices.

The offices are in Kitchener-Waterloo, Cambridge, Guelph and Milton. Don Travers, admitted to the bar in 1974, founded the firm in 1981 under the name Paquette Travers and served on Kitchener council and Waterloo Regional Council. The firm has worked in real estate law for over 40 years, offers evening appointments, remote and virtual meetings and fixed fees, and serves Waterloo, Kitchener, Cambridge, Fergus, Elora, Puslinch and Wellington County. Bryan Mayes and Robert A. Sheldon are also with the firm, and family law is a secondary area.
traxler-haines:
Traxler Haines is a Prince George firm handling real estate conveyancing, wills and estates, and business and corporate law since 1974.

The firm has six lawyers and offers services ranging from mediation to commercial contracts for residents of Prince George and surrounding communities. Its corporate law practice advises businesses from sole proprietors to international organizations, including on investments, disputes with associates, taxes and expenses. The office is on 4th Avenue.
tremblay-law-group-pc-north-bay:
Tremblay Law Group PC is a North Bay firm offering real estate, corporate, litigation, family, criminal and estates law in the Nipissing area.

Services are offered in English and French, with lawyers also serving Sturgeon Falls. The practice traces to 1993, when Wallace & Carr and Klein & Klein merged as Wallace Klein Partners in Law, followed by a 2024 rebrand under Managing Partner Christian Tremblay. It now has eight legal professionals. Real estate work includes commercial and industrial transactions, conventional, high ratio and reverse mortgages, power of sale and foreclosure proceedings, and condominium registration.
treo-law-llp-brandon:
Treo Law LLP is a Brandon firm serving Western Manitoba in family law, property division, real estate, corporate and criminal law.

Child protection is also a practice area. Partners are Breena R. Murray and Courtney A. Buckman, and associates are Sundeep S. Dhillon, Lyric D. Stewart and O. Sarah Idowu. Property division covers homes, farms, businesses and pensions, while real estate work covers residential, commercial and agricultural purchases and sales. Real estate and criminal services are available in Punjabi, Hindi, Urdu, Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin, subject to lawyer availability.
trivium-law-richmond:
Trivium Law is a Richmond firm handling business, real estate, and wills and estates matters, with offices in Richmond and Vancouver. Business work runs from entity setup and financing to shareholder and partnership agreements, acquisitions, franchising and commercial leasing.

Real estate services cover purchases, sales, financing and development, including REDMA compliance, pre-sale agreements, disclosure statements, subdivisions, stratification and land assemblies, plus commercial and industrial due diligence and bare trusts. The firm also handles tax-driven corporate reorganizations, succession planning and wealth preservation.
truman-law-surrey:
Truman Law is a Surrey firm advising on real estate, corporate matters, civil litigation, foreclosures and estate planning. Principal lawyer Harkirat Singh Kang founded it in 2020 as a litigation practice and expanded into residential and commercial real estate in 2021.

He was called to the bar in Delhi in 2013, Ontario in 2016 and British Columbia in 2017, and has appeared in the Provincial Court and the Supreme Court of British Columbia. His real estate work includes foreclosures, encumbered titles, private lending, corporate ownership structures and non-standard closings, and the firm also prepares wills, powers of attorney and representation agreements.
trust-law-barristers-and-solicitors-edmo:
Trust Law, Barristers and Solicitors is an Edmonton firm practising real estate, personal injury, estate, employment and commercial law since 2020.

Practice areas include real estate, personal injury, estate law, employment law and wrongful dismissal, corporate law and complex commercial matters. Dev S. Nanda is a partner. The office is on 80 Avenue NW in Edmonton and acts for individuals, families and businesses across Alberta, and the firm has completed more than a billion dollars in real estate and other transactions.
ts-canadian-immigration-services-brandon:
TS Canadian Immigration Services is a Brandon, Manitoba immigration practice assisting people who want to work, study or settle in Canada.

The practice helps with work permits, study visas and permanent residence applications. It is listed under immigration and operates from 930 Lorne Avenue in Brandon, Manitoba, serving people who plan to work, study or immigrate to Canada.
tsf-law-mississauga:
TSF Law is a Mississauga personal injury firm acting for people with denied long term disability benefits and injuries from car accidents and falls.

The firm practises personal injury law exclusively and acts for clients from across Ontario. Partner Terio Francis grew up in Toronto, studied at Dalhousie's Schulich School of Law, and has appeared before the Superior Court of Justice and the License Appeal Tribunal and arbitrated at the Financial Services Commission of Ontario. The team also includes associate KristoFer Angle, licensed paralegal Licia Lionessa, Andrea Seecharan and Andreea Savin, and the head office is on Traders Boulevard East.
turbide-avocat:
Turbide Avocat is a Levis business law practice handling incorporations, contracts and shareholder agreements across Quebec.

The practice serves entrepreneurs, small and medium-sized businesses, professionals and athletes, and offers defined legal services at displayed prices through an online client portal, with meetings held remotely or in person. Packages include federal and Quebec incorporation, shareholder agreements for two or three shareholders, and 30- or 60-minute meetings. A separate incorporation package is aimed at physicians, dentists, pharmacists, engineers, architects, accountants and other regulated professionals.
tuscano-law-surrey:
Tuscano Law is a Surrey firm handling immigration, family, criminal, wills and estates, personal injury and civil litigation matters. Founder Arica began her legal career in Mumbai in 2014, worked in firms in Mumbai and Vancouver, and was called to the Law Society of British Columbia in 2021.

The firm accepts Legal Aid clients and offers unbundled services, in which the lawyer handles only part of a matter and the client carries out the remaining tasks, which can make legal help more accessible. Arica holds an LLM in Business Law and belongs to the Law Society of British Columbia, the Trial Lawyers Association of BC and the South Asian Bar Association of British Columbia.
twin-lisbet-avocats-and-fiscalistes-mont:
Twin Lisbet Avocats & Fiscalistes is a Montreal firm practising tax litigation, tax and estate planning and business law.

On the tax side, the firm handles objections to notices of assessment, negotiation with Revenu Québec and the Canada Revenue Agency, and representation from tax audit through to litigation. Business work includes purchases and mergers of companies, commercial and civil litigation, regulatory compliance, international contracts and cross-border disputes, trademarks, patents and real estate law. Estate planning covers wills, mandates in case of incapacity, trusts, life insurance and the liquidation of estates, including business succession and blended families.
tz-law-calgary:
TZ Law is a Calgary boutique handling employment, human rights and privacy law for employees and employers across Alberta and British Columbia.

Its work covers wrongful termination, discrimination, privacy and contractual matters, and it advises people on whether to accept a severance offer or sign a release. It also acts for businesses, including start-ups and entrepreneurs dealing with growth, compliance and risk. Fee options are contingency, hourly and hybrid arrangements. The full range of services is provided in both English and Mandarin. The office is on 11 Avenue SW in downtown Calgary.
umpc-law-notary-public-and-lawyers-calga:
UMPC Law Notary Public & Lawyers is a northeast Calgary practice focused on immigration and personal injury law. UMPC LAW is the trade name of Usman Mahmood Professional Corporation, and Usman Mahmood established the firm.

Immigration work supports individuals and families from the first meeting through to a final decision, including appeals, while the injury practice acts for people hurt through negligence or in accidents. Real estate, family and criminal law are also handled, along with wills and estates. The office is on 26 Street NE.
unified-immigration-lawyers-toronto:
Unified Immigration Lawyers is a Toronto firm handling Canadian and American immigration applications, appeals and sponsorships.

The firm was formerly known as Matkowsky Immigration Law and was founded in 2017. It acts for individuals, families and corporations, with work ranging from Federal Court appeals and spousal sponsorship to executive work visas. Clients deal directly with lawyers rather than consultants or paralegals, and the firm works on flat fees. Sonia Akilov is associated with the firm, and a step-by-step process takes each file from first meeting to filing.
unified-llp-toronto:
Unified LLP is a Toronto firm handling long-term disability, family, real estate, labour and employment matters for clients across Ontario.

The firm has offices in Toronto and also serves the GTA and Kitchener. On the labour side it acts for unions, not individual grievors, in grievance arbitration, tribunals, professional regulators and courts. Its family group handles uncontested and contested divorces, separation agreements, support and parenting, with flat-fee options for straightforward matters. For disability cases, it helps people whose short-term or long-term benefits are denied, delayed or cut off, and some matters proceed on a contingency fee basis.
valin-partners-llp:
Valin Partners LLP is a full-service North Bay firm, founded in 1936, covering real estate, corporate, estates, employment, family and litigation matters.

The firm was founded by Ken Valin and Bill Flannery, and it serves North Bay, Callander, Nipissing, Parry Sound and New Liskeard. Areas include residential and commercial real estate, incorporations and mergers, wills and powers of attorney, estate litigation, municipal law and construction law. Its team includes Gordon A. Prisco, Kathleen N. Klein, Andrew D. Lawson, Brianne M. Levasseur and others, and several past lawyers were elevated to the bench, including Senior Regional Judge Spyros Loukidelis.
vallillee-family-lawyers-london:
Vallillee Family Lawyers is a London, Ontario boutique handling separation, divorce, parenting, support, property and Children's Aid Society matters.

The firm accepts family cases at the London and St. Thomas courthouses, including motions to change and contempt motions, and matters involving the Children's Aid Society of London & Middlesex. Services include separation agreements, court litigation, and Voice of the Child reports for children aged seven to fifteen, or older with special needs. Lawyer David is a Western University law graduate who also flies for the animal rescue charity Pilots4Paws. The firm acts for parents, grandparents and other family members.
van-looyen-and-fallon-law-professional-c:
Van Looyen and Fallon is a Hamilton family law firm that also serves Brantford and surrounding areas, practising family law exclusively.

The firm is run by a wife and husband team, Emily Van Looyen and Patrick Fallon. Emily has practised family law for eight years and appears in the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice and Unified Family Courts. She is a trained Collaborative Practice professional, acts as an agent for the Office of the Children's Lawyer, supervises for Pro Bono Students Canada and sits on the board of a Hamilton community agency. The team also includes a legal assistant and a law clerk, and the firm takes an organized, personal approach to each matter.
varity-law:
Varity Law is a Richmond Hill firm handling probate and estates, real estate, and corporate and commercial law for families and business owners.

Probate comes first, with work for executors that includes the application, court filings and monitoring until the Certificate of Appointment is issued. The firm does not handle estate litigation or disputes. Its team includes Sabrina Ding, an Osgoode Hall graduate whose team has closed real estate purchases, sales and refinances since 2017, and Jonathan Thibert, along with law clerks. On the business side, it advises on incorporation, contracts, buy-sell arrangements and succession, and serves clients across Ontario.
veale-law:
Veale Law is a Vancouver personal injury firm with an office on the 13th floor at 1500 West Georgia Street.

The firm is listed under personal injury in Vancouver, British Columbia. Details about its lawyers, services or approach are not recorded in this entry, which is limited to the firm's name, its office address and its practice area.
velandia-pouyes-avocats:
Velandia & Pouyes Avocats is a criminal defence firm in Rosemere, Quebec, handling impaired driving, sexual offence, domestic violence and fraud charges. Also known as VP Avocats, the practice is concentrated on criminal law and supports accused people in Quebec with rigour and clarity.

The firm has four core practice areas plus an emergency path for people who have just been arrested or whose relative is detained, with round-the-clock availability. Economic offences it handles include fraud, theft, breach of trust, forged documents and money laundering. Cases in a conjugal context carry conditions from the first appearance, such as orders prohibiting communication. Release hearings are also among its matters. The office is on Chemin de la Grande-Côte.
velletta-pedersen-christie-lawyers-victo:
Velletta Pedersen Christie Lawyers is a full-service Victoria firm covering litigation, corporate, real estate, family and estates law. Practising since 1982, it acts for clients in Victoria, across Canada and abroad.

Its business work includes contracts, publishing companies, royalty agreements and non-disclosure agreements, along with share and asset purchases, and it also handles immigration, employment, personal injury and entertainment law. Its lawyers have appeared before the Supreme Court of Canada, the British Columbia Court of Appeal, the Federal Court of Canada and the Court Martial Appeal Court of Canada.
verdicta-llp-edmonton:
Verdicta LLP is an Edmonton firm handling criminal defence, DUI and SafeRoads sanctions, real estate, family law and civil litigation. It is based in Whitemud Business Park and offers services in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu.

The practice also covers corporate and commercial law, traffic tickets, emergency protection orders, and wills and estates, with fixed fees for real estate work. Lawyers Jatin J. Sahni, Milan M. Sahni and Tajvir S. Dhillon serve Edmonton, St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Stony Plain and Leduc.
veritas-avocats:
Veritas Avocats is a Laval firm focused on family law, including divorce, separation, common-law couples, child support and child custody. Its lawyers keep clients informed of important developments and stay available to answer questions throughout a matter.

Civil litigation is also among its practice areas, and a fair hourly rate applies whatever the complexity of the file. Family disputes are difficult when emotions are involved, so files are taken on quickly from the first exchange, and transparency and communication are part of the firm's values. The office is at 271 Rue Corbin, Suite 201.
verreau-dufresne-avocats:
Verreau Dufresne Avocats is a Levis firm serving Québec City and Lévis in civil litigation, business, family and labour law.

The firm offers three kinds of mandate: full handling of a lawsuit with a lean toward negotiated settlement, an a la carte supervision service for people representing themselves in court, and advice and representation where no court file exists. Its business law division works with start-up, growing and established companies in commercial and corporate matters, and many of its business lawyers have been entrepreneurs themselves.
vey-willetts-llp-ottawa:
Employment law is the sole focus of Vey Willetts LLP, an Ottawa firm acting for both employers and employees in workplace disputes.

Its lawyers are Andrew N. Vey, Paul J. Willetts, Maureen Carlos and R. Ross Dunsmore. They have appeared before the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice, the Court of Appeal for Ontario, the Human Rights Tribunal of Ontario, the Ontario Labour Relations Board and the Canada Industrial Relations Board, as well as in arbitrations and mediations. The downtown Ottawa office serves the National Capital Region and communities including Brockville, Cornwall, Kingston, Pembroke, Petawawa and Carleton Place.
vick-hundal-brampton:
Vick Hundal represents people charged with assault, impaired driving, fraud, theft and drug offences in Brampton and across the GTA. He appears at all levels of court in Ontario and serves clients in Bramalea, Churchville, Mount Pleasant, Castlemore, Tullamore and Snelgrove.

Matters include bail hearings, youth cases, domestic assault, sexual assault, robbery, over 80 charges, attempted murder and murder. His approach covers understanding the court process, identifying flaws in the Crown's case, building a defence strategy and protecting a client's rights.
vickers-law-group:
Vickers Law Group is an Abbotsford firm offering legal guidance in civil litigation, probate and employment throughout the Fraser Valley.

The firm is also listed under business law and contracts, with an office on McCallum Road in Abbotsford, British Columbia. Details about its lawyers, history and approach are not recorded in this entry, which is limited to the firm's name, location, address and practice areas.
victoria-xu-law-office-toronto:
Victoria Xu Law Office is a Toronto firm handling family law, wills and estates, and real estate matters across the GTA. Lawyer Victoria Xu has worked in family law, real estate, employment, immigration, wills and estates and contracts since 2015 and has appeared before several levels of court and administrative tribunals. She is an accredited mediator with OAFM and FDRIO, and family clients can proceed through litigation, mediation or limited scope services.

Other services include real estate transactions with mortgages and refinancing, wills, trusts and powers of attorney, civil litigation appearances, preparation of contracts and legal opinion letters, and document notarization and legalization. Ms. Xu belongs to the Ontario Bar Association, the Federation of Asian Canadian Lawyers and the Canadian Bar Association, and is also a member of the Law Society of Saskatchewan.
vilkhov-law-professional-corporation-tor:
Downtown Toronto criminal defence is the focus of Vilkhov Law Professional Corporation, led by lawyer Igor Vilkhov. The firm defends charges including sexual assault, impaired driving, assault, drug possession and fraud, and clients deal with Igor Vilkhov directly rather than with an associate or paralegal.

Based on Richmond Street West, it also serves Etobicoke, Scarborough, Mississauga, Brampton, Newmarket, Barrie, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Innisfil and Ajax. Igor Vilkhov has handled more than 5,000 cases in Ontario courts.
vilma-radfar-barrister-and-solicitor-nor:
Family law is the main focus of Vilma Radfar Barrister & Solicitor, a boutique firm in North York covering divorce, parenting and support. Founded by Vilma Radfar, who was called to the Ontario bar in 2017, the firm acts in decision-making responsibility and parenting time, child and spousal support, property division, motions to change court orders and child protection matters. Out-of-court work includes cohabitation agreements, marriage contracts and separation agreements.

Vilma holds a Juris Doctor from the University of Ottawa and an honours Bachelor of Arts in sociology from York University. She is a panel member of Legal Aid Ontario, serving financially eligible, low-income clients, and also assists victims of domestic abuse. Matters proceed through court or alternative dispute resolution.
vincent-mark-law-corporation-burnaby:
Vincent Mark Law Corporation is a Burnaby firm handling real estate, family, business, immigration and personal injury matters. Aikay Vincent Oduoza is its founder and principal partner, and the firm serves clients in Burnaby, Vancouver, Richmond, Surrey, New Westminster, Coquitlam and the wider Lower Mainland.

Real estate work covers commercial and residential purchases, sales and refinancing, leasing and real estate litigation, while other services include contract disputes, small claims and estate planning. The firm also offers board secretarial and on-demand corporate legal services to companies, with fixed fees where possible.
viridius-lex-llp-kingston:
Real estate, corporate and commercial, environmental and not-for-profit law make up Viridius Lex LLP, a Kingston firm. It also has an office in Toronto, and a digital platform lets it handle real estate transactions anywhere in Ontario, with virtual meetings and electronic signing available.

Business services include formation, restructuring, commercial leases and contracts. Environmental work covers regulatory compliance, allocating environmental risk in business and real estate transactions, and drafting and registering conservation easement agreements. The lawyers share a background in public interest law, and the team includes partner Rizwan Khan and law clerk Sandra Choi.
virtual-law-group-canada-calgary:
Virtual Law Group Canada is a Calgary firm, established in 2022, offering immigration, family, real estate, estate and business law online or in person.

Its practice also covers personal injury, employment law, estate administration, and complex commercial and civil litigation, and its lawyers provide litigation and research support to other law firms. The lawyers bring legal experience from Canada, the United Kingdom, India, Nigeria and the Caribbean. Services are delivered online, with in-person meetings where necessary, for clients across Canada.
visa-law-group-pc-north-york:
Visa Law Group PC is a North York immigration firm handling refusals, Federal Court litigation and Canada visa applications. It acts for applicants who have been refused, including study permit, Express Entry and start-up visa work permit refusals taken to Federal Court, and for people facing misrepresentation allegations.

The firm also assists individuals and businesses with temporary and permanent residence applications, appeals and inadmissibility issues, and with business immigration through the Start-up Visa Program, provincial nominee entrepreneur streams and the Global Talent Stream. Meetings can be held virtually.
vml-family-law-llp-calgary:
VML Family Law LLP is a Calgary family law firm offering divorce, custody, child support, mediation, arbitration and litigation services.

The team includes mediators, arbitrators, parenting coordinators and litigators. Services also include asset and debt separation, adoption, child abduction law, prenuptial agreements, legal coaching and the preparation of agreements and legal documents. Emily Varga is a co-founding partner, and the team also includes Holly McCord Lonseth, Suman Parmar, Tanisha Smith, Anne Marie Harrison, Danijela Radinovic, Caleigh Hunt, Hannah Grant and Kamiko Bosch. The firm takes a compassionate approach to emotionally charged family matters and has an office on 4 Street SW.
vo-law-etobicoke:
Vi Vo founded Vo Law, an Etobicoke firm handling residential and commercial real estate along with wills and estates. Principal lawyer Vi Vo holds Juris Doctor degrees from the University of Ottawa and Michigan State University and an Honours Bachelor of Science from the University of Toronto. Her practice covers business law, real estate law and wills and estates, and she is frequently invited to speak at first-time home buyer seminars hosted by local brokerages.

The firm acts on purchases, mortgages, sales and refinancing of detached homes, condominiums and townhouses, as well as commercial real estate. It offers traditional and non-traditional legal services to clients of all financial abilities and works from Bloor Street West, serving the Toronto market.
vora-law-professional-corporation-toront:
In five languages, Vora Law Professional Corporation serves Toronto clients in real estate, immigration, estate and family law. Mona Vora is the founder and principal lawyer of the GTA-based practice in Scarborough, which focuses on moving matters forward in a timely way.

Legal services are offered in English, Hindi, Urdu, Marathi and Gujarati, with notary services alongside the main practice areas. The firm aims to tailor solutions to each client's needs and objectives, and its office is on Sheppard Avenue East in Scarborough.
vrs-law-firm:
VRS Law Firm is a Kitchener firm preparing wills and powers of attorney and acting in probate and real estate matters, including for Cambridge clients.

Varun Sharma, who received his law degree from the University of New Brunswick and a BA from McMaster University, was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2012. His real estate work covers buying, selling and refinancing for first-time purchasers through to downsizers, and he assists lenders, investors and companies. Andrew Captan is also with the firm. Up-front fee quotes are offered for real estate matters, and estate planning is personalized, including choosing who manages affairs and who looks after children.
vsr-law-professional-corporation:
VSR Law Professional Corporation is a Mississauga firm handling real estate, personal injury, immigration, debt consolidation and notarial services.

Its real estate practice covers purchases, sales, refinancing and closings, and it also serves clients in Kitchener, Cambridge and Brampton. The personal injury side covers cases arising from car accidents, bicycle accidents, dog bites, pedestrian collisions, chronic pain and psychological injury, and catastrophic injury. The firm acts for injured people across Ontario, and legal fees on injury cases are payable only if compensation is recovered. It also handles immigration matters and builds a case strategy from the start of each file.
wahab-law-kitchener:
Wahab Law is a Kitchener firm handling real estate, family, employment, wills and estate, and civil litigation matters.

The firm serves Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, the Greater Toronto Area and surrounding regions. Khaled Wahab is the managing lawyer, with Nima Pannu as an associate and Richard David Christy as executive advisor. Real estate work covers buying, selling and refinancing with transparent pricing, while the family practice handles custody disputes, support calculations, asset distribution and divorce. Notary services and independent legal advice are also offered, and clients are served throughout the Waterloo Region.
walsh-llp:
Walsh LLP is a full-service Calgary firm serving Southern Alberta, with practices in agriculture, business, litigation and real estate law. It has more than sixty-five years of history across four generations and five offices: Calgary, Canmore, Okotoks, Claresholm and Stand Off.

Practice areas include agriculture law, alternative dispute resolution, business and corporate law, civil and commercial litigation, commercial real estate, construction litigation and employment law. The agriculture group covers business structure, succession planning, banking and financing, and several Walsh lawyers have been active farmers. Most of the firm's work comes from long-standing clients, and it aims to give advice in plain language.
warnett-hallen-llp:
Warnett Hallen LLP is a Vancouver personal injury firm handling auto accident, slip and fall and other serious injury cases.

The firm was founded by personal injury lawyers Paul Warnett and Manjot Hallen, and its partners each have decades of experience litigating injury cases. It works on a contingency fee basis, so legal fees are paid only if compensation is recovered, and acts for clients in Vancouver and across British Columbia. It also covers dental malpractice. British Columbia has operated under a no-fault system for motor vehicle accidents since May 1, 2021.
waseer-law-office-london:
Waseer Law Office is a London, Ontario firm handling immigration, real estate, family law, and wills and estates for clients in seven languages.

The practice is led by Zia Waseer, who is a barrister and solicitor in Ontario and a solicitor in England and Wales. He holds a law degree from London Metropolitan University and has over 15 years of experience with a focus on Canadian immigration law. The office is on Richmond Street in London, and many real estate and immigration matters can be handled remotely. The wills and estates practice covers wills, powers of attorney, probate and estate administration for clients in London, Windsor, Mississauga and surrounding areas.
watchmaker-law-car-accident-and-personal:
Watchmaker Law is an Edmonton firm handling car accident, personal injury and civil litigation matters for clients across Alberta.

Founder David Sowemimo represents plaintiffs in serious and catastrophic injury cases, from paraplegic and quadriplegic injuries to multi-fatality collisions, and draws on alternative dispute resolution experience. Associates Wura Oshodi and Erin Castro are also with the firm, and services are available in English and Yoruba. Its injury practice covers psychological injuries, fractures, traumatic brain injuries, whiplash, burns and chronic pain. The firm works on a contingency fee basis and offers flexible meeting options for clients whose injuries make travel difficult.
weaver-simmons-llp:
Weaver Simmons LLP is a Sudbury firm of more than 30 full-time lawyers handling litigation, criminal, corporate, real estate, mining and family law.

The firm has more than 90 years of service and over 60 support staff including law clerks and students. Its practice areas also cover commercial, aboriginal, natural resources and labour and employment law, and it has a personal injury team. Services are offered in both official languages, Ojibwe, Greek and Italian, and clients include institutions, businesses, families and individuals throughout Ontario. The firm has supported more than 60 charitable and community organizations. The office is on Brady Street in Sudbury.
weirfoulds-llp:
WeirFoulds LLP is a Toronto law firm organized around four areas: litigation, corporate, property and government law.

The firm was founded in 1860. Fourteen of its lawyers have been appointed judges by the federal government, the first in 1883 and the most recent in 2021, and eight of them went to courts of appeal, including the Supreme Court of Canada. Past and current lawyers have also served as Treasurers and Benchers of the Law Society of Ontario. Its news and insights cover employment law, construction contracts, commercial litigation and estates.
weng-law-firm-toronto:
Across nine practice areas, Weng Law Firm acts for Toronto clients, from business and family matters to immigration and real estate. The areas are business, employment and labour, family and divorce, immigration, litigation, notary services, personal injury, real estate, and wills, estates and trusts.

Examples include incorporations, shareholder agreements and share purchases; dismissal and severance matters; separation agreements and marriage contracts; sponsorship, study permit, work permit and refugee applications; mortgage enforcement; affidavits and declarations; motor vehicle accident, slip and fall and dog bite injuries; and property purchases, sales and refinancing. Business matters are approached from a commercial perspective, and the office is in Scarborough.
west-legal-calgary:
West Legal is a Calgary team of lawyers handling wills and estates, probate, family, employment and residential real estate matters.

The firm takes a People First approach and serves Calgary, Okotoks and Airdrie. David West practises in real estate, wills and probate, Kim Nutz in employment law for both employees and employers, Machelle Luiters in family law and Kelsey Morrison in wills and estate planning. Adrienne O'Reilly handles corporate, securities, mergers and acquisitions and commercial work. West Legal offers flat-rate fees wherever possible, including for wills, enduring powers of attorney, personal directives, probate and residential real estate transactions.
westcoast-wills-and-estates-vancouver:
Westcoast Wills & Estates is a Vancouver firm of lawyers handling wills, trusts, probate, estate disputes and related corporate and family law.

The firm has offices in Vancouver, North Vancouver, Surrey, Burnaby and Richmond. Ninety-five percent of its clients are charged flat rates, and it donates 1 percent of its revenue to charity and tries to limit its environmental impact. Lawyers on the team include Jessica Poon, Aron Chitsaz, Katrina Law, Nick Russell, Harleen Sandhu and Joanna Tu. Representative work includes helping siblings settle a parent's estate through a probate application, and its lawyers present publicly on estate topics.
what-the-law:
What The Law is an Aurora criminal defence firm founded by Mustafa Sheikh, handling impaired driving and other criminal charges across Ontario.

The firm, styled WhatTheLaw, handles all criminal charges at all Ontario courthouses and offers flat-rate fees with flexible payment plans. A large team of criminal lawyers works collaboratively, with availability around the clock. Mr. Sheikh has appeared on CTV, CBC, Global News and CP24. Richmond Hill and the wider Greater Toronto Area are also part of its service area.
white-and-jeet-criminal-defence-calgary:
White & Jeet Criminal Defence is a Calgary team of criminal lawyers with offices in Lethbridge, Medicine Hat and Red Deer, serving all of Alberta.

Practice areas include violent and serious charges, sexual assault, murder and homicide, drug and controlled substance offences, financial and complex matters, and criminal driving offences. The firm also handles administration of justice offences, such as breaches of release conditions or probation under section 145 of the Criminal Code. Its work runs from early investigation and bail hearings through trial, appeals and post-conviction matters, and it operates a round-the-clock help line.
white-macgillivray-lester-llp-thunder-ba:
White Macgillivray Lester LLP is a Thunder Bay personal injury firm serving clients across Northwestern Ontario.

Its areas of work include slip and falls, vehicle collisions, insurance disputes and long term disability, and its team consists of injury lawyers and agents. Its lawyers and staff live in the region, unlike firms headquartered in Toronto, and it has helped people from the Manitoba border in the west to Marathon in the east, as well as in the far northern communities. The office is at 1 Cumberland Street South, and Dan Lester is among its lawyers.
whitestone-law-ottawa:
Whitestone Law is an Ottawa firm providing corporate and commercial law, real estate transactions and estate planning for clients across Ontario.

The firm acts for businesses, individuals and families, and clients work directly with their lawyer for continuity and clear communication. Corporate work covers mergers and acquisitions, incorporations, restructuring, contract drafting and regulatory compliance, with ongoing advisory and general counsel services available. Real estate files include buying, selling and refinancing, and estate planning centres on wills and inheritance planning. Costs are explained before work starts, and every lawyer on the team is licensed in Ontario.
williams-litigation-lawyers-llp:
Williams Litigation Lawyers LLP is an Ottawa civil litigation firm covering insurance, personal injury, estate and commercial disputes.

Areas of work include insurance law, personal injury, estate litigation, commercial litigation, employment litigation, professional liability and long-term disability. The lawyers include Kelly P. Hart, Eric R. Williams, Tara Lemke, Jeremy R. Rubenstein, Ashlee L. Barber, David Cutler, Gabrielle Parsons and Gabriella Gader. Kelly Hart and Eric Williams were included in the 2027 edition of a Canadian lawyer directory.
williams-litigation-north-north-bay:
Williams Litigation North is a North Bay civil litigation firm covering insurance, personal injury, long-term disability and professional liability.

The firm works as Williams Litigation Lawyers from 176 Lakeshore Drive. Its approach is modern counsel with classic care, doing law differently. Its team includes Ashlee L. Barber, Kelly P. Hart, Tara Lemke, Jeremy R. Rubenstein, Eric R. Williams, David Cutler, Gabrielle Parsons and Gabriella Gader. Two of its lawyers were included in a Canadian lawyer ranking publication.
williamson-law-calgary:
Williamson Law is a Calgary litigation practice handling civil disputes, personal injury, estate litigation, construction and real estate disputes. The practice operates as Chad Williamson Professional Corporation.

Civil work includes debt collection, judgment enforcement, insurance denials and professional negligence, while injury matters cover motor vehicle, motorcycle, pedestrian, bicycle and public transit accidents. It also handles probate, trusts, guardianship and trusteeship, builders' liens, and shareholder and joint venture disputes. The firm does not offer simple will drafting or real estate purchase and sale services.
wilson-rasmussen-llp-surrey:
Wilson Rasmussen LLP is a Surrey and Delta law firm handling real estate, wills and estates, property development, business and family law. It also acts in immigration, mediation and civil litigation, with offices in Surrey's Guildford Landmark building and in Delta.

Services include preparing wills, powers of attorney and representation agreements, advising companies on contracts and guiding developers through zoning, permits and development projects. The firm serves Surrey, Delta, Ladner, Tsawwassen, Langley, White Rock and Richmond and works in English and Spanish. Its lawyers include Dharam Dhillon, Robin Jawanda and Douglas Zorrilla.
wishart-law-firm:
Wishart Law Firm LLP handles corporate, commercial, civil litigation, real estate and municipal law in Sault Ste. Marie for clients across Ontario.

The firm's history begins in 1900, when Moses and Uriah McFadden opened an office at Brock and Queen Streets. Ernest McMillan joined after Moses became a judge in 1915, and when Arthur Wishart arrived from Blind River in 1939 the firm became Wishart and McMillan. After the Second World War the practice accepted an appointment as solicitor for the city. It also provides business planning, wills and estates and residential real estate work, and the office is on Bay Street.
witten-llp:
Witten LLP is an Edmonton firm practising real estate and wills and estates, at 2500 Canadian Western Bank Place on Jasper Avenue.

The firm is listed under real estate and wills and estates in Alberta. Details of its lawyers, history and approach are not recorded in this entry, which is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice areas.
wolf-law-mississauga:
Wolf Law, based in Mississauga, advises lenders, investors and businesses on real estate transactions, commercial lending and mergers and acquisitions.

The firm acts for purchasers, lenders, private credit funds and developers across Ontario and internationally. The lending side covers secured and unsecured arrangements such as acquisition financing, real estate development financing, bridge loans and asset-based lending. Its commercial real estate work includes acquisitions, dispositions, title searches and due diligence, and joint venture agreements for development projects. The corporate side includes share and asset purchases, joint ventures and cross-border business transactions.
wolseley-law-llp-winnipeg:
Wolseley Law LLP is a Winnipeg community law firm handling wills, estates, real estate, family, business and litigation matters. Partners Gerrit Theule, Tim Brown and Leah Unruh founded the firm in the Wolseley neighbourhood, where Gerrit grew up and lives, to serve everyday issues rather than large downtown clients.

Services include buying, selling and mortgaging property, wills, estates and elder law, family law through collaboration, negotiation and mediation, litigation, and business and non-profit work. The firm also offers assisted self-representation, with unbundled services and legal coaching, and publishes flat-fee pricing for matters that progress consistently. The office is at 120 Sherbrook Street.
woods-llp:
Woods LLP is a Montreal law firm with litigation and employment law as its recorded practice areas.

Its office is at 2000 McGill College Avenue, Suite 1700, Montreal, Quebec. Details about its lawyers, courts or approach are not recorded in this entry, which is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice areas.
workly-law-toronto:
Workly Law is a Toronto firm handling employment, labour and corporate matters for employees, executives, employers and boards. Led by Sunira Chaudhri, the firm acts across Canada on terminations, constructive and wrongful dismissal, employment contracts and offers, non-competition agreements, discrimination and human rights cases, and sexual harassment and bullying. Executive work includes negotiating contracts and disputes over bonuses, restricted share units, equity pay and long-term incentives.

Its corporate and civil work includes partnership disputes and startup law. Sunira Chaudhri comments on employment cases in the media, including radio appearances on Newstalk 1010, and the team includes Tiana Perricone, Samantha Khaouli, Jan Tomiska and Ceviel Alizadeh-Najmi. The office is on Bay Street in Toronto.
wpc-personal-injury-lawyer-etobicoke:
Etobicoke-based WPC Personal Injury Lawyer handles car accidents, slips and falls and other injury cases.

Eric Barapp leads a team that also includes Lorne Weinstock, Eti Taylor and Nabeel Sera, and he is a graduate of Osgoode Hall Law School. Practice areas include orthopaedic injuries, motorcycle, pedestrian and public transit accidents and dog bite incidents. Each case is assigned a case manager who coordinates documents and communication with the other parties. Operating as WPC Law, the firm has offices in Etobicoke, Scarborough and Cayuga and belongs to the BARAPP Law Alliance.
wvgb-personal-injury-lawyers-ottawa:
WVGB Personal Injury Lawyers is an Ottawa firm acting for people hurt in car crashes, falls, brain injuries and other accidents.

WVGB Law Group was established in 2021 through a partnership between Villeneuve Litigation P.C. and Wolfe Lawyers P.C., and serves English and French speaking communities in Ottawa and the Ottawa Valley. Clients work directly with a partner who oversees the case personally. Practice areas cover car accidents, slip and trip and falls, brain injuries, animal attacks and rideshare and taxi accidents, along with wills and estates, and the time limits that apply to injury cases are explained.
wyman-and-williamson-criminal-defence-la:
Wyman & Williamson is a Calgary criminal defence firm that handles only Criminal Code prosecutions, with a focus on sexual assault and impaired driving.

Its lawyers act at all levels of court in Alberta, have made several appearances before the Supreme Court of Canada, and take cases throughout Western Canada. The firm handles domestic assault matters, including the conditions police impose barring communication after a domestic incident, and covers simple and aggravated assault, threats and bail conditions. The consequences of a sexual assault conviction include possible incarceration and registration on the sex offender registry. The Calgary office sits on Seventh Avenue SW.
x-copper-toronto:
X-Copper is a Toronto defence firm handling traffic tickets, criminal charges and CVOR offences across Ontario. Its team includes more than 60 lawyers and paralegals as well as former police officers, working from 18 offices across Ontario, and it has handled over 300,000 tickets and charges.

Traffic matters include speeding, careless driving, stop sign offences and stunt driving, with the aim of reducing demerit points, fines and insurance impact. Criminal work covers impaired driving, assault, theft, fraud and drug offences. Fees are set as block fees, and the firm attends preliminary court appearances so that clients do not have to.
yazdani-law-north-york:
Denied and terminated long-term disability benefits are the focus of Yazdani Law, a North York practice led by Mark Yazdani. The practice acts in court against insurance companies for people whose short-term or long-term disability benefits were denied or cut off.

Mark Yazdani has more than 17 years of experience as a disability lawyer. His cases involve fibromyalgia and chronic pain as well as psychiatric conditions such as depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, PTSD and panic disorder. The practice serves Toronto and the surrounding areas from its Yonge Street office and acts for clients across Ontario.
yeung-and-associates-law-professional-co:
Yeung & Associates is a Toronto firm founded in 1989 that has focused on motor vehicle accident claims since 1996.

The firm serves the Chinese-speaking community, and its team speaks Mandarin, Cantonese and English. The firm says it helps clients with the financial and emotional strain after an accident and with complex claim documents. Founder Philip Yeung's earlier career included immigration, criminal and personal injury work.
ylaw-vancouver:
YLaw is a Vancouver firm handling family, employment, estate litigation, immigration and strata law matters across British Columbia.

The firm has offices in Vancouver, Langley and Chilliwack, and also serves Surrey. Its family lawyers deal with divorce, common-law separation, asset and debt division, spousal and child support and parenting time, plus mediation. The employment group covers wrongful dismissal, severance, contracts and workplace equity, while estate litigators handle will disputes and unfair wills. YLaw also handles civil litigation and class actions. It does not treat every case as a battle and focuses on a client's long-term family, career and financial interests.
z-legal-litigation-lawyer-toronto:
Z Legal is a Toronto litigation firm handling estate, employment, commercial and family disputes and professional misconduct matters.

Founder Martin Zatovkanuk is a litigation lawyer with more than a decade of experience before all levels of Ontario courts. The firm represents clients from the outset of a matter to its end, whether it resolves by settlement, mediation, arbitration or trial. Its employment practice acts for employees and employers on wrongful dismissal, severance pay, constructive dismissal and workplace harassment across Toronto and the GTA, while the firm also covers real estate litigation and will challenges. Flat-rate and contingency fee options are available.
zacharias-mccann-llp:
Zacharias McCann LLP (ZM LLP) is an Abbotsford firm handling civil litigation, personal injury, employment, family and commercial matters.

The firm acts across British Columbia, Alberta and the Yukon and covers commercial litigation, contract law, disability law, class actions, real estate, corporate law, and governance and workplace law for First Nations. Its family law team works on separation agreements, mediation, court applications and trials, alongside accountants, business valuators, real estate appraisers, pension valuators and counsellors. Its lawyers have more than 100 years of combined experience.
zaifman-immigration-lawyers-winnipeg:
Zaifman Immigration Lawyers is a Winnipeg firm handling Canadian immigration applications for individuals, employers and international students.

Kenneth Zaifman founded the firm in 1986 after taking his first immigration case, R. v. Cole, in 1979. The staff of twelve includes lawyers and Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultants, and service is offered in Chinese, Spanish, Korean, Tagalog, Punjabi and Hindi. The firm assists applicants destined for any province under federal programs and Provincial Nominee Programs, helps Canadian employers fill labour needs, and supports students planning to study in Manitoba.
zamani-law-toronto:
Zamani Law is a Toronto criminal defence firm that represents people facing criminal allegations across the Greater Toronto Area.

Practice areas include bail hearings and domestic violence charges, and the firm's priority is protecting clients' rights while seeking a reasonable resolution or withdrawal of charges. For family law, wills and estate planning and real estate, it has alliances with other practitioners to whom it directs clients, since family disputes are often linked to criminal proceedings. Founder Farid Zamani is a co-founder of Children without Borders, a non-profit that raises awareness of child labour and sponsors education for children in Afghan communities. The office is on Richmond Street West.
zargarian-litigation:
Zargarian Litigation is a Nanaimo criminal defence firm defending assault, sexual assault, impaired driving, firearms and fraud charges.

It acts across British Columbia. Babak Zargarian and Zoe Arghandewal handle every file personally. Babak Zargarian has conducted cases at every level of court in the province and before the Supreme Court of Canada, and he practises in both trials and appeals. The firm serves Nanaimo, Campbell River, Courtenay, Duncan, Port Alberni and Smithers, and takes cases from Vancouver Island to Prince Rupert.
zemp-law-group-calgary:
Zemp Law Group is a Calgary immigration firm covering both Canadian and American immigration for individuals and businesses. The firm is led by Kevin Zemp, who is licensed to practise immigration and citizenship law in Canada and the USA.

Staff include former senior Canadian immigration officials and immigration paralegals, and speak Filipino, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, Slovak and Polish. Services include work permits under NAFTA, GATS and intra-company transfer categories, LMIA applications, study permits, super visas, permanent residence in Canada and the USA, citizenship, and inadmissibility matters.
zinati-kay-toronto:
Zinati Kay is a Toronto real estate law firm handling home purchases, sales, refinancing and title transfers at fixed closing costs. It has practised residential real estate law in Toronto for more than 25 years and has closed over 25,000 transactions.

John Zinati heads the firm, holds degrees from the University of Toronto and Osgoode Hall Law School, writes a newsletter called Title Tips and sits on an advisory council at First Canadian Title. Other services include assignments, title insurance, title searches and virtual closings and signings. Clients come from downtown Toronto, east to Oshawa and north to Newmarket. The team also includes Jonathan Mak, Cathy Harpaul and Leroy Law.
zoe-arghandewal-nanaimo:
Zoe Arghandewal is a Nanaimo lawyer handling wrongful dismissal, severance, human rights and workplace discrimination matters. A partner at Zargarian Litigation, she has more than seven years of experience, previously practised at her own firm, Arghandewal Law, and serves Nanaimo and all of Vancouver Island.

Most of her employment work is for workers, though she has also acted for some non-profit employers. It includes severance negotiations, discrimination and harassment complaints under the BC Human Rights Code, workplace investigations, mediations and reviewing employment contracts. She also defends criminal charges such as assault, theft, fraud and impaired driving in provincial and Supreme Court matters.
zomorodi-law-pc-richmond-hill:
Zomorodi Law PC is a Richmond Hill firm offering real estate transactions, business law, civil and commercial litigation, and wills and estates.

Its real estate practice covers purchase, sale and mortgage closings for urban and cottage properties, condominiums and vacant land, both residential and commercial. Business services include articles of incorporation, shareholder agreements and the sale or acquisition of franchised businesses, and notary public services are also offered. The firm serves newcomers, business owners, young entrepreneurs, other professionals, international investors and diverse communities, and its litigation experience lets it handle disputes that arise during a closing in house.
zoom-law-calgary:
Zoom Law is a Calgary firm practising only injury law, from car accidents and hit and runs to motorcycle, pedestrian and cycling crashes.

Its car accident work covers rear-end collisions, impaired or distracted driving, uninsured motorists and wrongful death. The firm works across Alberta and offers service in English, Arabic, Russian, Polish, Ukrainian, Tagalog, Urdu, Punjabi, Hindi and Kurdish. It also guides clients through chronic injury matters and recovery, with the Calgary office as its base.
zubic-law:
Zubic Law is a Niagara Falls firm handling residential and commercial real estate, corporate matters, wills, powers of attorney and probate.

Zubic Law Professional Corporation and Anya Zubic Professional Law Corporation both operate under the Zubic Law name. Real estate services include contract negotiation, due diligence and closings for buyers and sellers, as well as mortgage refinancing, with separate real estate coverage for Welland, St. Catharines, Airdrie and Okotoks. On the estates side, it guides executors and beneficiaries through probate and estate administration. The office is on Victoria Avenue in Niagara Falls.
